10-b-criminal-law-center-st-catharines:
10(B) Criminal Law Center is a Niagara criminal defence practice handling bail hearings, trials, youth court and impaired driving charges.

The office is in St. Catharines, and the practice is exclusively criminal defence, led by Sidney Zarabi. Areas of work include bail hearings, resolution and diversion, youth criminal justice, mental health and drug treatment court, Indigenous peoples court and trials. The firm also helps clients reach counselling, housing and employment programs. Zarabi has written commentary on Niagara's justice system, including its detention centre and treatment court, and the firm is a member of the Ontario Trial Lawyers Association.
a-circelli-law-guelph:
A.Circelli Law is a Guelph family and estates law practice led by Antonio (Tony) Circelli, handling divorce, separation, wills and estate planning.

Circelli was called to the Ontario bar in 2003 and spent more than a decade as in-house counsel at Family and Children's Services of Guelph and Wellington County before opening his own practice. The office is at 367 Woolwich Street in Guelph, and the firm's work covers divorce and family law, trust planning and estates.
a-dhillon-law-brampton:
A Dhillon Law Professional Corporation is a Brampton criminal defence firm serving clients across Southern Ontario.

The firm maintains offices in both Brampton and Toronto and acts for individuals facing criminal charges, defending cases involving impaired driving, assault, sexual assault, assault with a weapon, uttering threats, mischief, theft, drug offences and firearm and weapons charges. Clients are served in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
a-m-canadian-immigration-law-corporation:
A&M Canadian Immigration Law Corporation is a Winnipeg immigration-only law firm handling work and study permits, Express Entry and sponsorships.

Established in 2019 by Dr. Muhammad Abrar, the firm is based at 1325 Markham Road, Unit 12, and acts for clients in Manitoba, across Canada and abroad. Its work covers visitor visas, spousal and parent sponsorship, business immigration, refusals, judicial review and appeals, refugee matters and citizenship, with remote consultations available for clients outside Winnipeg. Abrar is a member of the Canadian Immigration Lawyers Association.
a-s-law-office-winnipeg:
AS Law Office is a Winnipeg solo law practice led by Avantika Sharma, handling immigration, family, real estate, criminal and estates matters.

Sharma is a barrister, solicitor and notary public who appears before the Manitoba Court of King's Bench and the Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada. The office is at 1785 Main Street in West Kildonan, and its work includes Express Entry, the Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program, family sponsorship, work and study permits and refugee claims, as well as divorce, child custody and support, residential real estate, wills and probate. Service is offered in English, Hindi and Punjabi, in person or virtually, to newcomers, families and small business owners across North Winnipeg.
a-s-mattoo-and-associates-law-office-kam:
A S Mattoo & Associates Law Office is a Kamloops law firm handling real estate, estates, business and immigration matters.

The firm works from 712 Seymour Street and handles residential and commercial real estate, mortgages and refinancing, wills and estates, corporate and business law, immigration, and taxpayer representation including CRA audits, appeals and Tax Court of Canada matters.
aaries-family-law-kingston:
Aaries Family Law is a Kingston firm that practises family and divorce law exclusively, from separation agreements to custody and support.

Led by principal lawyer Mark Kim, a former family mediator with a certificate in family mediation from York University, the firm has practised since 2015 from 159 Wellington Street, Suite 4, and appears in Kingston's Unified Family Court. Its work covers divorce, parenting time and custody, child and spousal support, the division of property and debt, and family mediation, for clients in Kingston, Frontenac County, Napanee, Belleville and Brockville.
aasara-lawyers-professional-corporation-:
Aasara Lawyers is a Brampton firm handling real estate, business and corporate, and wills and estates matters for clients across the GTA.

Partner Aman Kapila, a Barrister & Solicitor, practises business and corporate law, commercial matters and secured financing, and has worked on files for individual clients as well as banks and private lenders. The firm's real estate work covers buying, selling and mortgaging residential and commercial property across Ontario.
abramovich-immigration-law-toronto:
Abramovich Immigration Law is a Toronto immigration law firm led by lawyer Lev Abramovich, acting for families, individuals and businesses.

Abramovich studied at the University of Windsor and speaks English, Hebrew and Russian, and the firm works from 60 Bloor Street West. It handles family sponsorship, permanent residence, Express Entry, citizenship, LMIA and employer-sponsored applications, refugee claims, asylum and pre-removal risk assessments, business and investor programs, and Federal Court judicial review for newcomers from diverse backgrounds.
accord-family-law-edmonton:
Accord Family Law is an Edmonton family law firm founded in 2020 by lawyer Reena Herian, with a virtual-first practice serving clients across Alberta.

The firm operates as Reena Herian Professional Corporation from Suite 333 at 13548 97 Street NW and handles separation agreements, joint and uncontested divorces, prenuptial, postnuptial and cohabitation agreements, independent legal advice, residential real estate, and wills and estate planning, with a focus on low-conflict family matters, in English.
accord-law-professional-corporation-toro:
Real estate, immigration, wills and powers of attorney, and business law make up the work of Accord Law Professional Corporation in Toronto. Principal lawyer and founder Angat Saini worked for over 12 years as a real estate agent and has practised at a large Bay Street firm, where he handled immigration matters for clients ranging from individual applicants to multinational corporations.

The immigration group has advised on citizenship and business cases for more than 14 years, covering business immigration, resident permits, work permits and student visas for employers hiring from abroad and for individuals moving to Canada. The firm also provides notary public and commissioner of oaths services and offers its legal services in several languages.
achkar-law:
Achkar Law is a North York employment law firm acting for employees and employers in Ontario and British Columbia on dismissal, severance and human rights.

Christopher Achkar founded the firm in 2016 with the aim of practising in plain language, with practical strategies, for real people facing real problems. The firm also handles constructive dismissal, workplace disputes and employer-side defence, with a hub for Toronto and the GTA. For employers, its lawyers design workplace training, including on the harassment and violence requirements under Ontario's Occupational Health and Safety Act. The firm acts on either side of an employment dispute.
acosta-legal-services-north-york:
Acosta Legal Services is a North York paralegal practice providing litigation support, legal document preparation and real estate-related services.

The corporation is led by principal Maikell Acosta, a paralegal licensed by the Law Society of Ontario, and works from 25 Sheppard Avenue West. It is a paralegal practice rather than a law firm, and its listed services include legal forms and document help, legal information, litigation support and real estate services for clients across North York and the Greater Toronto Area.
adam-miller-kelly-law-firm-ottawa:
Adam Miller Kelly Law Firm is a Kanata law firm in Ottawa handling real estate, wills and estates, and municipal and planning law.

The firm is a multi-lawyer practice at 300 March Road, Suite 601, serving clients across Kanata and the wider Ottawa area. Its work covers real estate transactions, wills, estates and trusts, and municipal and planning matters, and it is one of the established legal offices in Ottawa's west end.
addelman-baum-gilbert-llp-ottawa:
Addelman Baum Gilbert LLP is an Ottawa criminal defence law firm formed in 2010, acting in impaired driving, drug and regulatory cases.

The firm was formed in January 2010 by Richard Addelman, who was called to the bar in 1969 and co-founded the Defence Counsel Association of Ottawa, Douglas Baum, called in 1994 and later president of that association, Jason Gilbert and Joseph Addelman. Its roughly six lawyers handle criminal defence, child protection defence for Children's Aid Society matters, regulatory and provincial offences, impaired driving and drug offences.
ads-law-professional-corporation-mississ:
ADS Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga, Ontario law firm advising on real estate, corporate, estates, family and litigation matters.

The firm’s head office is in Streetsville, with a meeting office in Toronto at First Canadian Place, 100 King Street West. It acts for start-ups, local businesses, professionals, developers and investors across Ontario on real estate, corporate and commercial law, wills and estates, family law and civil litigation, and completes transactions remotely.
advocate-law-calgary:
Advocate Law is a Calgary association of independent criminal trial lawyers serving clients across Alberta.

Founding members Maurice Collard, a former long-serving Central Alberta Crown prosecutor, Jeremy Newton, a former federal prosecutor, and Andrew Phypers are joined by trial counsel Michelle McBeath, Hannah Volk and Darren Tootoosis. The group defends impaired driving, drug, assault, homicide and child-protection matters before the Alberta Court of Justice, the Court of King’s Bench and appellate courts, and also handles wills, estates and trusts for individuals, families and small businesses.
aeh-legal-laval:
AEH Legal is a Laval criminal and penal defence practice founded by Alicia E. Haziza, a former Crown prosecutor.

Haziza previously prosecuted for Quebec's Crown prosecution service, the DPCP, and has nearly a decade of legal experience. The office is at 800 Boulevard Chomedey, Tower C, Suite 430, and the practice acts in criminal and penal matters for clients in Montreal and across Quebec, in English and French.
aftermath-law-criminal-defence-mississau:
Aftermath Law is a Mississauga, Ontario criminal defence and family law practice led by principal lawyer Dildeep Sahi.

The firm defends adults and youth in Ontario criminal courts, handling bail hearings, assault and domestic allegations, impaired driving, drug and weapons charges, and theft and fraud matters, and it also advises on divorce, parenting, child and spousal support and property division. Sahi holds an LLB from the University of Leicester and completed the Law Practice Program at Toronto Metropolitan University with a placement at the North Bay Crown Attorney’s Office. The firm serves Mississauga, Brampton and communities across Ontario in English, Punjabi and Hindi and accepts Legal Aid Ontario certificates.
agir-legal-inc: Agir Legal Inc is a family law firm in Quebec City, Quebec. Its office is at 1020 Rue Bouvier, Suite 400, Quebec City, Quebec G2K 0H3. The firm's practice area is family law, and it is based in Quebec City in the province of Quebec. Details of its lawyers, services other than family law and approach are not on record, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, address and practice area.
agnes-law-toronto:
Agnes Law is a Scarborough law firm handling real estate, family, immigration, business, civil litigation and estates matters.

Agnes K. Varkeychen is the owner and principal lawyer, practising as a barrister and solicitor from 885 Progress Avenue, Suite 218, with a branch office in Maple. The firm's services include real estate, family law, immigration, business and corporate law, civil litigation, wills and estates, and notary services.
agp-llp-ottawa-criminal-lawyers-ottawa:
AGP LLP Ottawa Criminal Lawyers is an Ottawa criminal defence firm whose partners include Howard Krongold, Michael Spratt and Keara Lundrigan.

The firm practises criminal law exclusively from Suite 200 at 116 Lisgar Street and handles impaired driving, drug offences, sexual assault, homicide, white-collar crime, appeals, bail hearings and youth matters for individuals, executives, professionals and institutions across Eastern Ontario, and has appeared before the Supreme Court of Canada.
ain-whitehead-llp-barrie:
Ain Whitehead LLP is a downtown Barrie law firm handling business, real estate, and wills and estates matters.

Lawyers Andrew Ain, who leads the firm’s land development work, founding partner Kathryn Whitehead, Graydon Ebert and Tony Servello practise from 27 Clapperton Street, handling business and corporate law, real estate law, and wills, estates and trusts for individuals and businesses in Barrie.
aird-berlis-llp:
Aird & Berlis LLP is a Toronto business law firm established in 1974, located at Brookfield Place on Bay Street.

The firm works from Suite 1800 at 181 Bay Street and its practice covers corporate and commercial law, real estate, civil litigation, employment and labour, tax, intellectual property and technology, wills and estates, restructuring and insolvency, municipal and land development law and energy, for real estate developers, Ontario municipalities, banks, infrastructure funds, energy developers and court-appointed monitors.
aitken-robertson-kingston:
Aitken Robertson is a criminal defence law firm established in 2009, with offices in Kingston, Peterborough and Oshawa.

Richard Aitken is the firm's owner, and the Kingston office is at 2263 Princess Street. The firm defends impaired driving and DUI, assault, drug, theft, fraud and weapons offences, breach of probation and internet offences for clients across the region.
aitken-robertson-peterborough:
Aitken Robertson is a Peterborough criminal defence firm founded in 1999 by lawyer Richard J Aitken, called to the Ontario bar in 1984.

The Peterborough office is at 263 Charlotte Street, and the firm also has offices in Kingston, Brampton, Newmarket, Oshawa, Belleville, Scarborough and Toronto. It was formed in 1999 when Richard Aitken took over the practices of Harry Robertson and John Robertson Q.C. Its work covers impaired driving, domestic violence, drug offences, criminal appeals, youth charges, and highway traffic and provincial offences, for clients across southern, central and eastern Ontario.
aj-murray-legal-services-professional-co:
Paralegals at AJ Murray Legal Services Professional Corporation handle landlord and tenant, human rights and provincial offences matters in Ottawa.

The firm also has offices in Toronto and Hamilton. Licensed paralegal and notary public Amri Murray holds a law degree from the University of London and has more than 16 years in the legal industry. The firm appears before the Landlord and Tenant Board, the Ontario Court of Justice and the Human Rights Tribunal, and handles employment standards issues such as minimum wage and hours of work, from negotiation through to litigation.
akrami-and-associates-mississauga:
Akrami & Associates is a Mississauga immigration law firm handling Express Entry, sponsorships, work and study permits, appeals and deportation defence.

Founded in 2013 by managing partner Shabnam Akrami, the firm works from 1440 Hurontario Street in Port Credit, and its team includes immigration lawyers, paralegals and regulated consultants. Its work also covers business immigration, citizenship, temporary resident permits, criminal rehabilitation and refugee law, serving clients across the GTA, Canada and abroad in languages including Farsi, Arabic, French, Hindi and Urdu.
alam-real-estate-law-mississauga:
Alam Real Estate Law is a Mississauga law practice led by founder and managing barrister Muhammad Alam, called to the Ontario bar in 2007.

The practice works from 5100 Dixie Road with lawyers Aftab Alam, Laurencia Fasoyiro and Naina Tandon. It handles residential and commercial purchase, sale and refinance closings, private mortgages, title transfers, status certificate reviews, wills, powers of attorney, construction liens and real estate litigation across the Greater Toronto Area and Halton.
alepin-gauthier-avocats:
Alepin Gauthier Avocats is a family-run Laval law firm of lawyers and notaries, founded in 1978 by François Alepin.

Brigitte Gauthier later became a partner and founded the firm's family law department, and Chanel Alepin and Maxime Alepin have been partners since 2021. The firm has offices in Laval, Old Montreal, downtown Montreal and Quebec City. Its practice covers business and corporate law, family law, real estate, construction, employment and labour, wills and estates, immigration, criminal defence, tax, bankruptcy and insolvency, civil litigation and notarial services for individuals, families and small and medium businesses, in English, French, Arabic and Italian.
alexander-hu-professional-corporation-to:
Alexander Hu Professional Corporation is a Downtown Toronto law firm limited to real estate, handling home and condo purchases, sales and mortgages.

The firm's work covers title examination, financing and closing coordination, including examination of condominium status certificates and collaboration with realtors and mortgage lenders. It serves Toronto, Peel, Durham, York and Halton regions, with local coverage of Central Toronto, Old York, East York, Etobicoke, North York and Scarborough. Topics include multiple offers, rezoning and development, property taxes, land transfer taxes and mixed-use or commercial properties.
alg-lawyers:
ALG Lawyers is an Abbotsford law firm founded by Jasdeep Aujla, with additional offices in Surrey and Vancouver.

The firm has six lawyers and works from Unit 205 at 2890 Garden Street in Abbotsford. In December 2025 it took on the team and clients of Bronson Jones Gray & Company, a firm established in 1986. Its practice covers family law, criminal defence, real estate, wills and estates, personal injury, business and corporate law and employment law, in English, Hindi and Punjabi.
ali-family-law-surrey:
Ali Family Law is a Surrey, British Columbia firm that helps families with divorce, separation and parenting matters.

The practice covers divorce, separation agreements, child and spousal support, property division, parenting time, mediation and independent legal advice, and its team includes Zamir Ali. The firm also publishes articles on what to expect from divorce and the family court process. The office is at 15388 24 Avenue, Unit 202, in Surrey.
alice-huynh-law-corporation-vancouver:
Alice Huynh Law Corporation is a British Columbia family law and civil litigation practice led by lawyer Alice Huynh.

The one-lawyer practice handles family law, civil litigation, estate litigation, and wills and estates matters, and Huynh appears in both the Provincial Court and the Supreme Court of British Columbia. Services are offered in English and Vietnamese to family law and litigation clients in Vancouver and Burnaby.
align-family-law:
Align Family Law is a Victoria family law firm led by a team of lawyers that includes Joanne Martin.

From Suite 102 at 2020 Richmond Road, the firm handles divorce, separation agreements, child custody, child and spousal support, adoption, fertility law, marriage and cohabitation agreements, committeeship and mediation for traditional and non-traditional families in Victoria and across British Columbia, in English.
alloy-llp-calgary:
Alloy LLP is a Calgary firm practising corporate litigation, real estate and personal injury law for individuals and businesses. Partners Joseph Iwanicki and Greg von Euw became friends in law school and formed the firm after more than 10 years of experience in the industry.

Each file stays with one lawyer rather than passing between several, so clients deal with the same person throughout. The firm helps business owners with legal problems, home buyers and sellers, and people hurt in accidents. The office is in Bow Valley Square II on 5 Avenue SW and serves the Calgary area and beyond.
amanda-berloni-professional-corporation:
Amanda Berloni Professional Corporation is a Greater Sudbury law firm founded in 2015, handling real estate, corporate and wills and estates matters.

Amanda Berloni founded the firm after working as a student and then associate at Wildeboer Dellelce LLP in Toronto corporate finance, and associates Connor MacKay and Marissa Sarrazin practise alongside. From its single office at 254 Larch Street, the firm acts on residential and commercial real estate, corporate and commercial law, business formation and governance, mergers and acquisitions, commercial leases, and wills and estates for homebuyers, lenders, developers, entrepreneurs, individuals, families and businesses, in English and French.
amani-law-office-richmond-hill:
Amani Law Office is a Richmond Hill law firm led by lawyer Ali Amani, operating as Amani Law Professional Corporation.

Ali Amani holds a master of laws degree from Osgoode Hall Law School and is licensed by the Law Society of Ontario. The firm, at Suite 203, 27 Major Mackenzie Drive East, handles immigration and refugee law, real estate, notary and commissioner services, wills and powers of attorney, civil litigation and criminal defence, with services in English, Arabic and Farsi.
ambassador-law-corporation-abbotsford:
Ambassador Law Corporation is an Abbotsford law firm handling real estate conveyancing, wills and estates and notary services.

The business has been registered in Abbotsford since 2005 and amalgamated with Terry Sidhu Notarial Services Inc. Jimmy Kumar is the firm's president and lawyer, and its single office is at 33456 South Fraser Way, Suite 120. Services include residential and commercial conveyancing, refinancing, subdivisions, wills, probate, powers of attorney, representation agreements, business formation and notarization for homebuyers, investors, entrepreneurs and families across Abbotsford and the Fraser Valley.
amberstone-law-civil-litigation-lawyers-:
Amberstone Law is a Calgary boutique civil litigation firm founded in 2023 by managing lawyer Shubhankar Baweja.

Lawyers Karanbir Dhariwal and Jason Ramsoondar practise with Shubhankar Baweja from Suite 310 at 150 13 Avenue SW. The firm handles civil and commercial litigation, business formation and transactions, commercial real estate and leasing, contracts, and employment and wrongful dismissal matters for business owners, commercial landlords, tenants and corporate investors across Calgary and Alberta, in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
amer-ali-law-ottawa:
Amer Ali Law is a virtual Ontario firm, with Ottawa, Orleans and Toronto listed, that handles real estate closings, incorporations and wills.

The firm's model pairs technology with personal service, with documents signed electronically and remotely, or in person when arranged in advance. Its real estate work includes buying and selling, title transfers and survivorship applications, mortgage transactions, mortgage refinancing and debt consolidation, and examining the agreement of purchase and sale. It acts for homeowners, realtors, lenders and mortgage professionals on residential and commercial properties, and has completed thousands of real estate deals.
amica-law-corporation-winnipeg:
Amica Law Corporation is a Winnipeg law firm handling business, real estate, family and estates matters.

Lawyers Debra Takeuchi, Tanya Keller and Sue Ahn-Breckman practise from Suite 30 at 226 Osborne Street North. The firm handles business and corporate law, real estate, family law including mediation and collaborative family law, and wills, estates and trusts, with appointments by telephone, video or in person and some legal services available in Spanish.
amlea-avocats:
Amlea Avocats is a Montreal business and corporate law firm advising startups, entrepreneurs and small and medium businesses in Quebec.

Anne-Edma Louis, a tax and corporate lawyer admitted to the Barreau du Québec, founded the firm in 2015, and Gabraël Akinyode is a business and corporate lawyer on the team. From a single office at 500 Place d'Armes, it handles incorporations and business formation, corporate tax planning, shareholder agreements, holding companies and trusts, mergers and acquisitions, and trademark registration and intellectual property for startups, IT consultants and growing companies.
ammar-law-professional-corporation-winds:
Ammar Law Professional Corporation is a Windsor law firm led by Ahmad Ammar, handling real estate, criminal defence and immigration matters.

Ahmad Ammar has led the firm since 2015, working from 3990 Tecumseh Road East. Its practice covers residential and commercial real estate, criminal defence including bail hearings, immigration, personal injury, and wills and estates for clients in Windsor.
anderson-haak-and-engels-edmonton:
Anderson Haak & Engels is an Edmonton law firm handling residential and commercial real estate, wills and estate planning, and incorporations.

The firm was formed when Robert A. Engels joined the existing practice of Kenneth R. Haak, and both are partners, with Graham Semeniuk as associate. It also has offices in northside Edmonton, Windermere, Leduc and Sherwood Park. Its work covers condominium purchase and sale reviews, mortgage refinancing, powers of attorney and personal directives, for buyers, sellers, condominium owners and lenders in Edmonton, Leduc, Sherwood Park, Beaumont and St. Albert, in English.
andrew-edgar-criminal-defence-counsel-br:
Andrew Edgar Criminal Defence Counsel represents people facing criminal charges in Brampton, Mississauga and across the GTA. Andrew Edgar has practised exclusively in criminal defence since 2005, a span of more than 20 years, and works directly with each client. He represents clients in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice.

He walks through the allegations, the evidence, the options and the possible consequences of a charge, including questions about work, family and a criminal record, so that clients can make informed decisions. The firm, which also operates as Edgar Law, is on Steeles Avenue East in Brampton.
andrews-donnelly-llp-kingston:
Andrews Donnelly LLP is a Kingston boutique firm handling family law, estate litigation and civil litigation.

Its dispute resolution services are available in Kingston, Frontenac County, Prince Edward County and surrounding areas, including Brockville, Napanee, Belleville and Picton. Family work covers custody, access, child and spousal support and division of property. Estate litigation covers will challenges, power of attorney disputes, capacity questions and the passing of fiduciary accounts. Its lawyers include Paul and Whitney, and fees can be arranged as fixed-fee or project-based billing, hourly engagements, or monthly retainers.
ang-law-professional-corporation-north-y:
Ang Law Professional Corporation is a North York firm handling real estate, family law, wills and estates, immigration and business law. Founded in 2020, it acts on residential and commercial real estate transactions, divorce and separation including mediation and support, marriage and cohabitation contracts, civil matters and estate planning.

Lawyer Derek graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 2018, focuses on family and real estate law and sits on the Legal Aid family panel. Lia is licensed in both the Philippines and Ontario and practises immigration and business law. Services are offered remotely for clients across the Greater Toronto Area.
angeles-and-de-jesus-law-llp-toronto:
Angeles & De Jesus Law LLP, also known as AJ Law LLP, is a Toronto law firm and licensed paralegal practice.

Fatima Angeles and Czarina Mae De Jesus founded the firm, and immigration lawyer Rodrigo Jun Hernandez also practises there, from a single midtown Toronto office at 160 Eglinton Avenue East. Services cover immigration, family law, criminal law, civil litigation, wills and estates, real estate and notarial services, along with paralegal services including landlord and tenant matters, small claims and provincial offences.
anita-perera-law-professional-corp-lawye:
Anita Perera Law is a Brampton firm offering real estate, immigration, family, wills and notary services across the GTA, founded in 2016.

Anita Perera practised law in Sri Lanka before requalifying in Canada and being called to the Ontario bar in 2016. The firm describes its approach as patient, plain-language advice for clients who find the legal system intimidating, particularly newcomers. Its paralegal services cover Small Claims Court and tribunal matters across the Greater Toronto Area.
ankr-legal-calgary:
ANKR Legal is a Calgary, Alberta law firm at 638 11 Avenue SW, Suite 200, practising in personal injury, criminal defence, and wills and estates.

Lawyer Andres Villaruel handles personal injury claims arising from motor vehicle, pedestrian and cyclist accidents, along with employment and human rights matters, while the firm’s criminal defence and wills and estates practices serve individuals and families across Calgary.
anne-gervais-corbin-avocate:
Anne Gervais-Corbin Avocate is a sole-practitioner family and youth law practice at 371 Rue Racine in Granby, Quebec.

A member of the Barreau du Québec, she practises as an avocate in family and youth law, advising on divorce and separation, child custody, support payments, youth law and youth protection matters involving the DPJ, and serves Granby and the surrounding area in French.
annette-lefebvre-avocats-montreal:
Annette Lefebvre Avocats is a Montreal firm representing patients and accident victims in medical malpractice and personal injury cases.

The firm acts only for patients and victims, including in birth injury, spinal cord injury and chiropractic injury cases against doctors, medical institutions, building owners and insurers. It has more than forty years of experience. Annette Lefebvre is a former intensive care nurse who has spent over thirty years on malpractice and injury suits, and Melissa Lonn has devoted her practice to the same fields, drawing on a background in social work and science. The firm serves Montreal, Laval, Longueuil and Brossard.
annie-boyer-avocate-saint-jerome:
Annie Boyer practises criminal and penal defence in Saint-Jerome with the lawyers of OMB Avocats, who also serve Laval and Joliette.

Her colleagues at the firm are Carl Ouimet, Karam Mahrez, Jonathan Boivin and Félix Beauchemin. OMB Avocats defends impaired driving, drug, assault, domestic violence, sexual assault, theft, hit and run, weapons and attempted murder charges, and also handles restricted licences, vehicle seizures and the setting aside of default judgments. Its main territories are Saint-Jerome, Mirabel, Repentigny, Terrebonne, Laval and Joliette. Legal aid mandates are accepted, and emergency service is available around the clock.
ansari-immigration-law-calgary:
Ansari Immigration Law is a Calgary immigration law firm founded by lawyer Yameena Ansari, licensed in Ontario, Alberta and the Northwest Territories.

The firm works from Suite 2500 at 639 5 Avenue SW and handles Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, family sponsorship, work and study permits, refugee and humanitarian applications and citizenship by descent, with services in English, French and Urdu.
anton-m-katz-barrister-and-solicitor-nor:
Anton M Katz, Barrister and Solicitor is a North York sole practice handling business, corporate and estate matters.

Anton Katz was called to the Ontario bar in 1996 and practises as a sole practitioner from 5255 Yonge Street in North York. His work includes incorporations, professional corporations, minute books, business purchases and other commercial matters, as well as estate matters.
apna-law-llp-burnaby:
Apna Law LLP is a Burnaby firm of trial and appellate lawyers handling family, estate, personal injury and civil disputes.

The firm opened in 2018 and serves British Columbia and Alberta, and its lawyers have more than 40 years of combined experience inside and outside the courtroom. Its name is a Punjabi word loosely meaning ours, which the firm links to community and collaboration. The family law team includes James Gill, Amanda James, Hannah Gowans and Ingrid Lee, and an appeal to the Court of Appeal is not a re-hearing of the case. It also publishes articles, including one on international students and immigration consultants.
archstone-law-professional-corporation-m:
Archstone Law Professional Corporation, in Mississauga, acts in real estate, family, immigration, estates and civil litigation matters.

Areesha Raja is the principal lawyer. She articled at an estate litigation firm in downtown Toronto, worked at firms in immigration, family, civil litigation and real estate, and represented clients at a ten-day civil trial in her first year as a lawyer. The firm acts for both plaintiffs and defendants in Ontario litigation, handles residential and commercial real estate transactions and prepares wills. During law school Areesha sat on a pro bono committee, and she still serves clients who might not otherwise afford a lawyer.
arrow-law-north-york:
Arrow Law is a North York law firm handling immigration, real estate and family law matters from offices in Toronto and Hamilton.

The firm's Toronto office is on the 10th floor of 4711 Yonge Street, and its Hamilton office is on the 5th floor of 21 King Street West. Its practice covers immigration law, real estate law, family law, notary and commissioning services and independent legal advice for clients across the Greater Toronto Area, Hamilton, Durham Region and internationally.
art-of-law-professional-corporation-nort:
Art of Law Professional Corporation is a North York law firm founded by Ardeshir Tahbaz, handling family, civil litigation and estates matters.

The firm works from the 10th floor of 4711 Yonge Street and acts for clients from anywhere in Ontario in family law, civil litigation, wills and estates, real estate, and notary public and document services, with service in English and Farsi, including notary and commissioner services in Farsi.
ascent-employment-law-vancouver:
Ascent Employment Law is a Vancouver law firm founded in 2020, practising exclusively in employment, labour and human rights law.

Partners David Brown, Richard Johnson and Trevor Thomas founded the firm, which has about 14 lawyers plus paralegals and a mediator, with offices in Vancouver, Kelowna, Victoria, Vernon and Prince George. It merged with Veronica Ukrainetz's practice, established in 2007, in 2023. The firm handles wrongful and constructive dismissal, severance, workplace investigations, human rights complaints, employment contracts and settlement agreements for employees and employers across British Columbia, in English, Vietnamese and Punjabi.
avanessy-giordano-llp-north-york:
Avanessy Giordano LLP is a North York personal injury law firm established in 2015 by partners Michael Giordano and Aline Avanessy.

Avanessy was formerly in-house counsel to a major Canadian insurer, and the team includes partner Nima Azizi and senior associate Antonia Hristova, with further offices in Newmarket and Oshawa. The firm acts for plaintiffs in motor vehicle accidents, catastrophic, brain and spinal injury, slip and fall, long-term disability, accident benefits and medical malpractice claims, and also handles employment law and residential real estate, in Armenian, English, French and Italian.
aviron-law-professional-corporation-bram:
Aviron Law Professional Corporation is a Brampton law firm founded in 2018, handling real estate, immigration and wills and estates matters.
