Founded in 2018 by managing partner Belal Najmeddine, the firm works from 10185 107 Street NW and has grown to about 17 lawyers, adding partners Jessette Apao, Jessi Dhanju and Tamer S. Obeidat in 2026. Its practice also includes divorce, personal injury, commercial law and landlord and tenant matters, and lawyers serve clients in languages including Arabic, Hindi, Punjabi, Tagalog, Urdu and Yoruba.
edmonton-top-law-edmonton:
Edmonton Top Law is a litigation-focused family law firm founded in 2024, representing individuals and businesses in family, civil and commercial matters.

Majd Mouzaffar, a litigation lawyer, focuses on complex family and civil disputes. The firm says it uses negotiation and mediation where appropriate and is ready to go to court when necessary, and its listed languages are English, Arabic and French.
eidelmann-law-inc-montreal:
Eidelmann Law Inc is a bilingual boutique litigation firm in Montreal founded by Adam Eidelmann, with lawyer Micheal Romanelli on its team.

From 8000 boulevard Décarie, the firm handles litigation, business law, debt collection, labour and employment law, real estate and commercial leasing, contract law and shareholder disputes for entrepreneurs, corporate directors, property owners and individuals across Montreal, Laval and the West Island, and is licensed in Quebec and Ontario.
einfeld-law-kelowna:
Einfeld Law is a Kelowna civil litigation and personal injury firm acting in lawsuits, estate disputes and employment matters. It acts for individuals and businesses in civil lawsuits in the Okanagan and beyond, including contract disputes, insurance disputes, property disputes and matters involving municipalities.

Business litigation includes breach of contract, negligence, lease disputes, builders liens and product liability. Estate work covers contested wills, wills variation, trust litigation and executor disputes, with arbitration and mediation available, and employment work covers wrongful dismissal and severance. Injury cases arise from negligence such as slips and falls and unsafe property; the firm does not act on ICBC motor vehicle injury cases.
el-asmar-legal-edmonton:
El-Asmar Legal is an Edmonton immigration and human rights law firm led by principal and founding lawyer Jouman El-Asmar.

Jouman El-Asmar is licensed in Alberta and Quebec. The firm works from Suite 200 at 10212 127 Avenue NW and handles immigration, refugee claims and asylum, deportation defence and pre-removal risk assessments, Federal Court judicial reviews, human rights matters, family sponsorship, work and study permits, citizenship, and wills and estates for clients across Canada, in English, French and Arabic.
el-haddad-avocats:
El-Haddad, Avocats is a Laval criminal and penal defence firm led by lawyer Anthony El-Haddad, a former prosecutor.

Anthony El-Haddad leads the firm as its sole lawyer from bureau 200 at 3090 boulevard le Carrefour, defending criminal charges and penal infractions for clients across Laval, Montreal, Brossard, Longueuil and the greater Montreal area, in English, French and Arabic.
elegant-law-corporation-surrey:
Elegant Law Corporation is a Surrey law firm led by lawyer Mukesh Singla, handling immigration, real estate and business matters.

The firm works from Suite 205 at 13737 72 Avenue and handles Canadian immigration including permanent and temporary residence, citizenship and inadmissibility, real estate conveyancing, wills and estates, and corporate and business law for clients in Surrey, in English and Hindi.
elevate-law-group:
Elevate Law Group is a Guelph law firm handling wills and estates, real estate, and business and corporate matters.

Principal lawyer Ajay Sharma holds a JD from the University of New Brunswick (2017), articled at a full-service firm in Brampton, later worked on Bay Street and in-house, and earned an Osgoode Wills and Estates certificate in 2020. From 207 Woolwich Street, the firm acts for individuals, partnerships, corporations and first-time homebuyers in Guelph and surrounding regions.
eli-bloom-avocat-montreal:
ELI Bloom Avocat is a Montréal immigration law practice led by Me Ralph Elysée, a member of the Barreau du Québec.

The firm helps international students, temporary workers and families with study and work permits, permanent residence and Canadian citizenship, and Me Elysée appears before Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada, the Immigration and Refugee Board and the Federal Court of Canada. The practice works largely paperless and offers consultations by video. The office is at 4810 rue Jean-Talon Ouest.
ellis-criminal-law-professional-corporat:
Ellis Criminal Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario firm that limits its practice to criminal defence.

The firm has practised only criminal defence since 2006, after earlier work in civil litigation and education, and has appeared at all levels of court in Ontario. Laura Ellis, Ron Ellis and Stephen Troyer are the lawyers, with Kholood Ghenniwa as paralegal and office manager. Its services include cyber crime, preliminary hearings, trials, first-time offenders, young offenders, and corporate, property and driving offences. The team stresses Charter protections and is reachable around the clock, every day of the week.
england-lam-family-law-vancouver:
England Lam Family Law is a Vancouver family law firm with lawyers Louise Lam and Jessica England and a second office in Langley.

The firm advises on separation and divorce, custody, access, support and property division, cohabitation and separation agreements, and offers collaborative negotiation as well as litigation for families in Vancouver and Langley. Its second office is at 8661 201 Street, on the second floor, in Langley.
epp-law-office-brandon:
Epp Law Office is a Brandon, Manitoba law firm founded in November 2020 by Andrea Epp.

Epp, who was called to the bar in 2020, leads a two-lawyer team with associate Alex Klippenstein from the head office at 642 18th Street, Unit A, with a second office in Carberry. The firm advises on real estate, business and corporate law, estate planning, estate administration and municipal law.
ericksons-llp:
Ericksons LLP is a full-service Thunder Bay firm, active since 1986, with practice in Indigenous and First Nations law, litigation, estates and real estate.

The main offices sit near the Waterfront District, and the firm operates satellite offices in Geraldton, Manitouwadge, Marathon and Terrace Bay. Its practice also includes insurance, construction, medical malpractice, personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, environmental, employment and labour, and corporate and commercial law. Indigenous and First Nations work covers joint ventures, partnerships, charitable corporations, taxation advice for First Nations and resource development in forestry, mining and energy. Lawyers include Derek T. Noyes, Theodore L. Scollie, Evan A. Juurakko, Ryan C. Venn and Matthew Smiley.
erikson-law-firm-ottawa:
Erikson Law Firm in Ottawa handles real estate, tax and family law matters, with flat-fee billing for most of its legal services.

Valentin Erikson owns the firm. He studied at Carleton University and the University of Ottawa, clerked at the Tax Court of Canada and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2009. The practice serves clients in Ottawa and across Ontario from an office in Nepean, and also covers estate planning and same-sex legal issues. Notary services include administering oaths, certifying true copies, consent letters for children travelling abroad, passport declarations, and authenticating documents in English, French, Russian, Estonian and Lithuanian.
etude-davocats-tlr-law-office-winnipeg:
Étude d'avocats TLR Law Office is a Winnipeg law firm handling wills, estates, real estate and corporate matters.

The firm, also known as TLR Law and Estate Attorneys of Manitoba, has lawyers Cheryl Pearson, who is co-owner, Darryl Strain and Philippe Richer, who is principal. It acquired the Jack M. Rabkin Law Office in 2022 and operates three Winnipeg offices in St. Boniface, on Scurfield Boulevard and in St. James. Its work covers wills and powers of attorney, probate and estate administration, residential real estate, and corporate and business law.
evans-pollock-schofield-family-law-corpo:
Evans Pollock Schofield Family Law Corporation is a Winnipeg family firm using collaborative practice, mediation and arbitration outside court.

The firm has practised collaborative law since 2003. Its work covers prenuptial agreements, separation and divorce, adoption and assisted reproduction, and estate planning. Its guiding principles are empathy, transparency and a safe space without judgment, and it helps clients choose which resolution process suits their family. The firm's offices stand on Treaty One Territory, the traditional territory of several Indigenous peoples and the homeland of the Red River Metis.
evolution-legal-calgary:
Evolution Legal is a Calgary employment law firm that acts only for employees, founded by lawyer Stephen Dugandzic.

Dugandzic, called to the Alberta bar in 2014 with a JD from the University of Alberta, previously practised at national and regional law firms and as in-house counsel. The firm advises on wrongful and constructive dismissal, employment agreements, severance and workplace resolutions, offering flat-fee virtual consultations to employees across Alberta.
ewen-boyd-llp-barrie:
Ewen Boyd LLP is a Barrie firm that handled family, real estate, wills and estate planning and corporate law, and has announced that it is closing.

After more than eleven years of service the firm will close its doors in the near future. It no longer holds any wills or powers of attorney, which have been transferred to Ness Law in Orillia. Before the closure notice, it assisted clients across Simcoe County and Muskoka. Former clients who need a closed real estate or family file are directed to a mailing address in Barrie.
excelsior-avocats:
Excelsior Avocats is a Laval law firm of three lawyers handling family law, immigration and related civil matters.

Mélissa Charles leads the firm as president and CEO, with Pradelle Yimga handling civil and labour matters and Rebecca Polynice practising family law. Its work covers family law and immigration law for clients across the Laval area, served in French, with virtual appointments available.
fabris-mciver-and-durvin-nanaimo:
Fabris McIver & Durvin is a Nanaimo, British Columbia law firm established in 1980 at 40 Cavan Street.

Formerly known as Fabris McIver Hornquist and Radcliffe, the firm’s active lawyers are Iain McIver, Bradley Durvin and Kellen Hornquist. It handles civil litigation and dispute resolution, personal injury, employment and labour law, real estate, wills, estates and trusts, and business and corporate law for individuals, families and businesses across Vancouver Island and British Columbia, in English.
falcon-law-pc-mississauga:
Falcon Law PC is a largely virtual Canadian firm focused on business, corporate and commercial law, with immigration and real estate work.

Founder Raz Toor advises entrepreneurs and business owners on buying and selling businesses, franchise agreements and e-commerce matters. The firm also acts for buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants on commercial and residential real estate across Ontario, and it serves clients across Canada.
fallow-gould-llp-kingston:
Fallow Gould LLP is a Kingston boutique estates law firm formed by lawyers Angela Fallow and David Gould, practising together since 2010.

David Gould was called to the Ontario bar in 2004 and the Alberta bar in 2008, and Angela Fallow has practised wills and estates law since 2007. From The Woolen Mill at 4 Cataraqui Street, Unit 114, the firm handles wills, estates and trusts, estate planning and administration, probate, estate and civil litigation and powers of attorney for clients in Kingston and the Toronto–Ottawa corridor, in English.
family-lawyers-collective-llp-london:
Family Lawyers Collective LLP is a London, Ontario family law boutique with three lawyers practising exclusively in family law.

Partner Jelena Buac, Louise Mimnagh and Alice Rho practise from Suite 301 at 200 Queens Avenue, handling divorce and separation, parenting arrangements, child and spousal support, property division, domestic contracts and family mediation for families in the London area, in English.
farhat-associates-law-firm:
Farhat & Associates Law Firm is a Windsor, Ontario firm associated with Rashid Farhat, a Windsor solicitor. The firm has an office at 1 Hanna St W in Windsor.

No specific services or practice areas are recorded for the firm beyond a general areas of practice listing, so none are described here. The profile is limited to the firm's name, its city and its street address, and it will be extended when verified details of its lawyers and fields of work are available.
farjoud-law-professional-corporation-nor:
Farjoud Law Professional Corporation is a North York criminal defence practice founded by lawyer Arman Farjoud, serving clients across Ontario.

The firm, based at 4950 Yonge Street, handles drug offences, impaired driving, assault including domestic and sexual assault, fraud, forgery, identity theft, guns-and-gangs and conspiracy prosecutions, youth and driving offences, bail hearings and record suspensions, with services in English and Farsi.
fasken:
Fasken is a law firm in Toronto, Ontario, with an office at 333 Bay St, Suite 2400. No practice tags are recorded for the firm, so its fields of work are not listed.

The entry identifies the firm only by its name and Toronto address. Nothing is stated here about other offices, individual lawyers or areas of practice, and the profile will be extended once verified information on those points is available.
fasken-calgary:
Fasken operates a Calgary office at First Canadian Centre, 350 7 Avenue SW, Suite 3400, part of an international business law firm.

The firm’s full name is Fasken Martineau DuMoulin LLP, and its Calgary lawyers include Holly Barker, Clarke Barnes and Vhari Storwick. They advise on energy, oil and gas, mining, real estate, banking and finance, infrastructure, technology, Indigenous affairs and government matters for local Alberta businesses and global entities entering Canadian markets.
fazio-law-sarnia:
Fazio Law is a Sarnia firm that has handled real estate, business and estate matters since 1988 for individuals, families, charities and companies.

The practice serves Sarnia and the surrounding area, from small businesses to large corporations, and covers estate planning, real estate transactions and corporate law. Frank Fazio was admitted to the Ontario bar in 1988 and has more than 37 years in practice. He has served on boards in Sarnia-Lambton, including the YMCA, the Downtown Business Improvement Area, the Lung Association and the real estate section of the Lambton Law Association, and the aim is to explain legal dealings in everyday English.
fdg-avocats-montreal:
Business law, tax law and litigation for start-ups and established companies are the focus of FDG Avocats in Montreal.

Services include representation in audits, objections and court proceedings against tax authorities, tax strategies for individuals and businesses, and legal structuring that isolates business assets from personal wealth and guards against seizure. The firm also advises on business management and growth and helps resolve disputes between individuals or companies, whether by agreement or before the courts. Me Félix-Desbiens-Gravel is a former counsel for the Canada Revenue Agency. The office is on Route Transcanadienne Ouest in Saint-Laurent.
feld-kalia-professional-corporation-toro:
Feld Kalia Professional Corporation is a Toronto real estate law firm, with wills, estates and trusts services, led by lawyers David Feld and Sonia Kalia.

The firm is located at 171 Midland Avenue and acts for individuals and businesses buying or selling residential and commercial properties in Toronto, alongside wills, estates and trusts work. Service is offered in English.
fg-avocat-inc-repentigny:
FG Avocat is a Repentigny firm practising criminal and penal law, from impaired driving and criminal offences to pardon applications and traffic tickets.

Me François Gaudreau defends people charged in the Joliette, Repentigny and Laval areas, with service points in Joliette, Laval, Saint-Jérôme, Terrebonne, Trois-Rivières and Témiscamingue (Ville-Marie). The firm supports clients from the first steps after an arrest for impaired driving through to court appearances, and helps challenge a ticket considered unjustified. The firm works in French.
field-law:
Field Law is a full-service Edmonton law firm established in 1915, with offices in Calgary, Canmore and Yellowknife.

The Edmonton office works from Suite 2500 at 10175 101 Street NW, where partner Ayla Akgungor practises. The firm’s practice covers corporate and commercial law, insurance, litigation, estate planning, tax, real estate, technology and healthcare for businesses, institutions, governments and individuals across Western and Northern Canada.
filkow-law-kelowna:
Filkow Law is a Kelowna criminal defence and driving-offence practice founded in 2014 by senior counsel Kevin Filkow.

The firm defends impaired driving and Immediate Roadside Prohibition matters, drug and fraud offences, assault and sexual assault charges, and handles driving law generally for clients across the Okanagan and the Interior, in English, French, Mandarin, Cantonese, Punjabi and Hindi.
fine-and-associates-toronto:
Fine & Associates Professional Corporation limits its Toronto practice to family law and divorce, including parenting, support and property division. Lawyer Lorne J. Fine graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1990, was called to the bar in 1992 and has studied at Oxford. He holds certificates in negotiation, collaborative law and mediation, has mediated numerous cases and is a qualified arbitrator.

The firm seeks settlements through mediation where possible and prepares for trial when a fair resolution cannot be reached. It acts for clients across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, including Markham, Oakville and Mississauga, and Lorne has been interviewed on Global television and CHCH television about major family law issues in Ontario.
flaherty-mccarthy-llp:
Flaherty McCarthy LLP is a Markham, Ontario insurance litigation firm founded in 1994, with Toronto roots and an office at 179 Enterprise Boulevard.

The firm, renamed Flaherty Dow Elliott & McCarthy in 2000 and Flaherty McCarthy LLP in 2015, has fifteen lawyers including managing partner Frank Benedetto and partners Sean Brown, Michael Chadwick and Sophia Chaudri. It acts in motor vehicle tort, statutory accident benefits, coverage disputes, class proceedings, occupiers’ liability, personal injury, negligence, property damage and subrogated claims, and offers mediation and arbitration.
fortier-law-firm:
Fortier Law Firm is a family-run Greater Sudbury practice, in operation since 1972, covering real estate, corporate, family and wills and estates law.

The firm is a father, son and daughter team raised in Sudbury, made up of Fred, Carter and Krista Fortier. Carter Fortier advises on corporate and business law, including buying and selling businesses, over more than 25 years, and Krista Fortier handles family law including parenting time and decision-making. Real estate work covers single-family homes, cottages, multi-unit residential, recreational, vacant land and commercial property, along with mortgages from banks and private lenders. Max, the office dog, greets visitors.
forum-law-llp-edmonton:
Forum Law LLP is an Edmonton full-service law firm established in 2017, acting for individuals, families and businesses across Alberta.

The firm works from a single office at 11835 149 Street NW and handles a broad range of work, including civil litigation, corporate and commercial law, real estate, family law, wills and estates, employment, construction and franchise law, for clients in Edmonton and across the province, in English, Arabic, Punjabi, Cantonese and Mandarin.
forward-law-llp:
Forward Law LLP is a Kamloops firm handling estate planning, probate, business, employment, construction and Indigenous law.

Its areas include estate planning, commercial work, probate, business, bidding, municipal, expropriation and First Nations law, and it supports survivors of Federal Indian Hospitals. The firm's name reflects a wish to help clients move forward, whether that means starting a business, resolving a dispute or preparing a will and power of attorney. It is a friendly Kamloops firm with offices on Summit Drive.
fosters-law-llp-london:
Fosters Law LLP is a litigation firm at 150 Dufferin Avenue in London, Ontario, concentrating on personal injury and insurance claims.

The firm acts in personal injury, catastrophic injury, wrongful death, medical malpractice, product liability and insurance defence matters, and also advises on civil litigation, commercial and corporate law, criminal law and family law. Clients are served in English from the London office.
fox-mcnevin-mackay-llp-lawyers-windsor:
Fox McNevin MacKay LLP is a Windsor family law firm handling divorce, separation, property division, custody, access and support.

Its services include collaborative family law, marriage, separation and cohabitation agreements, uncontested divorce, mediation and arbitration, litigation and appeals. Tanya McNevin earned her law degree from the University of Windsor in 2010, was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2011 and spent ten years in the legal field beforehand. Thomas MacKay and Mary Fox are also part of the team. The firm develops a custom strategy with each client and uses mediation, collaborative processes and litigation.
fp-legal-calgary:
FP Legal is a full-service Calgary firm handling real estate, personal injury, civil litigation, corporate and family law. Its office is on 17 Avenue NW.

Founder Nelson Osamudiamen earned his Juris Doctor at the University of Calgary in 2013, articled at Dentons and was licensed by the Law Society of Alberta in July 2014; he has appeared before all levels of court in Alberta. Real estate work covers residential and commercial transactions, corporate clients receive contract drafting and negotiation support, and family law includes agreements for couples entering, living in or ending a relationship.
fraese-aymont-family-lawyers-calgary-cal:
Fraese Aymont Family Lawyers Calgary is the Calgary office of Fraese Aymont LLP, a family law boutique established in 2014.

Partners Heather Fraese and Brandi Aymont lead the firm, which works from Suite 2600 at 605 5 Avenue SW with an office in Vancouver. It practises family law only, including separation and divorce, parenting and child custody, spousal and child support, property division, pre- and post-nuptial agreements, adoption, adult guardianship, mediation and arbitration, in English and French.
freedom-family-law:
Freedom Family Law is a Victoria practice focused on prenuptial, cohabitation, postnuptial, common-law and separation agreements.

The firm's entire practice is family agreements, and it does not litigate, reasoning that most family disputes are preventable and most often settled by agreement. It is remote-first and serves clients across British Columbia. Mathais Sarrazin is the barrister and solicitor and Zoe the designated paralegal. Agreements let couples set their own terms instead of relying on the default rules of the Family Law Act.
frenkel-tobin-llp-toronto:
Frenkel Tobin LLP is a Toronto family law firm led by David Frenkel and David Tobin, handling parenting, support and property matters.

David Frenkel was called to the Ontario bar in 2010 and David Tobin in 2014, and lawyers Angela Huang, Jordan Shanlin and Iris Wilkinson practise with them from Suite 1001 at 317 Adelaide Street West. The firm practises family and divorce law only, including parenting and decision-making, child and spousal support, property division, and pre- and post-relationship agreements, for mothers, fathers and grandparents across Ontario. The two partners also edit Ontario Family Law Monthly.
fridman-co-immigration-law-office-winnip:
Fridman & Co. Immigration Law Office is a Winnipeg immigration and citizenship law firm led by lawyer and notary public Carolina Fridman.

Carolina Fridman has led the firm since 2014, and it works from Suite 201 at 83 Garry Street. Its practice is limited to Canadian immigration and citizenship law, including permanent and temporary residence, study and work permits, provincial nominee programs, family sponsorship, business immigration, appeals of refused applications, inadmissibility, judicial reviews and criminal rehabilitation, acting for individuals, families and businesses.
frouhar-law-ottawa:
Frouhar Law is an Ottawa criminal defence firm founded by lawyer Mash Frouhar, called to the Ontario bar in 2009.

Mash Frouhar previously worked as an Assistant Crown Attorney and as defence counsel, and senior counsel Connie D’Angelo, called in 1993, practises with the firm from Suite 700 at 190 O’Connor Street. The firm handles homicide, sexual assault, drug offences, human trafficking, impaired driving, domestic violence, theft and robbery, bail hearings, appeals, Charter applications and notary services for clients in Ottawa and Eastern Ontario.
gad-pariente-montreal:
Gad Pariente Avocat Inc. is a Montreal immigration law firm led by sole practitioner Gad Pariente, a member of the Barreau du Québec since 2006.

The firm handles spousal and family sponsorship, Express Entry, Quebec immigration programs, work permits, citizenship, permanent residence, appeals before the Immigration and Refugee Board, refusals and inadmissibility. It works remotely for clients across Canada, with in-person meetings at 83 Rue Saint-Paul Ouest in Montreal by appointment, and serves foreign nationals, international students, skilled workers, families and businesses in English, French and Spanish.
gagan-law-pc-mississauga:
Gagan Law Professional Corporation is a Streetsville, Mississauga law firm led by principal lawyer Gagan Dadiala.

The three-lawyer firm works from a single office at 8 Water Street, with Shawn Dadiala and Aelia Merchant practising alongside the principal. Its work covers residential and commercial real estate, business and corporate law, wills and estates, immigration law and notary services for clients across Peel Region and the Greater Toronto Area, in English, Hindi, Punjabi, Arabic and Urdu.
gagan-nahal-criminal-lawyer:
Gagan Nahal Criminal Lawyer is a Surrey criminal defence practice acting in impaired driving, drug, assault, fraud and bail matters.

Gagan Nahal practises on his own, having articled with an established British Columbia criminal defence lawyer and opened his own practice immediately after being called to the bar. The practice is limited to criminal defence, including DUI and impaired driving, drug offences, assault and violent crime, theft, fraud, break and enter, and bail hearings, and serves clients across British Columbia and in Alberta, Manitoba and Ontario, including non-Canadian citizens, in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
gagnon-avocats:
Gagnon Avocats is a Chicoutimi, Quebec general practice law firm at 393 Rue Racine Est, also known as Gagnon et Associés and Gagnon Minier Avocats.

Its lawyers include Eric Gagnon, Adam Minier, Fanny Boutin, Dominic Riverin and Jean-Claude Basque, and the practice covers administrative law, labour law, civil litigation, Quebec civil law, construction law, family law, commercial law, criminal law and environmental law for clients in the Saguenay region.
gagnon-tasse-gagnon-avocats:
Gagnon & Tassé-Gagnon Avocats is a Saint-Jerome firm handling criminal law, penal law and young offender cases since 1990.

The firm has been rooted in Saint-Jerome from the start and takes clients, individuals or companies, through the criminal and penal system from arrest to trial. It acts in the judicial districts of Terrebonne (Saint-Jérôme), Laval, Labelle (Mont-Laurier), Joliette and Montréal. Examples of matters handled include impaired driving, assault causing injury in domestic violence cases, seizure of firearms, unlawful presence in a dwelling and road safety code tickets.
galbraith-law-edmonton:
Galbraith Law is a northwest Edmonton law firm founded in December 1987, handling real estate, wills and small business matters.

Lawyer Stan Galbraith leads the practice, which began as a one-person operation in the Westmount Shopping Centre and works from 10630 178 Street NW. Its practice covers real estate, wills and estates and small business law for individuals and businesses across Edmonton.
gale-law-professional-corporation-toront:
Gale Law Professional Corporation is a Toronto estate litigation and elder law firm founded in 2019 by lawyer Kim Gale.

Gale was called to the Ontario bar in January 2018 and opened the firm in January 2019. The practice handles will challenges, power of attorney disputes, capacity claims, estate administration problems, financial abuse of older adults and probate matters, and offers estate mediation through Gale Mediation. The two-lawyer firm serves clients in Toronto.
galileo-partners-montreal:
For employers with Canadian, Quebec and American immigration needs, Galileo Partners is a Montreal business immigration firm.

The firm acts for domestic and international companies through a bilingual, turnkey service that manages complete immigration files, with the aim of lightening the load on human resources and legal teams. It handles more than 2,500 files a year for over 1,000 companies, with more than 15 lawyers working in immigration law. A blog follows Quebec, Canada and US immigration developments, including work permits expiring in 2026. Its office is on Avenue Union.
gardiner-roberts-llp:
Gardiner Roberts LLP is a full-service Toronto law firm founded in the 1920s, advising businesses on corporate, real estate and litigation matters.

Its practice covers business and corporate commercial law, commercial real estate and municipal law, financial services, securities and corporate finance, litigation and dispute resolution, employment, insurance, tax litigation and immigration. Clients include banks, municipalities, government entities, entrepreneurs, technology and growth companies, developers, lenders and investors.
garson-immigration-law-north-york:
Garson Immigration Law is a North York law firm practising immigration law exclusively, founded by managing partner David Garson.

Lawyers Jessica Ravenhurst and Eric Chang practise alongside David Garson at 4950 Yonge Street, Suite 302. The firm handles temporary entry for workers, visitors and students, super visas, permanent residence, Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, family sponsorship, the Start-Up Visa, citizenship, LMIA and work permits, employer compliance, inadmissibility and U.S. visas, for multinational corporations and professionals in technology, engineering, entertainment, sports, mining and financial services.
gauthier-and-mines-criminal-lawyers-vanc:
Gauthier & Mines Criminal Lawyers is a Vancouver criminal defence firm founded in 1993 and formerly known as Mines & Company.

Lawyers Ian Gauthier and Michael Mines practise from Suite 1550 in the Marine Building at 355 Burrard Street. The firm defends assault, theft, drug and driving charges and handles administrative and regulatory matters, civil asset forfeiture, professional discipline and Motor Vehicle Act matters for clients across Metro Vancouver, British Columbia and the Yukon.
gauthier-avocats-brossard:
Gauthier Avocats is a Brossard family law firm handling divorce, separation and child custody matters for spouses and parents in the Montreal area.

The firm has practised family law since 2009 and serves clients in Brossard, Longueuil, Montreal, Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu and Saint-Hyacinthe. Its approach rests on long experience in family matters and close attention to each client. The office is on Boulevard Lapinière in Brossard, and legal aid mandates are not accepted.
gauthier-bedard:
Gauthier Bedard is a Saguenay law firm, founded in 1932 and based in Chicoutimi, whose listed practice area is employment law.

Its themes include notarial law, mediation and psychosocial risk management, and its lawyers look for strategic solutions in a competitive setting. The firm helped apply the Labour Code provisions on maintaining services for the population, acting for the CPE Le Jardin de Robi in Roberval during a general strike that began on 22 October 2025. The Tribunal administratif du travail ordered minimum child care services in two decisions of March 2026, with Me Sylvain Bouchard directing the employer's representation.
gauthier-tousignant-avocats-inc:
Gauthier & Tousignant Avocats Inc. is a Saint-Jérôme criminal defence firm acting for people charged with criminal offences.

Pierre M. Gauthier, Meghann Tousignant and Félix Bergeron are the firm's lawyers, working from 35 rue de la Gare, Suite 201. The firm defends sexual offences, driving-related offences, drug charges, theft and fraud and assault, acting for clients between Joliette and Gatineau and in Ontario, in English and French.
gbv-avocats-quebec-city:
GBV Avocats is a Québec City law firm in Sainte-Foy at Place Iberville III, 2960 Boulevard Laurier, Suite 500.

From its Sainte-Foy office, the firm advises businesses, financial institutions and organizations on commercial and civil litigation, business and corporate law including mergers, acquisitions and commercial contracts, construction law, labour and employment, and insurance law, in French and English.
gelman-and-associates:
Gelman & Associates is a North York family law firm acting in divorce, separation, parenting and child protection matters across Ontario.

The firm was founded by Lisa Gelman, who has practised family law since 1995, and Karen Kotansky, who runs operations. Its roughly 19 lawyers include Paul D. Slan, who has practised since 1977 and is a past chair of the Ontario Bar Association family law section. It has offices across Ontario and handles divorce, collaborative law and mediation, high-conflict separations, inheritance disputes on separation, wills and estate planning, in English, French, Bengali, Hindi, Malayalam, Punjabi, Romanian and Urdu, and accepts legal aid certificates.
george-lee-law-corp-burnaby:
George Lee Law Corp is a Burnaby general practice law firm in Metrotown, led by sole lawyer George Lee.

The firm has served clients in Burnaby and Vancouver for more than 25 years from Suite 608 at 4538 Kingsway. Its practice covers family law, civil litigation, immigration, criminal defence, wills and estates, notarization, conveyancing and business incorporation, with services in English, Cantonese and Mandarin.
george-murray-shipley-bell-llp:
George Murray Shipley Bell LLP is a full-service Sarnia law firm with nine lawyers.

Lawyers Robert Murray, Wayne Shipley, D’Arcy Bell and James Kohlmeier practise with the firm, which handles general practice matters, family law, real estate, wills and estates, estate planning, incorporation of companies, business law and municipal law for individuals, families and businesses in Sarnia.
georgia-pappis-montreal:
Montreal immigration lawyer Georgia Pappis handles Express Entry, family sponsorship, work and study permits and citizenship applications.

She has been a barrister and solicitor since 2004, is a member of the Quebec Bar and belongs to the Association of Quebec Immigration Lawyers (AQAADI). Her practice has been exclusively immigration law for more than 20 years. Matters include Quebec Skilled Workers, the Quebec Experience Program (PEQ), visitor visas, permanent resident card renewals, humanitarian and compassionate applications, criminal rehabilitation and record suspensions, along with advice on criminal matters that can affect immigration status. She works in English, French and Greek from an office on Boulevard Alexis-Nihon in Saint-Laurent.
gerami-law-pc-ottawa:
Gerami Law PC is an Ottawa immigration law firm practising since 2011, with remote Toronto and Vancouver offices.

The firm works from 130 Albert Street and handles Canadian immigration, refugee and citizenship matters, including permanent residency, visitor and spousal visas and refugee claims, for individuals and families. Its practice also extends to litigation and administrative law.
gerry-law-thunder-bay:
Gerry Law is a Thunder Bay personal injury law firm representing injured people and survivors of sexual assault and abuse across Ontario.

Founded by principal lawyer Natalie Gerry, who holds a JD from the Lakehead University Bora Laskin Faculty of Law and previously practised personal injury litigation at Ericksons LLP in Thunder Bay, the firm operates from Suite 301 at 34 Cumberland Street North. It handles motor vehicle, slip and fall, cyclist and pedestrian, ATV and snowmobile and defective product claims, and meets clients in person, by phone or by Zoom.
gertsoyg-and-company-burnaby:
Gertsoyg and Company is a Burnaby firm handling family law, estate litigation, disability benefit denials, personal injury and wrongful dismissal. It also acts in human rights and commercial litigation matters and has locations in Vancouver, North Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Langley and Kelowna.

Clients are served by an experienced lawyer supported by five law assistants, all with university education. Disability work covers appeals of denied benefits and other insurance disputes, while personal injury work includes cases against ICBC, and family work extends to estate litigation.
ggfi-law-llp-kitchener:
GGFI Law LLP is a Kitchener law firm founded in 1981 by Ted Giesbrecht, with offices in Kitchener, New Hamburg and Waterdown.

The firm has about 19 lawyers and 40 staff, including partners Karin Maiterth in estate administration, Mark Radulescu in litigation, Warren Griffin, Stephen Funk and Robert Lanteigne, and has absorbed several practices since 2016. Its Kitchener office is at 515 Riverbend Drive. Services cover family law including collaborative practice and adoptions, real estate, wills, estates and trusts, corporate and business law, civil litigation, charity and not-for-profit law, construction liens, and immigration and refugee law, in English, Vietnamese, German and Spanish.
ghabryal-law-professional-corporation-to:
Ghabryal Law is a Toronto firm whose lawyer studied law in the United States before returning to practise in Canada.

The practice includes immigration matters such as work permits, study permits, permanent residence and citizenship, along with partnership and shareholder agreements, commercial leases, marriage contracts and spousal support. The lawyer is a member of the Canadian Bar Association and the Law Society of Upper Canada.
ghasemi-law-professional-corporation-ric:
Ghasemi Law Professional Corporation is a Richmond Hill law firm led by Sara Ghasemi, handling immigration, real estate and estates matters.

Sara Ghasemi is the founder and director and a member of the Law Society of Ontario, and worked at two major banks in Toronto and Vancouver before practising law. The firm handles immigration and refugee claims, family sponsorship, Express Entry, work and study permits, judicial review, residential real estate, wills and estates and traffic tickets for individuals and families across the Greater Toronto Area, in English and Farsi.
giardino-law-edmonton:
Giardino Law is an Edmonton firm that handles real estate purchases, sales, refinancing and title transfers.

It acts for home buyers and sellers, realtors and mortgage lenders, and each file moves through four stages: intake, preparation, a signing meeting, and closing and keys. Remote signing is available, and the firm also offers wills and personal injury services. It has worked in real estate law for 20 years and publishes flat fees for buying, selling and refinancing. The office is at 10113 104 Street NW, Suite 218.
gibson-meardi-barristers-and-solicitors-:
Gibson Meardi Barristers & Solicitors is an Edmonton, Alberta law firm with offices in Edmonton and Whitecourt.

Lawyers Damien Meardi, who founded the practice, and Dereck Gibson advise on family law, real estate, wills, estates and trusts, corporate and business law, and litigation. The Edmonton head office is on Jasper Avenue, and a second office at 4907 52 Avenue serves Whitecourt.
ginakes-law-office-winnipeg:
Ginakes Law Office is a Winnipeg general practice law firm at 1850 Main Street, led by lawyer Peter Ginakes.

Ginakes was called to the Manitoba bar in 1995, and Peggy Damianakos, called in 1998, is also registered at the firm. It provides legal services to individuals and businesses, locally and nationally, including house purchases, real estate, wills, estates, probate, business law and legal document assistance, in English, Ukrainian and Russian.
ginzburg-legal-montreal:
Ginzburg Legal is a Montreal criminal defence firm handling DUI, violent, drug, cybercrime, theft and weapons charges.

From an office on Saint-François-Xavier in Old Montreal, the firm defends charges ranging from sexual assault and fraud to impaired driving and drug offences. Its method is to assess the situation, study the evidence and case law, negotiate, and argue the case, with a discharge or acquittal as the goal. Practice areas include driving, violent, drug, cybercrime, property and weapons offences, and the firm publishes articles on topics such as judge-shopping and impaired driving.
girard-avocats-inc:
Girard Avocats Inc is a Sherbrooke law firm founded by lawyer Annie-Elizabeth Girard, with a second office in Granby.

Annie-Elizabeth Girard, called to the Barreau du Québec in 1998, leads the firm from bureau 250 at 1358 rue King Ouest. The firm handles family law, civil litigation, construction law, and wills and estates for individuals, families and businesses in Sherbrooke, Magog, Granby and the Eastern Townships, in English and French.
glass-gavel-professional-corporation-bar:
Criminal charges, bail and driving offences are the focus of Glass Gavel Professional Corporation, a Barrie paralegal firm. It is owned and operated by Larissa Kushwara, a licensed paralegal and Notary Public in Ontario, and acts for people charged with criminal offences who do not qualify for Legal Aid, with flat fees and payment plans.

Areas include assault, breach of court order, break and enter, cannabis and drug offences, currency and financial offences, environmental offences and firearm offences. Ms. Kushwara grew up in Blind River, Ontario, has represented clients in courtrooms across the province, and started the firm to make legal services more accessible in Northern Ontario.
gluckstein-lawyers:
Gluckstein Lawyers is a Toronto personal injury law firm founded in 1962, acting for accident and medical malpractice victims across Ontario.

Litigator Bernard Gluckstein founded the firm, which is led by managing partner Charles E. Gluckstein from the Atrium on Bay at 595 Bay Street. Its practice covers personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, medical malpractice, birth injury, catastrophic brain and spinal injury, sexual abuse litigation, class actions and wrongful death, with service available in English, French, Mandarin, Cantonese, Farsi, Portuguese, Spanish, Hindi and Punjabi.
go-law-vancouver:
Go Law is a Vancouver firm handling real estate, business and estate planning matters, including probate. Nick Go founded the firm after completing his Juris Doctor at the University of British Columbia in 2015 and practising with senior lawyer Dick W. Eng and at Bell Alliance LLP.

Real estate work covers residential and commercial purchases and sales, private lending, refinancing, commercial leases and Land Title Office filings such as subdivisions, stratifications and easements. Designated paralegal Teng Fong has more than 15 years of experience with conveyancing, corporate and estate files and serves clients in Cantonese and Mandarin.
gobeil-lapierre:
Gobeil & Lapierre is a Levis family law office, operating under the name Gobeil Avocats, that offers mediation, divorce and separation work.

The office has served Lévis since 1980. Its family law matters include divorce, separation, child custody, division of property and child support, together with family mediation, youth law and civil law. The firm's approach is human, rigorous and strategic, and in mediation an impartial mediator helps parents reach an agreement.
godinho-zager-kraska-llp-mississauga:
Former criminal prosecutors make up the partnership at Godinho Zager Kraska LLP, a Mississauga criminal defence firm. Partners Mike Godinho, Reyam Zager and Robert Kraska bring more than 20 years of experience as criminal prosecutors and now defend people charged with offences ranging from murder, impaired driving causing death, armed robbery, drug trafficking and home invasion to petty theft and minor assault.

The firm acts at every stage of the criminal justice system, from bail through trial, and in quasi-criminal and regulatory matters. Services cover assault, criminal harassment, uttering threats, sexual assault, DUI and other driving offences, property crimes, fraud, firearms and drug offences, as well as record suspensions and pardons.
godwit-law-office-brampton:
Godwit Law Office is a Brampton law firm focused on Canadian immigration, with family law, residential real estate and notary services alongside.

The firm was founded by principal lawyer Andrew Mattu, who has practised since 2018, and works from 1A Conestoga Drive, Suite 300. Its immigration work covers Express Entry, permanent residence, spousal and parental sponsorship, work and study permits, visitor visas, citizenship, LMIA applications, refugee claims and appeals, and Federal Court judicial review. Service is offered in English, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu to students, newcomers, sponsors, families and businesses in the Greater Toronto Area and overseas.
gogna-immigration-inc-edmonton:
Gogna Immigration Inc. is an Edmonton immigration consultancy, with a team of regulated consultants led by owner Neha Gogna.

The practice is a licensed immigration consultancy rather than a law firm, and Gogna is also a Commissioner for Oaths. From its office at 17415 105 Avenue NW, the team handles work permits, permanent residence and Express Entry, family and spousal sponsorship, parent and grandparent sponsorship, super visas, provincial nominee programs, citizenship, LMIA applications, humanitarian and compassionate applications, study permits and visitor visas for individuals, families and employers within Canada and abroad.
gold-family-law-brampton:
Gold Family Law is a Brampton family law firm led by principal lawyer Jennifer Gold, with a second office in Port Credit, Mississauga.

The Brampton head office is at 21 Queen Street East, Suite 300, and the firm's roughly 13 lawyers practise family law only, covering divorce and separation, child protection matters, mediation, collaborative law, arbitration and domestic contracts, along with related wills and powers of attorney. The firm was previously known as Wood Gold LLP and serves Peel Region families in English, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Urdu.
gold-law-north-york:
Gold Law is a criminal defence and civil litigation firm whose founder has practised exclusively in criminal law for over a decade.

Before founding the firm, the lawyer was a partner at a Toronto boutique criminal law firm. The site lists clients charged with offences including assault, sexual assault, murder and attempted murder, drug trafficking, firearm offences, and impaired and dangerous driving.
goldengate-barristers-and-solicitors-pro:
GoldenGate Barristers and Solicitors Professional Corporation is a full-service law firm on Queen Street in downtown Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Located at 4786 Queen Street, Unit 202, the firm advises on residential and commercial real estate, family law and divorce, immigration (work permits, family sponsorship, refugee claims and citizenship), criminal defence, and wills and estates, and it also provides notary public services. It serves individuals, families, newcomers and business owners in Niagara Falls, St. Catharines, Welland and Thorold in English, Urdu, Hindi and Punjabi.
goldman-associates:
Goldman Associates is a Vancouver immigration law firm handling provincial nominee, sponsorship and humanitarian applications.

The firm is managed by Ian Goldman, who has more than 30 years in Canadian immigration law, and it is a law firm rather than an immigration consultancy. Services include spousal and common-law partner sponsorship, entrepreneur applications, compliance inspections for employers, and rehabilitation for criminal inadmissibility. The firm also covers work permits, student permits, permanent residence, citizenship and settlement services, and prepares clients for interviews and border entry.
goldman-sloan-nash-and-haber-llp:
Goldman Sloan Nash & Haber LLP is a mid-sized downtown Toronto firm handling corporate and commercial law, banking and finance, real estate and arbitration.

The firm has helped businesses, entrepreneurs and individuals for more than 40 years and advises across all major practice areas, including litigation and alternative dispute resolution. Its aim is to combine the personal service of a boutique with the sophistication of a larger firm. Pooneh Sooresrafil and Jana Smith are recent additions as lawyers, and another lawyer was quoted in a Lexpert special edition on infrastructure. The firm also issues a newsletter with bulletins and updates.
goldwyn-law-professional-corporation-mar:
Goldwyn Law is a Markham firm handling real estate, corporate and commercial, secured lending, wills and estates, and mortgage enforcement.

Its work includes residential and commercial real estate closings, incorporations and start-up planning, financial services and secured lending transactions, and estate planning. It also addresses mortgage defaults from both the borrower and the lender side. Notary services for affidavits and statutory declarations are available, in person or virtually. The firm acts across Ontario, and its mission is to be a friendly and practical presence for first-time homebuyers, investors and entrepreneurs.
goodfellow-and-schuettlaw-calgary:
Goodfellow & Schuettlaw is a full-service law firm with offices in Calgary and Edmonton, Alberta, practising in construction and real estate law.

The firm’s lawyers, including Donald Goodfellow, counsel Kent Hehr and Lydia Lytwyn, advise on construction, development and real estate law, corporate and commercial matters, condominium law, private lending and debt recovery, civil litigation, employment and labour, and wills, estates and trusts.
goodfellow-and-schuettlaw-edmonton:
Goodfellow & Schuettlaw is a law firm with offices in Edmonton and Calgary that concentrates on construction, development and real estate law.

Its work covers construction law, corporate and commercial law, real estate law and condominium law, including development projects such as financing and permitting. The firm acts for start-ups, growing businesses and large corporations, and has also acted in other provinces and territories. The Edmonton office is at 11150 Jasper Avenue, Suite 375.
gooselaw-immigration-law-firm-mississaug:
GOOSELAW Immigration Law Firm is a Mississauga immigration law firm founded in 2020 by Donovan Francis.

Francis is a member of the Law Society of Ontario with a JD from Osgoode Hall and previously worked in the Toronto office of an international immigration law firm, and senior associate Temitayo Osinbajo practises alongside. The firm has a satellite office in London, Ontario, operates as a virtual practice, and handles business immigration, citizenship, Express Entry, family sponsorship, appeals, refugee law and study and work permits for technology and engineering employers, individuals and families.
gosal-and-company-surrey:
Gosal & Company is a Surrey law firm acting for injured workers in WorkSafeBC claims and for claimants in CPP disability appeals.

Sarj Gosal is president and managing partner and has practised in WorkSafeBC matters since 1993, and Michelle Bissenden is also a lawyer with the firm. From its office at 9639 137A Street, Suite 304, the firm acts in workers' compensation claims and appeals and in Canada Pension Plan disability applications and appeals for clients across British Columbia, including Vancouver, Surrey and Burnaby.
gowling-wlg-canada-llp:
Gowling WLG (Canada) LLP is a sector-focused, full-service law firm in Toronto that is part of an international group.

Its Canadian team numbers more than 700 legal professionals in seven cities, within a worldwide group of over 1,500. Services include advertising and product regulatory, banking and finance, competition and antitrust, construction, corporate and M&A, data protection and cyber security, employment and labour, ESG, and restructuring and insolvency. The firm holds that legal matters are people matters, and Gowling WLG International Limited, an English company, coordinates its members, which operate as independent entities.
gowling-wlg-canada-llp-calgary:
Gowling WLG (Canada) LLP is a national full-service law firm with a Calgary office at Suite 1600, 421 7th Avenue SW.

The Calgary office advises on administrative and public law, banking litigation, securities, corporate finance and mergers and acquisitions, among other practice areas, and its lawyers include partners George Wilson and John Ramsay. Services are available in English and French.
gray-criminal-defence-toronto:
Gray Criminal Defence is a Toronto criminal defence firm founded and led by lawyer George Gray, called to the Ontario bar in 2009.

George Gray previously worked as a criminal litigator at a national law firm and now practises from the 3rd floor at 65 Front Street East. The firm defends charges including assault, domestic violence, sexual offences, drug offences, impaired driving, theft, fraud, and firearms and violent allegations.
grayer-law-office-family-lawyer-vancouve:
Grayer Law Office is a small family law firm on Commercial Drive in East Vancouver, British Columbia.

Lawyer Patrick Grayer is a collaborative lawyer and accredited family mediator who advises on separation, divorce, parenting and child matters, property division, child and spousal support, and wills and estates, and who offers unbundled legal services. The firm serves families in East Vancouver in English.
great-lakes-law:
Great Lakes Law is a Sarnia firm handling residential and commercial real estate, mortgages, wills, powers of attorney and trusts. It serves individuals and businesses, with Chelsea Cooper as principal lawyer and Sarah Craig as associate lawyer.

The real estate side covers first-home purchases, refinancing, home-improvement financing, investment property, commercial leasing, multi-unit residential projects and municipal applications, and residential purchases and sales are a core part of the firm's work. A team of real estate and mortgage staff and an office management team support the lawyers at 236 Napier Street.
grechi-carter-professional-corporation-t:
Grechi Carter Professional Corporation is a boutique Midtown Toronto firm handling real estate, private mortgages and mortgage enforcement. It acts on the purchase, sale and refinancing of condominiums, houses, cottages and commercial or industrial property, and for private mortgage lenders in Ontario, closing hundreds of private mortgages per year.

The firm has also acted for both borrowers and lenders in contested and uncontested mortgage enforcement actions. Its office is at 1 Eglinton Avenue East, Suite 803, in Toronto.
green-and-spiegel-llp-toronto:
Green and Spiegel LLP is a Toronto immigration-only law firm acting for employers, investors, families and individuals in Canada and the United States.

Founded in 1962 by Mendel Green, the firm practises immigration law exclusively and is led in Canada by managing partners Stephen W. Green and Evan J. Green from its office at 150 York Street. Its Canadian work spans employer and work permit programs, investor and Start-up Visa applications, permanent residence, sponsorship, citizenship, refusals, appeals and Federal Court matters, while its U.S. practice operates from Philadelphia and other American offices. Lawyers and staff work in many languages, including French, Spanish, Russian, Hebrew, Farsi and Italian.
greg-monforton-partners:
Greg Monforton & Partners is a Windsor personal injury law firm founded in 1981, acting for accident victims and their families.

Greg Monforton and Brad Robitaille founded the firm, and its six lawyers include partners Jennifer Bezaire and Dina Mejalli and associates Joanna Sweet and Melissa Novis, working from a single Windsor office. The practice covers car, truck and motorcycle accidents, medical malpractice, slip and fall, brain and spinal injury, product liability, class actions, long-term disability, insurance claims, dog bites and wrongful death across Windsor-Essex.
gregg-alfonso-law-corporation:
Gregg Alfonso Law Corporation is a downtown Kelowna law firm led by lawyer Gregg Alfonso, handling real estate and estates matters.

Gregg Alfonso, called to the British Columbia bar in 1992, practises from Suite 201 at 1180 Sunset Drive and handles real estate, wills, estates and trusts, business and corporate law, and civil and commercial litigation for residential and commercial real estate parties, realtors, mortgage brokers, estates and business clients in the Okanagan.
grenier-law-notary-public:
Grenier Law is an Ottawa firm led by Monick Grenier that handles criminal defence and civil litigation, with notary services.

Monick Grenier was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2012 after more than 20 years working in civil litigation, including in plaintiff personal injury and insurance defence firms and seven years as a land claims researcher. She has appeared before the Superior Court of Justice, argued appeals in the Divisional Court, and acted in Small Claims Court and before immigration, labour, human rights and landlord and tenant tribunals. The firm offers full representation and limited scope retainers, plus notary services such as apostille authentication, certified copies and affidavits.
grewal-law-firm-ottawa:
Grewal Law Firm is an Ottawa-area solo family law practice founded in 2021 by lawyer Manraj Grewal, who has practised law since 2019.

The Kanata practice handles separation and divorce, parenting arrangements and decision-making authority, child and spousal support, property division, child protection, cohabitation, marriage and prenuptial agreements, and mediation for clients in Ottawa, Lanark County and eastern Ontario.
grover-law-firm-calgary:
Grover Law Firm is a Calgary personal injury firm representing people hurt in car, motorcycle, trucking and pedestrian collisions.

Founded in 2003 by trial lawyer Steve Grover, the firm works from the Sovereign Centre on Macleod Trail SE, with further offices in Yellowknife and Whitehorse. Its practice includes traumatic brain and spinal cord injury, slip and fall, dog bites, wrongful death and cross-border accident claims, and it acts for clients across Alberta and the territories, with service available in a range of languages.
gss-law-firm-edmonton:
GSS Law Firm is an Edmonton general practice handling real estate, family, criminal, civil, immigration and personal injury matters.

The principal founder is a general practitioner who has advised clients on legal and non-legal issues and represented them in Provincial Court and the Court of Queen's Bench. The firm also offers notary services.
guberman-appleby-immigration-lawyers-tor:
Guberman Appleby Immigration Lawyers is a Toronto immigration boutique practising Canadian and U.S. immigration law.

Co-founders Joel Guberman and Lainie Appleby practise with U.S.-licensed attorney Ginger Devaney at 287 Macpherson Avenue, handling Express Entry, family sponsorship, work permits and LMIA, inadmissibility waivers, corporate mobility, permanent residence and citizenship for corporations, technology start-ups and private individuals, in English, Cantonese, Italian, Mandarin and Spanish.
gunn-law-group-edmonton:
Gunn Law Group is an Edmonton law firm founded in 1972 by Peter Bruce Gunn, handling criminal defence, family and administrative law.

Shannon Gunn Emery leads the firm today, working with lawyers Adam Klassen, Barbara Dowker, Brendan Thompson, Justine Fallu and Kyle Procee from a single office at 11210 142 Street NW. Its practice covers criminal defence including impaired driving, collaborative and litigated family law, administrative law, wills, personal directives and powers of attorney.
gupta-law-firm:
Gupta Law Firm Professional Corporation is a Brampton law firm founded in 2015 by Sanjeev Gupta, handling personal injury, family and real estate matters.

From its office at 2250 Bovaird Drive East, the firm acts on car, motorcycle, truck, bus and bicycle accident claims, family law and divorce, immigration, residential real estate, wills and estates, and affidavit and notary services. It serves Brampton and neighbouring communities in English, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu.
gurna-law-corporation-surrey:
Gurna Law Corporation is a Surrey immigration law firm led by barrister and solicitor Saravpreet Singh Gurna.

The firm works from Suite 208 at 8028 128 Street and acts for individuals and families across the Lower Mainland, including Vancouver, Abbotsford, Burnaby, Coquitlam, Langley and Richmond. Its practice covers immigration and refugee law, immigration appeals, deportation and removal, family sponsorship, Express Entry, work and study permits, citizenship, Federal Court judicial reviews and notary services, in English, Hindi and Punjabi.
gurpreet-ghag-law-group-vancouver:
Gurpreet Ghag Law Group is a boutique Vancouver firm centred on real estate law, with family and criminal law also among its areas.

Its real estate work includes buying and selling transactions, drafting purchase and sale agreements, title searches, and representation of buyers and sellers in residential and commercial deals. Other services include landlord and tenant matters such as leases and eviction proceedings, property development and finance, real estate investment, litigation and dispute resolution, planning and zoning, and notarial service. The firm's office is on Fraser Street in Vancouver, British Columbia.
h-and-h-law-group-mississauga:
H&H Law Group is a Mississauga firm covering family law, corporate law, real estate, wills and estates, and immigration for clients across Ontario.

Its offices are on Cawthra Road and at Village Centre Place in Mississauga, with a third in Oakville, and it serves Peel, Halton and the wider Greater Toronto Area, plus other clients by video. Family, business and property problems overlap, so one team handles them together. Lawyers offer service in English, Pashto, Urdu, Punjabi and Hindi. The firm provides clients with a written plan from the first meeting, and its real estate commentary examines title problems, closing costs, condominium status certificates and hidden defects.
habib-and-associates-law-office:
Habib & Associates Law Office is an Ottawa firm handling residential and commercial real estate, wills and estates, business law and family law.

The firm has more than 35 years of experience. Its real estate services include home purchases and sales, newly constructed homes, refinancing, land transfer tax and title insurance, and it acts on commercial purchases and sales as well. It also handles wills and powers of attorney. Clients receive a written statement of anticipated fees and expenses at the start of a retainer. Mark K. Habib, a McGill University graduate, is the barrister and solicitor.
hammer-injury-law-edmonton:
Hammer Injury Law is an Edmonton personal injury law firm founded in 2023 by lawyer Richard Mallett, with an additional office in Yellowknife.

Richard Mallett has practised since 1990 and has handled injury claims exclusively since 1999. The firm works from Suite 355 at 11150 Jasper Avenue and handles motor vehicle accidents, brain and spinal cord trauma, fatal accidents, orthopedic injuries and class actions for claimants in Alberta, the Northwest Territories, the Yukon and British Columbia, in English, French, Tagalog, Ilocano and Cantonese.
hammerco-lawyers-llp-vancouver:
Hammerco Lawyers LLP is a Vancouver firm handling class actions, commercial litigation, estate litigation, personal injury and medical negligence.

The firm has served individuals and businesses for over twenty-five years in British Columbia and now in Ontario, with offices on Vancouver Island, in Vancouver and in London, Ontario. It also acts in civil sexual assault cases and publishes a guide for survivors of sexual assault. Lawyers include Morgyn Chandler, Douglas Chiu, Dale McGregor, Kevin McLaren, Krista Simon, Alexia Majidi and Sabrina Lombardi, and service is available in Mandarin and Cantonese among other languages.
handa-law-professional-corporation-bramp:
Handa Law Professional Corporation is a Brampton, Ontario law firm at 100 Queen Street West, advising on real estate, family and immigration law.

Lawyer Kritika Handa is the firm’s primary contact, and the practice acts for individuals and families on property transactions, family law disputes and immigration applications in Brampton and the surrounding area, in English.
hansen-and-company-calgary:
Hansen & Company is a Calgary immigration law firm that has been operating for more than 30 years.

It acts for individuals, families and businesses on immigration and cross-border legal matters between Canada and the United States. Its site also lists civil litigation, corporate law and US notary services, along with family and real estate work. The office is at 558 9 Avenue SE.
hansra-law-toronto:
Hansra Law is a Toronto business and technology law firm advising owner-managed companies, start-ups and corporations.

Founded in 2020 by principal lawyer Sukhi Hansra, the firm operates from 1 Dundas Street West, Suite 2500, and handles business sales and purchases, incorporations, reorganizations, shareholder agreements, franchise law, SaaS licensing, intellectual property, commercial contracts and commercial leases. Hansra holds a JD from Osgoode Hall Law School and an MBA from the Schulich School of Business and began a legal career at a Bay Street firm. Clients include franchisors, franchisees, technology companies and the executives and directors behind them, served in English and Punjabi.
hara-company:
Hara & Company is a family-run Burnaby law firm founded in 1962, practising from 4664 Lougheed Highway, Suite 155.

Lawyers Glenn Hara and Bradley Hara handle residential and commercial real estate, corporate law, civil litigation, wills and estates, and family law for individuals, families and business owners in Burnaby and across the Lower Mainland, with services in English and Japanese.
harris-ramdowar-professional-corporation:
Harris Ramdowar Professional Corporation is a Niagara Falls law firm practising as Harris Lawyers, established in 2018.

Principal lawyer Sukhmani Ramdowar leads the firm from 4444 Drummond Road, after Ken Harris, who established it, retired in 2024. The firm handles residential and commercial real estate, wills, powers of attorney, estate administration and notary public services for clients in Niagara Falls, St. Catharines, Fort Erie, Welland and Thorold, in English, French and Portuguese.
harrison-pensa-llp:
Harrison Pensa LLP is a law firm in London, Ontario, with an office at 130 Dufferin Ave, Suite 1101.

No practice areas are recorded for the firm, so this profile is limited to its name, city and address. Details of its lawyers and fields of work are not given here, and the entry will be extended once verified information on its practice becomes available.
harsimran-makkar-law-professional-corpor:
Harsimran Makkar Law Professional Corporation is a downtown Brampton law practice led by lawyer Harsimran Makkar.

Harsimran Makkar holds a Master of Laws from Osgoode Hall Law School and has been licensed by the Law Society of Ontario since 2018. The practice works from 180 Queen Street West and handles family law, immigration law and civil litigation for clients in Brampton and across Ontario, in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu.
harvey-katz-law-office-hamilton:
Harvey Katz Law Office is a Hamilton law firm led by litigator Harvey Katz, in practice since 1978, handling personal injury and civil litigation.

The office works from a heritage building at 14 Hess Street South in Hess Village and handles personal injury, car accidents, slip and fall, wrongful death, disability claims, civil litigation, residential and commercial real estate, and wills and estates for individuals and families in Hamilton and surrounding communities, in English.
hashmi-law:
Hashmi Law is a Surrey law firm led by Soleman Hashmi, handling family, real estate, business and estate matters.

Soleman A. Hashmi was called to the British Columbia bar in 2005, and the practice, also known as Hashmi & Co Barristers & Solicitors & Notaries Public, has served Surrey Central since 2006 from 10491 135A Street. Its work covers family law and collaborative law, residential and commercial real estate, business, corporate and commercial law, construction, estates, property matters and personal injury.
haxell-law-oakville:
Haxell Law is an Oakville firm handling real estate transactions, wills, powers of attorney, probate applications and estate planning, with notary services.

The firm has served the Oakville community since 1993 and sits close to the QEW. Its lawyer Jameson Glas, who grew up in Oakville, holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Toronto, was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2014, and earlier practised civil litigation in Toronto with a focus on real estate, private loans and employment. The practice is barrister, solicitor and notary public work for clients in Oakville and the surrounding area.
hayher-lee-llp-calgary:
Hayher Lee LLP is a Calgary, Alberta family law boutique with partners Andy Hayher, Stacey Lee and Marty Birky.

The firm’s roughly eleven lawyers handle divorce, custody and access, spousal and child support, property division, international child abduction under the Hague Convention, appeals, arbitration, mediation, estate litigation, and wills and estates, with Birky handling wills, estates and trusts.
