KMMG Law, formally Kelekis Minuk MicFlikier Green, is a Winnipeg family law firm at 625 Nairn Avenue in the Elmwood and East Kildonan area.

Managing partner Daniel Minuk leads a team that includes associates Merissa Mundey and Shaylan Cottick and lawyer and mediator Renée Nichols, a collaborative practitioner. The firm handles divorce, separation, custody, collaborative divorce, mediation, real estate and wills and estates for clients in Winnipeg.
kn-law-toronto:
KN LAW Professional Corporation is a Scarborough residential real estate law firm led by lawyer Kiranjit Sihota.

The firm works from Suite 303 at 2225 Markham Road and handles home purchases and sales, mortgage refinancing, title transfers, survivorship applications, private mortgages and virtual closings for Ontario homeowners, first-time buyers and investors, in English and Punjabi.
knight-law-office-winnipeg:
Knight Law Office is a Winnipeg general practice law firm at 900 Harrow Street East, Suite 202, led by Donald Knight, KC.

Knight, who was called to the Manitoba bar in 1980, practises with lawyer Wayne Forbes in family law, real estate, wills and estates, criminal defence, civil litigation, corporate and commercial law and personal injury, serving individuals, families and businesses throughout Manitoba in English.
kooner-law-brampton:
Criminal defence is the only work of Kooner Law, a Brampton firm acting on driving, assault and drug charges. Lawyer Indervir Kooner represents clients at every stage, from arrest through bail, trial and sentencing.

The firm serves Brampton, Mississauga and the wider Greater Toronto Area and acts across Ontario. It accepts Legal Aid certificates and offers flexible payment options. It also helps clients understand bail and release from custody, how a case will be heard, their rights at trial and sentencing principles, and whether they qualify for Legal Aid Ontario coverage.
kooner-priddle-law-group-kamloops:
Kooner Priddle Law Group is a Kamloops litigation firm handling personal injury, malpractice, estate litigation, employment and contract disputes.

Its Kamloops lawyers offer a full scope of litigation services, from giving an opinion on a legal matter to designing litigation strategies, and act for clients from all walks of life. On malpractice, the firm covers harm from misdiagnosis, surgical or prescription errors and failure to diagnose or monitor a condition, and its team are trial lawyers. The office is at 172 Battle Street in Kamloops, British Columbia.
korman-and-company-toronto:
Korman & Company is a Toronto firm of real estate lawyers, with notary public services offered alongside other areas of practice.

The firm's practice includes a real estate section, other areas of practice, notary public services and a team of lawyers. Little further detail about the firm's approach, history or clients is available, so this entry is limited to its location and practice areas.
kormans-llp:
Kormans LLP is a Mississauga law firm established in 1973, handling real estate, corporate and commercial, and estate matters across Ontario.

The firm is headquartered in Mississauga with offices in Markham, North York, Vaughan and Gravenhurst, and its lawyers include David Korman, Jonathan A. Hacohen, Sharon Edoo and Taimoor Qureshi. Its practice covers residential and commercial real estate, corporate and commercial law, wills and estates, and notary services for individuals and businesses throughout the province.
kraska-law-mississauga:
Kraska Law is a boutique criminal defence law firm at 4310 Sherwoodtowne Boulevard, Suite 102, in Mississauga, Ontario.

Founded by Robert Kraska, a former federal prosecutor, the firm defends DUI and impaired driving, domestic assault, theft and violent crime charges, handles bail hearings and takes select civil litigation and personal injury matters. Services are offered in English and Polish to clients in Mississauga and the surrounding region.
kreindler-law-toronto:
Kreindler Law is a Toronto immigration law firm led by principal lawyer Jerry Kreindler, focused on Canadian business immigration.

Jerry Kreindler holds law degrees from Queen Mary College London and the University of Ottawa and an undergraduate degree from McGill University. The firm works from Suite 1505 at 65 Queen Street West and handles work permits and LMIAs, intra-company transferees, investor and entrepreneur visas, Express Entry, family sponsorship, citizenship, rehabilitation waivers and temporary resident permits for Canadian and international companies and individuals, with French and Spanish spoken.
krk-law-corporation-winnipeg:
In Winnipeg, KRK Law Corporation handles immigration and refugee matters, family law, real estate, wills and estates, and corporate law.

Kasun, the managing partner, was admitted to the Manitoba bar in 2022. He earned his law degree at Sri Lanka Law College in 2009, practised in Sri Lanka for four years, and received his Certificate of Qualification from the Federation of Law Societies of Canada in 2020. Family law work covers divorce, child custody, child support and spousal support, and real estate work covers residential and commercial purchases and sales, leases and commercial contracts. Legal assistant Srima Jayakody is a former lawyer in Sri Lanka with more than eight years of experience.
ks-law-professional-corporation-etobicok:
KS Law Professional Corporation is an Etobicoke boutique firm handling family law and real estate for clients across the Greater Toronto Area. Kishore (Kris) Subramanian, a barrister, solicitor and notary public, has practised in Ontario for over 20 years and handles each file personally. On the family side he deals with divorce, separation, custody and parenting time, child and spousal support, and property division, appearing in the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice, arbitration and mediation.

The real estate practice covers residential purchases, sales and refinancing, commercial and investment property transactions, private mortgage lending and title transfers in Toronto, Peel, York, Halton, Durham, Simcoe County and Ottawa, along with notary services. Kris has also sat on the ethics board of Centennial College and served as a Vice-President with the Lions Club.
ksw-lawyers:
KSW Lawyers, formally Kane Shannon Weiler LLP, is a Surrey full-service law firm serving the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland since 1973.

The firm works from 7565 132 Street in Surrey, with further offices on Croydon Drive in Surrey and in Abbotsford and Langley, and Clifford R. Shannon is a member of the firm. Its practice covers personal injury and ICBC claims, business law, commercial and residential real estate, wills, estates and trusts, family law, employment and labour, taxation, insurance and criminal matters for corporate and individual clients.
kung-lo-jia-llp:
Kung, Lo & Jia LLP is a Markham firm handling civil litigation, employment, construction, corporate and real estate matters, plus wills and estates.

The firm was founded by Jason Huang-Kung, Justin Lo and Andrew Jia, and it serves individuals and businesses across York, Peel, Durham, the Greater Toronto Area and the rest of Southern Ontario. Work includes wrongful dismissal and severance matters, construction liens, shareholder agreements, commercial leases, probate applications, and residential and commercial real estate purchases, sales and refinancing. Other team members include Arsalan Wancho, Fawad Ghulami, Tammy Kung and Rachel Lee, and the firm offers multilingual support.
la-rosee-avocat-inc-montreal:
La Rosée Avocat is a Montreal family law and civil practice based in the Ahuntsic district.

Founded in 2015 by Me Nada Youssef, a member of the Barreau du Québec and an accredited small claims mediator, the solo practice handles family law, divorce, child custody and support, small claims mediation, civil litigation, housing matters before the Tribunal administratif du logement, criminal defence, and immigration and refugee law. Youssef holds a doctorate in public law and previously taught university law courses in Beirut. Services are available in English, French and Arabic to individuals, newcomers and families across Greater Montreal.
lacombe-avocats-montreal:
Lacombe Avocats is a single-lawyer Montreal business law firm led by Marc-André Lacombe.

Operating from 495 Avenue Viger Ouest, Suite 3105, the firm advises on business and corporate law, real estate, co-ownership, wills, estates and estate planning, tax, bankruptcy and insolvency, employment, immigration, family, construction, administrative matters and civil litigation. Lacombe, a member of the Barreau du Québec, holds a JD in common law, a master’s degree in taxation, a master’s degree in international trade law from the Université de Montpellier and a diploma in business law.
lafreniere-sanna-estate-law-ottawa:
Estate planning and trusts are the focus of Lafrenière Sanna Estate Law, formerly Persona Law Group, in the Ottawa area. Its office is in Stittsville.

Each lawyer practises in a limited number of areas so that advice is detailed within those fields, and the combined practices extend from estate planning and powers of attorney to trusts and real estate. Chantal Lafrenière earned her law degree in French at the University of Ottawa and articled at an Ottawa labour and employment firm, and Natalie Sanna is also a lawyer with the firm. A law clerk and administrative staff support the lawyers, and a first meeting is arranged with the lawyer able to advise on the matter.
lakeshore-law-oakville:
Lakeshore Law is an Oakville firm covering corporate and commercial law, construction, criminal, family and civil litigation, and immigration matters.

Arjun Sekhon graduated from the University of Windsor in 2021 and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2022, with corporate, commercial, criminal, family and immigration work. Daniel Ibrahim, of counsel, practises litigation before the Ontario Court of Justice and Superior Court of Justice, with municipal, criminal, family and civil work, plus probate applications, wills and powers of attorney. The team has backgrounds in larger firms and in-house roles, and the firm takes on pro bono work and mentorship.
lakhan-tram-llp-mississauga:
Lakhan Tram LLP is a Mississauga family law and civil litigation firm co-founded by partners Ravi Lakhan and Daniel Tram.

The firm handles family law including support, custody, property division and domestic contracts, civil litigation including construction disputes, contract and debt claims, real estate litigation and fraud, and construction law, for clients across the Greater Toronto Area and Peel Region, appearing before the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice in Brampton.
lakin-afolabi-law-london:
Lakin Afolabi Law is a London, Ontario criminal defence firm that focuses on sexual assault and domestic assault charges.

The firm also defends other criminal charges and has offices in London and Kitchener. The team includes Lakin Afolabi, Howsikan Kugathasan and Alyssa Zoltek. Lakin Afolabi has more than fifteen years of experience defending thousands of charges and has litigated over 20 jury trials to verdict. The firm takes a human approach to law built on listening, planning strategy with the client and then defending, and prospective clients can book appointments online.
lalande-personal-injury-long-term-disabi:
Lalande Personal Injury & Long-Term Disability Lawyers is a Hamilton firm acting for injured people, disability claimants and dismissed employees.

The firm is led by owner and principal lawyer Matt Lalande, who was called to the bar in 2003, and its work has centred on personal injury, disability, wrongful death and employment matters since then. It has offices on Main Street West and King Street West in Hamilton and a Burlington branch, and offers virtual consultations across Ontario in English and French. Services cover car, motorcycle and truck accidents, long-term disability denials, wrongful death, wrongful dismissal, civil litigation, insurance disputes and child injuries.
lalonde-geraghty-riendeau-saint-jerome:
Since 1978, Lalonde Geraghty Riendeau has practised in Saint-Jerome, covering civil and commercial litigation, business, real estate and family law.

Known as LGRA, the firm's lawyers also cover construction, tax, labour and employment, insurance, hypothecary recourses, municipal law, bankruptcy and insolvency, and estates. Litigation work includes appearances before the Court of Québec, Superior Court, Court of Appeal, Supreme Court, Federal Court, Tax Court of Canada and the Administrative Tribunal of Quebec, as well as arbitration and negotiated settlements. Business law services extend to self-employed workers and small and medium-sized businesses, including sales of businesses, shareholder agreements and disputes, and directors' liability.
lama-law-real-estate-lawyer-oakville:
Lama Law Real Estate Lawyer is an Oakville firm helping clients buy, sell and refinance homes across the Greater Toronto Area.

Pav Lama earned a bachelor's degree at York University and a law degree at the University of Birmingham in the UK, and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2016. The firm also handles corporate law, commercial law, notary services, and wills and powers of attorney. It offers fixed fee closings, and the office is on Speers Road in Oakville.
lambert-avocats-montreal:
Lambert Avocats is a Montreal law firm acting in personal injury, class action, criminal, administrative and housing matters.

The firm was founded by Jimmy Ernst Jr. L. Lambert and has a team of 14 lawyers working from a single office at 1200 McGill College Avenue, Suite 1800. Its practice covers SAAQ, CNESST and IVAC claims, class actions, criminal and penal defence, administrative and regulatory law, disciplinary matters, housing law and civil liability. Lawyers serve clients in Arabic, English, French, Haitian Creole, Korean, Romanian and Spanish.
lambert-boenders-employment-lawyer-toron:
Lambert Boenders is a Toronto employment and human rights law practice that advises both employees and employers on termination and workplace issues.

Lambert earned a B.A. (Hons) from Victoria College at the University of Toronto and a J.D. from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1994, entered employment and human rights practice in 2009 and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2010. Before practising law he worked for more than twenty-five years in business, including as Vice-President of Operations with an international insurance company. Services include examining employment offer letters and contracts, performance management and improvement issues, and non-solicitation and non-competition clauses. The office is on Queen Street West.
lambert-law-victoria:
Lambert Law is a Victoria boutique law firm led by principal lawyer Rory Lambert, handling personal injury and civil litigation.

Lawyer Andrew Rafuse practises with Rory Lambert. The firm handles personal injury claims including motor vehicle accidents, ICBC and medical malpractice claims, along with mediation, civil and general litigation, wills, estates and trusts and real estate, for injured members of the Victoria community, in English.
lamont-law-hamilton:
Lamont Law is a Hamilton personal injury firm that focuses on serious and catastrophic injuries, accident benefits and long-term disability denials.

Cases for Hamilton and the GTA include motor vehicle accidents, dog attacks, slip and falls, medical and nursing home negligence, wrongful death, brain injuries and spinal cord injuries, and the firm only takes catastrophic injury matters with an estimated value above $50,000. Erica Lamont, who was born in Hamilton, studied at the University of Waterloo and the University of Calgary and was admitted to the Law Society of Ontario in 2014. She is joined by lawyer Braden Adsett and paralegals Carrie Stewart and Phil Vivian.
lamprey-law-professional-corporation-bar:
Lamprey Law is a Barrie firm handling real estate, mortgages, wills, powers of attorney and estate administration for clients in Barrie and Simcoe County.

Peter Lamprey graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1979, began practising in 1981 and has worked exclusively in the Barrie area since. Jenna Goorts, an Osgoode graduate of 2017 who first worked at the firm as a summer student, practises real estate and wills and estates, and serves on a Simcoe County board for MADD Canada. After years in an early twentieth-century house on Worsley Street, the firm moved to Bayfield Street, where the office has parking and is wheelchair accessible.
landings-llp-toronto:
Landings LLP is a downtown Toronto law firm acting in refugee, immigration, citizenship and human rights matters. It represents people seeking refugee protection and temporary or permanent status, handles appeals to the Immigration Appeal Division and Refugee Appeal Division, humanitarian and compassionate applications, pre-removal risk assessments, detention and inadmissibility issues, and acts in constitutional litigation, including at the Supreme Court of Canada.

Partners Jacqueline Swaisland, Warda Shazadi Meighen and Erin V. Simpson lead the team. Its lawyers include former adjudicators of the Immigration and Refugee Board, lawyers who have worked with the United Nations and law school adjunct faculty, and the firm also advises non-governmental organizations and works with clients internationally.
lange-law-winnipeg:
Lange Law is a Winnipeg real estate and estates law firm founded in 2014 by Chris Lange.

Lange, a University of Manitoba law graduate, leads a two-lawyer team that includes Ola Kuewumi and advises on real estate law, wills and estate planning, and estate administration. The firm serves individuals and families across Manitoba and offers home meetings and after-hours appointments.
laperle-bouchard-avocats:
Laperle Bouchard Avocats is a Drummondville, Quebec law firm handling criminal defence, penal, youth and family law matters.

Lawyers Jasmin Laperle and Marie-Pier Bouchard are among the firm’s four lawyers, with Bouchard handling youth law matters. The team represents clients before municipal courts, the Court of Québec, the Court of Appeal and the Superior Court, accepts legal aid mandates and serves the Drummondville region in French.
laredo-law-toronto:
Laredo Law is a Toronto estates firm preparing wills, trusts and tax-aware succession plans and acting in estate administration.

The firm was founded in 2007 by Lisa Laredo, a Certified Trust and Estate Practitioner through STEP Canada who belongs to the Canadian Bar Association, the Ontario Bar Association and the Estate Planning Council of Canada. She also teaches accredited programs for lawyers and writes for legal journals. Associate lawyer Ana Wagner and a legal administrative assistant are on the team. The firm also has a real estate law practice and publishes a blog on wills and estates topics in plain language. The office is on Davisville Avenue.
larson-lawyers-professional-corporation:
Larson Lawyers Professional Corporation is a Thunder Bay law firm serving Northwestern Ontario since 1996, handling real estate, estates and family matters.

Founder and president Rene E. Larson was called to the Ontario bar in 1975, and the firm's four lawyers include Lydia Leroux, Olivia Pietrangelo and Nolan McCallum. It works from 620 Victoria Avenue East and its services cover real estate, wills and estate planning, family trusts, family law, corporate law, elder, employment and municipal law, and notarization.
lawden-kunal-kapoor-law:
LawDen, run by Kunal Kapoor Law Professional Corporation in Brampton, handles real estate, immigration, family, criminal and civil matters. Its practice areas also include insurance matters.

Litigation work covers contract and property disputes and employment issues, from pre-trial negotiations and mediation through to the courtroom. Kunal Kapoor is the barrister and solicitor, Ambica Kapoor is office manager, and a team member is listed as Saurav K. The firm offers tailored legal strategies, confidentiality and flexible payment options for individuals and businesses. Its office is on Camberley Crescent in Brampton.
lawpoint-north-york:
Lawpoint is a North York immigration firm handling visa refusal appeals, inadmissibility, permanent residence and work permits. Licensed in Ontario since 2008, it acts for individuals, families and businesses worldwide on matters from a first visitor visa to citizenship, including Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, study permits, LMIA applications and spousal and family sponsorship.

Litigation work includes inadmissibility hearings, mandamus applications and Federal Court proceedings after refusals, alongside humanitarian and compassionate applications, refugee matters and the restoration of permanent resident status. Immigration lawyer Tatiana Gulyaeva practises with the firm. Visits to the Yonge Street office near Finch Station are by appointment only.
lawrence-al-kabain-laval:
In Laval and Montreal, Lawrence Al Kabain practises civil law, covering real estate, insurance, estates and contract disputes.

Practice areas are real estate, insurance, estates, and civil and commercial law, with services offered across Quebec. Matters that bring people to the practice include problems discovered after buying a house, such as water infiltration, foundation or roofing defects; refusals or low valuations by insurers; landlord disputes over repossession and rent increases; contested wills and slow estate liquidations; unpaid invoices addressed by formal demand letters; and disputed contracts.
laws-and-beyond-calgary:
Laws & Beyond is a Calgary firm handling family law, civil litigation, wills and estates, real estate and employment matters.

Family matters include separation, divorce, emergency protection orders, spousal and child support, parenting arrangements, marital agreements and family violence, and Alberta now frames custody as decision-making responsibility and parenting time. The firm uses negotiation, mediation and other alternative dispute resolution where feasible but is prepared to go to court when required. It also offers notarization and commissioning services, and its approach is tailored to each client's goals and circumstances.
lawstop-criminal-lawyers-brampton:
LawStop Criminal Lawyers is a Brampton criminal defence firm led by founder Ishan Sharma, acting in DUI, assault, drug and bail matters.

Sharma holds a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Toronto and a law degree from the University of New Brunswick, and has practised since 2019. The firm works from a single office at 80 Pertosa Drive, Unit 12, accepts legal aid certificates, and handles DUI, assault and domestic offences, drug charges, bail hearings, theft and fraud, and youth offences.
lawyer-up-canada-richmond-hill:
Lawyer UP Canada is a Richmond Hill law firm led by Victor O'Brien, handling criminal defence and civil litigation.

O'Brien clerked for a criminal court judge and worked with an innocence project before practising, studied law at the University of London and articled at a Toronto immigration firm. The firm defends assault, impaired driving, drug, fraud and firearms charges, and also handles civil litigation, professional discipline and regulatory offences, acting for both adult and youth clients.
lawyerg-calgary:
LawyerG is a Calgary law firm founded in 2017 by Gurpreet Aulakh, handling real estate, business, estates and immigration matters.

Aulakh is a barrister and solicitor, and the firm has offices in Edmonton, Red Deer, Lethbridge and Medicine Hat in addition to Calgary. It acts on real estate, business and corporate law, wills and estates, civil litigation, family law, immigration, personal injury and notary services for first-time homebuyers, businesses and newcomers across Alberta, accepts legal aid files, and serves clients in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu.
lawyerrealtor-ca-toronto:
Anita Verma works as both a lawyer and a realtor at LawyerRealtor, a Toronto practice covering real estate, immigration and wills and estates. Operating as Verma Law P.C., the practice also prepares family law contracts and small business contracts.

For home buyers and sellers, it offers a land transfer tax calculator, information on the first-time home buyer rebate and non-resident vendors, and checklists for purchases, sales and refinancing. Anita has communicated with clients over WhatsApp, and meetings at the Liberty Street office are by appointment only.
lazar-law-firm-london:
Lazar Law Firm is a London, Ontario law firm founded by lawyer Bassam Lazar, called to the Ontario bar in 2011, with paralegal services.

Lawyers Katelyn Andersen and Chioma Adiele handle family law, and paralegal Patrick Pacheco supports the practice, from Suite 615 at 200 Queens Avenue. The firm handles real estate, family law, wills and estates and business law, with real estate clients also served in Windsor and Kitchener.
lazarus-legal-montreal:
Established in 1967, Lazarus Legal is a Montreal law firm that advises clients in emerging industries.

Edwin D. Monzon, called to the Quebec Bar in 2004, is managing partner and works in the gaming and corporate industry. The firm's people include Patrick Baghdisar, Audrey Baillairgé, Tim Buckingham, Marc Charbonneau, David Chislaru, Ian Cook, Alexander Di Giovanni, Vanessa Di Tullio, René R. Gauthier and John Giammarella. A notarial division handles real estate acquisitions, refinancing and condominium projects, along with non-contentious family law procedures, in English, French and Italian. The firm's core values are kindness and respect, trust, teamwork, success, growth and innovation, and courage and optimism.
lca-avocats-inc:
LCA Avocats is a Terrebonne firm, with offices in Repentigny and Rosemère, handling civil, real estate, construction, business, labour and family law.

Its mission is to provide a full range of legal services to individuals, entrepreneurs and small and medium-sized businesses. Its fields also include housing law, municipal law and regulatory penal law, and the lawyers act as legal advisers and business partners. Recent publications cover an employer's duties for company vehicles and employees' driving licences, a Tribunal administratif du logement ruling on pet clauses in leases, and Quebec's new régime d'union parentale.
lcg-avocats-inc-quebec-city:
Formed by a 2022 merger, LCG Avocats is a Quebec City firm covering civil, family, business, criminal, immigration and labour law.

The name stands for Labadie Carrier Guay, created from the merger of Côté Carrier avocats and L2 avocats. Civil litigation work includes commercial disputes, personal injury and medical liability, professional liability, wrongful dismissal, psychological harassment, construction law, latent defects, consumer protection, defamation and class actions. Other practice areas are public and administrative law and professional law and ethics, with an office on Chemin Sainte-Foy.
ld-law-llp-toronto:
LD Law LLP is a Toronto firm handling real estate closings, mortgage refinances, title issues and title insurance across Ontario.

The firm acts for buyers, sellers and owners of residential and commercial property, and also takes on real estate litigation. Further practice areas include wills and estate planning, family law and business law, along with employment, corporate and commercial matters. David Baptista dos Reis and Daniel La Gamba are the lawyers named, and real estate services are also offered in Brantford.
ldr-law-professional-corporation-toronto:
Founded in 2022 by Leslie Robinson, LDR Law Professional Corporation handles real estate, wills and estates for Toronto clients. Mr. Robinson works with individuals, families and businesses across Toronto and the GTA on purchases, sales and refinancing, new condominiums, cottage and waterfront properties, private lending, title transfers and Land Registry corrections.

Estate planning and administration are the other main areas, supported by tax planning knowledge and an advanced wills and estates program from Osgoode Hall Law School. Clients range from first-time home buyers to people with corporate holdings who need succession planning, and the firm also provides commissioner of oaths and notary services. Before law school, Mr. Robinson worked in social work.
le-cabinet-m-saint-jerome:
Le Cabinet M is a Saint-Jérôme law firm handling health law, personal injury, workplace injury and employment matters.

The firm works from 484 rue Laviolette and handles health law including SAAQ, CNESST and IVAC claims and medical error cases, personal injury, occupational health and safety, and employment law matters such as dismissal and harassment for Quebec clients, in French.
le-groupe-campeau-raymond-inc-montreal:
Le Groupe Campeau Raymond is a Montreal criminal defence law firm led by lawyers Anne-Marie Campeau and Maxime Raymond.

Campeau and Raymond joined forces in 2020 to form the two-lawyer firm, which operates from a single office at 54 Rue Le Royer Ouest. The practice handles criminal and penal law matters at trial and on appeal for individuals and companies, in English and French.
leadright-law-barrie:
LeadRight Law is a Barrie law firm led by principal lawyer Sreejith Subrahmanian, handling immigration, real estate and family matters.

The firm works from Suite 108 at 136 Bayfield Street and handles immigration and citizenship, residential and commercial real estate, family law, criminal defence and bail hearings, wills, estates and notary services for individuals, newcomers and families in Barrie and Simcoe County.
league-and-williams-lawyers-victoria:
League and Williams Lawyers is a Victoria law firm handling personal injury, wills and estates, real estate and business matters.

The firm has 12 lawyers and further offices in Vancouver, Duncan, Campbell River and Kelowna, and Darren Williams is principal for wills, estates and trusts. Its practice covers personal injury, wills, estates and trust disputes, estate planning, real estate, business and corporate law, commercial law, family law and marine law for individuals and businesses across British Columbia, in English and Russian.
leblanc-dingman-avocats:
Leblanc & Dingman Avocats is a Sherbrooke law firm established in 2008, handling criminal, penal and youth law matters.

Lawyers Kim Dingman, Mireille Leblanc and Adam Fontaine Métivier practise from bureau 20 at 85 rue Belvédère Nord. The firm handles criminal and penal defence, youth protection and youth criminal justice matters, and record suspensions, with family law handled by Mireille Leblanc, for clients in Sherbrooke and the surrounding region, in French.
lebrun-provencher-trois-rivieres:
LeBrun Provencher is a Trois-Rivières, Quebec criminal and penal defence law firm founded in 1947 and formerly known as Lacoursière LeBrun.

Its lawyers include Michel LeBrun, called to the bar in 1988, Penelope Provencher, Janie Thibault and Camille Marchand, and the firm operates from 1243 Rue Hart. It defends impaired driving, drug, violent crime, theft and fraud charges, criminal appeals, Charter applications and Highway Safety Code offences before the Court of Quebec, Superior Court, Court of Appeal and Supreme Court of Canada, in French and English.
lecker-and-associates-north-york:
Lecker & Associates is a North York employment law firm that acts only for employees in dismissal, severance and disability disputes.

Led by Bram A. Lecker, who was called to the Ontario bar in 1984, the firm has practised for more than 40 years from 4789 Yonge Street, Suite 514, with partners including Matthew A. Fisher, Jordan Reiner and Kimberley Sebag. Its work covers wrongful and constructive dismissal, severance negotiations, layoffs, workplace harassment, parental leave, denied disability benefits and contractor misclassification, and it does not act for employers.
lee-and-associates-north-york:
Lee & Associates is a North York personal injury firm acting for injured people in litigation, arbitration, mediation and negotiation. The firm was started in 2006 by Andrew, a former named partner at another firm, to focus on acting for plaintiffs, and its practice is limited to injured individuals rather than insurance companies or corporations. Fees are billed on contingency, so no fees or expenses are owed unless money is recovered.

The multicultural staff offers services in Arabic, Armenian, Belarusian, Bengali, Cantonese, French, Greek, Gujarati, Hindi, Italian, Korean, Malayalam, Mandarin, Punjabi, Russian, Tamil, Urdu and Vietnamese. Clients are seen at an office on Yonge Street.
lee-and-company-north-york:
Lee and Company is a North York immigration law firm helping newcomers, individuals and families obtain permanent residence in Canada.

Wennie Lee is a principal and lawyer with the firm, alongside Marco Vitorovich, with regulated immigration consultants supporting clients from 4773 Yonge Street, Suite 3F. Services cover permanent residence, work and study permits, family and spousal sponsorship, refugee claims, citizenship, LMIA, judicial review and business and investor programs, in Arabic, English, Korean, Punjabi, Russian, Serbian and Spanish.
legal-focus-llp:
Legal Focus LLP is a Windsor firm handling personal injury, estates and probate, real estate and civil litigation matters.

Partner Marcela S. Aroca was appointed a judge of the Tax Court of Canada. The team includes a partner in civil litigation and personal injury, associates in civil, tax and estate litigation, wills and estates, property disputes, corporate, commercial and real estate work, and law clerks who are also licensed paralegals. The firm is guided by integrity, transparency and client education, and its personal injury work covers motor vehicle accidents and slip and fall cases.
legal-route-brampton:
Legal Route is a Brampton law firm led by founder and principal lawyer Vinay Thapliyal, called to the Ontario bar in 2021.

The firm works from Unit 17 at 2074 Steeles Avenue East and handles business law, civil litigation, criminal law, construction law, family law, personal injury, real estate and wills and estates matters for clients in Brampton.
legal-solutions-law-firm-toronto:
Legal Solutions Law Firm is a Scarborough law firm founded in 2012 by Ryan Manilla, handling criminal, family and civil litigation matters.

Manilla holds a BA and JD, was called to the Ontario bar in 2008 and spent two years in litigation at a New York City law firm before founding the firm. Its head office is at 10 Milner Business Court, with meeting locations in Toronto, North York and Brampton by appointment, and its team includes lawyers and paralegals. Services cover criminal defence, family law, civil litigation, Small Claims Court, landlord and tenant matters, traffic tickets and regulatory proceedings across Toronto and Southern Ontario.
leiter-rahme-attorneys-inc-montreal:
Leiter Rahme Attorneys Inc. is a Montreal immigration law firm founded in 1991, advising on Canadian and U.S. immigration matters.

Barbara J. Leiter founded the firm, and partner Gissa Rahme co-directs it from 4541 Avenue du Parc; both are admitted to the Barreau du Québec and the New York State Bar. The practice covers permanent residence, work permits and LMIA, family sponsorship, super visas, student visas, citizenship, waivers of inadmissibility, deportation defence and business and investor immigration for individuals, families and executives from more than fifty countries.
lemieux-litigation-barrie:
Lemieux Litigation is a Barrie boutique litigation firm led by principal lawyer Marc Lemieux, handling injury, employment and family matters.

Lawyers Antonio Meringolo and Nicole Meringolo practise with Marc Lemieux from Suite 204 at 190 Cundles Road East. The firm handles personal injury claims including motor vehicle, motorcycle, slip and fall and long-term disability matters, employment and labour law, family law and general civil litigation for individuals across Barrie and Simcoe County, in English and Portuguese.
lerners-llp:
Lerners LLP is a full-service law firm established in 1929, based in London, Ontario with offices in Toronto, Strathroy and Kitchener-Waterloo.

The firm has more than 100 lawyers, including Clark Armstrong in commercial real estate and David Lyons in business law. Its practice covers litigation and class actions, alternative dispute resolution, banking and financial law, business law, employment, land development and real estate, insurance and specialty risk, professional regulation and health law, personal injury, family law, and wills and estates. The London office is at 85 Dufferin Avenue.
leveille-et-associes:
Leveille et Associes is a Gatineau firm established in 1996 handling family law, criminal law, housing disputes, and civil and commercial matters. A team of lawyers works across many areas of law.

Family services include divorce, separation, child custody and access, child and spousal support, division of property, amicable agreements and preparation for mediation. The firm also acts in criminal defence and in landlord and tenant matters before the housing tribunal, the Régie du logement. The office is at 255 Boulevard Saint-Joseph in Gatineau.
levitt-llp-toronto:
Levitt LLP is a Toronto employment and labour law firm acting for employers and employees in dismissal, severance and workplace disputes.

The firm has acted in employment and labour matters for more than 40 years. Senior partner Howard Levitt is the author of The Law of Dismissal in Canada and writes a column for the Financial Post. Jacqueline L. King is managing partner, Dante Capannelli, Peter Carey and Puneet Tiwari are partners, and Robert C. Taylor is senior counsel, in a team of 18 lawyers. Its work covers wrongful and unjust dismissal, severance and exit packages, employment contracts, WSIB and WSIAT claims, workplace investigations, labour relations and collective bargaining, discrimination and harassment, and appeals, in English and French, for clients across Canada.
lewis-et-associes-sencrl:
Lewis et Associes SENCRL is a Montreal immigration and refugee law firm, also operating under the English name Lewis & Associates LLP.

The firm has practised for more than 30 years from a single Montreal office and acts for individuals, families and corporations seeking permanent or temporary status in Canada, including legal aid clients. Its work covers refugee claims, humanitarian applications, immigration appeals, Federal Court applications, work and study permits, citizenship, family sponsorship, Express Entry, provincial nominee and start-up visa programs, detention reviews and notary services.
lex-magnus-law-professional-corporation-:
Lex Magnus Law Professional Corporation is a Toronto law firm handling litigation, criminal defence, family, immigration and real estate matters.

Partners Suvendu Goswami, Saidaltaf Patel and Khalid Arshad lead the firm, with associate Ashish Jobanputra, from offices at 1585 Markham Road and 1315 Lawrence Avenue East in Toronto, with additional offices in Los Angeles, New Delhi and Ahmedabad. Its practice covers civil and commercial litigation, criminal defence, family law, immigration, real estate, and wills and estates for individuals, families and businesses, in English, Hindi and Bengali.
li-cheng-business-and-real-estate-law-ha:
Serving Hamilton, Burlington and Oakville, Li Cheng Business & Real Estate Law handles residential and commercial real estate and business law. The firm has been in practice for more than ten years.

Li Cheng previously worked for all three levels of government advising on major public land development projects, and now acts for developers, lenders, businesses and home buyers and sellers. His work includes residential development projects ranging from $10 million to $200 million, as well as purchases, sales, refinancing, title transfers and private mortgages. Offices serve Hamilton, Burlington, St. Catharines and the Niagara Region, and services are available in English, Mandarin, Cantonese and Arabic.
liberty-law-llp-edmonton:
Liberty Law LLP is an Edmonton criminal defence firm founded in 1989, acting in homicide, impaired driving, sexual assault, drug and fraud cases.

The firm's partners are Edmond O'Neill, Brian Hurley, Eamon O'Keeffe, Kim Hardstaff, Robert LaValley and Shawn L. Gerstel, joined by associates Edward Apolonio Jr., Edward Sacher and Zoe Voigt. It practises from the Maclean Block at 10110 107 Street NW, with offices in Grande Prairie and Fort McMurray, and accepts Legal Aid Alberta files. Its work also covers young offenders, regulatory hearings, Charter litigation and appeals, including appeals to the Supreme Court of Canada, for clients across Alberta.
licata-law-north-york:
Licata Law is a North York law firm founded by lawyer Caterina Licata, called to the Ontario bar in 2016, handling real estate, family and corporate matters.

Oleksiy Hrabovetskyi manages the firm’s real estate practice. Licata Law handles residential and commercial real estate, family law including fertility and surrogacy matters, corporate and commercial law, mining law, and wills and probate for individuals, businesses, builders, developers and mining companies.
linq-law-edmonton:
LinQ Law is a full-service South Edmonton firm covering family law, real estate, business law, bankruptcy and insolvency, and estates. The firm has served Edmonton since 2016.

Family work includes divorce, child custody, child support, adoption and mediation. The practice also takes on personal injury, criminal defence and civil litigation, and it advises both lenders and borrowers on real estate matters. Through a network of partner lawyers it also supports Canadian firms looking to do business and expand, and it offers flexible payment structures.
lions-gate-law-corporation-vancouver:
Lions Gate Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling real estate conveyancing, mortgage refinances, incorporations, and wills and estates.

Services include commercial conveyancing and mortgage refinances, and its lawyers are mobile. The firm's office is on West Georgia Street in downtown Vancouver. Its lawyers hold degrees from the University of British Columbia, the London School of Economics and McGill University.
llf-lawyers-llp:
LLF Lawyers LLP is a Peterborough law firm founded in 1993, with a branch office in Bobcaygeon and a broad general practice.

The firm has 16 lawyers, with partners including Bill Lockington, Emmet Connolly and Jeff Lanctot, and its main office is at 332 Aylmer Street North. Its practice covers business and corporate law, real estate, family law, civil litigation, personal injury, wills and estates, employment and construction law for individuals, businesses and non-profits in Peterborough, Bobcaygeon and Central Ontario, in English.
lm-law-group-toronto:
LM Law Group is a Toronto immigration firm handling study permits, work permits, permanent residence, visitor visas, Express Entry and citizenship applications.

Founded in 2007, the firm has a team of about 25. Partners are Elizabeth Long, Aadil Mangalji and Ziah Sumar, with associates including Erin Levitsky and Catanne Boan-Mitchell. Services are organized by client group: employers, students, permanent residents, workers, visitors, citizens and entrepreneurs. Each case is assessed individually so that the immigration path fits the person, with an empathy-focused approach.
lmrt-immigration-services-montreal:
LMRT Immigration Services is a Montreal team of regulated immigration consultants handling asylum cases, family sponsorship and Express Entry.

The firm has worked on refugee and sponsorship files since 2017, and its founder, Loujin Khalil, is a regulated consultant authorized to appear before the Immigration and Refugee Board. His background includes business immigration streams such as entrepreneur programs, the Start-up Visa and owner-operator. Services are offered in English, French, Arabic and Persian, Quebec programs are covered, appointments can be held online, and guides are published on topics such as the four divisions of the Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada.
longfield-law-professional-corporation-b:
Longfield Law Professional Corporation is a family-run Brampton law firm founded in 1986 by Randall Longfield.

Michael Longfield later joined the firm, which operates from a standalone office at 303 Main Street North and handles residential and commercial real estate, wills and powers of attorney, probate and estate administration, corporate and business law, and commercial leasing for clients in Brampton, Georgetown, Milton and Caledon, in English.
loopstra-nixon-llp:
Loopstra Nixon LLP is a business law firm headquartered in Etobicoke, with offices in downtown Toronto and Vaughan.

Founded by Charles Loopstra and Sandy Nixon, the firm works from Suite 600 at 135 Queens Plate Drive and handles banking and finance, bankruptcy, insolvency and restructuring, corporate and commercial law, construction, commercial litigation, franchise, labour and employment, mergers and acquisitions, private equity, municipal and land use planning, real estate, and trusts and estates for businesses, institutions and individuals across Canada.
lou-vadala:
Lou Vadala Professional Corporation is a Kingston law office, founded in 2000, handling real estate, wills and estates, corporate and family matters.

Real estate, wills and estates and corporate law are the main areas, with family law, litigation and notary public and Commissioner of Oaths services among other practice areas. The team has served clients across the province and worldwide for more than 20 years. Team members include Lou Vadala, Anthony Vadala, Jake Wright, Steven King, Dianne LaFortune and Josh Vaters. Corporate work is aimed at entrepreneurs, founders, owners, lenders, partnerships and small businesses.
lt-lawyers-llp-calgary:
LT Lawyers LLP is a Calgary personal injury law firm founded by lawyers Ryan Lee and Peter Trieu, handling accident and disability claims.

Associate counsel Andrew Kim practises with the founding partners from Suite 750 at 630 6 Avenue SW. The firm handles personal injury and long-term disability claims including motor vehicle, motorcycle, bicycle and pedestrian accidents, brain and spinal injuries, slip and fall and wrongful death for injured clients in Alberta and British Columbia, in English, Cantonese, Vietnamese and Korean.
lucenti-orlando-professional-corporation:
Lucenti Orlando Professional Corporation is a North Bay firm practising family, estates, corporate, real estate, tax and civil litigation law.

Robert Lucenti joined the established firm of Ernest Loukidelis and Michael G. Bolan in 1969, and several of the firm's lawyers were later appointed to the Superior Court of Ontario. Sandro Orlando joined in 1984, Mark Lucenti in 2009 and Ryan Leckie in 2017. Family law work highlights collaborative family law, separation, marriage and cohabitation agreements, divorce and support. Civil litigation covers employment disputes and debt collection, and the firm has practised in North Bay for more than 55 years.
luk-associates:
Luk & Associates is a Markham law firm, a trade name of Raymond Luk Professional Corporation, handling real estate, family and estates matters.

Founder Raymond Luk holds a BA from the University of Toronto and a JD from Queen's University, and lawyer Eiman Sharifpour handles family law. The team also includes licensed paralegals, a law clerk and a regulated immigration consultant. Services cover real estate, family law, wills and estates, immigration, landlord and tenant matters, small claims, personal injury, tax, business and defamation law and notary services, in English, Mandarin, Cantonese, Vietnamese, Korean, Farsi, Ukrainian and Russian.
lydia-h-thomson-law-corporation-kelowna:
Lydia Thomson Law Corporation is a Kelowna, British Columbia family law and estates practice established in 2007.

Founded in summer 2007 by Lydia Thomson, a University of Saskatchewan law graduate and accredited family law mediator who previously spent several years with a Kelowna firm, the practice has two lawyers, including Brandon Montgomery. It handles family law, wills, estates and trusts, probate, consumer protection and general practice matters for clients in Kelowna, West Kelowna and Lake Country.
lyon-stern-immigration-law-winnipeg:
Permanent residence, work and study permits, sponsorship and business immigration are covered by Lyon Stern Immigration Law, a full-service Winnipeg firm.

The firm, also known as Lyon Stern Partners, works through a global network of lawyers, consultants and other immigration professionals and acts for individuals, families and businesses. Services include Provincial Nominee Programs, inter-company transfers, visitor applications, immigration services for Canadian businesses and citizenship. It offers a single access point for all immigration services, and its lawyers prepare strategies for dealings with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada. The office is on Portage Avenue.
m-i-b-avocat-inc-laval:
With an office in Laval, MIB Avocat handles immigration applications and criminal defence for clients in the Montreal area.

Immigration services cover visitors, foreign students, temporary workers, permanent residence, sponsorship and Canadian citizenship, while criminal law work includes release hearings and the defence of criminal charges and court summonses. Lawyers and staff communicate in French, English and Arabic. The firm's values are respect, transparency, open-mindedness, discretion, perseverance and excellence, and its office is on Boulevard Saint-Martin Ouest.
m-j-o-nions-vancouver:
MJ O'Nions, now Stride Law, is a Vancouver firm practising family law, mediation, wills and estates and business law.

The firm operates as Stride Law, formerly M.J. O'Nions Lawyers & Mediators, a British Columbia practice whose areas include mediation, collaborative divorce, family law agreements, wills and estates, business law and notary services. On estates it handles litigation over unfair wills and the defence of estates against challenges, along with probate, letters of administration and flat-rate estate plans covering a will, power of attorney and advance health care directive. It does not charge for photocopying, faxing or secretarial time.
m-roy-and-associes-drummondville:
Debt and insolvency solutions in Drummondville come from M Roy & Associés, a licensed insolvency trustee for individuals and businesses.

For individuals, solutions include debt consolidation through a single loan of up to five years, personal bankruptcy and consumer proposals, which combine debts into one repayment agreement based on the person's budget. For businesses, the firm handles commercial bankruptcy, proposals to creditors and insolvency in the construction sector, and it publishes advice and articles on indebtedness. The office is on Rue Hériot in Drummondville.
ma-adebisi-law-office-winnipeg:
MA Adebisi Law Office is a Winnipeg law firm led by founder and managing partner Mubarak Adebisi, serving St. Boniface and downtown Winnipeg.

The firm works from 185 Provencher Boulevard and handles family law, immigration, real estate, wills and estates and probate, corporate and commercial law, and notary public and commissioner of oaths services for individuals, families and businesses.
maam-law-mississauga:
Maam Law is a Mississauga firm offering family law, wills and powers of attorney, real estate, immigration, elder abuse prevention and notarization services.

Lawyer Nishtha Wadhwa moved to Canada in February 2018, passed the Ontario bar exams through the National Committee on Accreditation process, and was admitted to the Bar of Ontario on August 28, 2020. She also completed a postgraduate diploma in immigration law at Anderson College in North York. The office provides services in English, Urdu, Punjabi and Hindi, and Ms. Wadhwa works with culturally and ethnically diverse clients. Each practice area is set out in plain terms.
maana-law-mississauga:
Maana Law is a Mississauga, Ontario personal injury law firm founded and led by Aman Kalra.

Located at 90 Matheson Boulevard West, Suite 101, the firm handles car accidents, slip and fall injuries, long-term disability claims, dog bites, catastrophic brain and spinal injuries and wrongful death claims. It serves accident victims in Mississauga and Brampton in English, Hindi and Punjabi and offers home and hospital visits.
macdonald-zhivov-calgary:
MacDonald Zhivov is a Calgary law firm led by managing counsel Mark MacDonald, handling personal injury, immigration, family and estates matters.

The firm began in 2012 as Zhivov Law, founded by Vladimir Zhivov, who is now counsel emeritus. Personal injury lawyer Angie Mijalska and associate Emma Aprado practise with Mark MacDonald, and the firm has multiple locations in Alberta. Its work covers personal injury, immigration, family law, wills and estates and notary services, in English, Russian, Polish, Spanish, Tagalog and Ukrainian.
macisaac-gow-llp-oakville:
MacIsaac Gow LLP is an Oakville personal injury law firm founded in 2017 by Matthew C. MacIsaac and Fraser R. Gow.

Both founders began their careers on the insurance defence side, MacIsaac at firms in Hamilton and elsewhere and Gow at personal injury and insurance defence firms, and associates Alex Robart, Mark McDonald and Maximilian Jagoda work alongside them. Its practice covers motor vehicle, truck, motorcycle and bicycle accidents, slip and fall claims, dog bites, long-term disability, medical malpractice, product liability, catastrophic injury, wrongful death and chronic pain, for injured people across Halton, the Greater Toronto Area and Southern Ontario, in English, French, Mandarin and Cantonese.
mack-lawyers:
Mack Lawyers is an Oshawa law firm serving Durham Region for more than four decades in business, real estate and civil litigation matters.

The firm has eight lawyers working from a single office at 146 Simcoe Street North, including Paul D. Mack in civil litigation and corporate and commercial law and Craig Mack in corporate and commercial law. Its practice covers business formation, commercial and corporate law, real estate, employment and labour, civil litigation including construction liens, wills, estates and powers of attorney. Clients range from first-time homebuyers to developers and commercial landlords, in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
mackenzie-family-law-pc-toronto:
Jaclyn Mackenzie leads Mackenzie Family Law PC, a Toronto firm for divorce, parenting, support and child protection cases. Her practice is exclusively family law and child protection law.

Jaclyn Mackenzie was called to the Ontario bar in 2014 and founded the firm in 2018 after several years at a boutique family law practice. Her work covers decision-making responsibility, parenting time, child support, spousal support and restraining orders, and a significant part of it involves representing parents and other family members in proceedings with Children's Aid Societies. Legal Aid Ontario certificates are accepted, and private clients can retain the firm hourly or on a flat fee for court materials.
mackenzie-vozza-law:
MacKenzie Vozza Law is a Sarnia practice focused on real estate, wills and estates, and corporate commercial law.

MacKenzie Vozza is an associate lawyer practising in association with George Murray Shipley Bell LLP, which she joined in May 2024. Born and raised in Sarnia, she earned a criminology degree at Western University in 2018 and a Juris Doctor at the University of Calgary in 2022, and then articled at the Provincial Court of Alberta in Edmonton, working with judges in family, civil and criminal matters. She was admitted to the Ontario Bar in 2023, and the office is at 222 Front Street North.
maclean-law-vancouver:
MacLean Law is a Vancouver family law firm founded in 1983 by Lorne MacLean, K.C., acting in divorce and estate litigation matters.

MacLean is a fellow of the International Academy of Family Lawyers, and the firm has offices in Vancouver, West Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, Victoria, Kelowna and Calgary. Its practice covers family law and estate litigation, including high net worth divorce and international and jurisdictional family disputes, for clients in Canada and internationally, with lawyers speaking languages such as Cantonese, Farsi, French, Hebrew, Hindi, Korean, Mandarin, Punjabi, Spanish and Urdu.
macleod-law-firm-toronto:
MacLeod Law Firm is a Toronto employment and labour law boutique founded in 1989 by lawyer Douglas MacLeod.

Based at 2 Bloor Street West, the boutique focuses on workplace law and handles wrongful dismissal, severance reviews, employment contracts, human rights matters and wider employment and labour law questions, representing both employees and employers in workplace disputes across Ontario.
madaans-llp-lawyers-mississauga:
Madaans LLP is a Mississauga firm handling residential and commercial real estate and business purchases and sales across the Greater Toronto Area.

Services include sales, purchases, refinancing and title transfers, with flat-fee residential pricing plans. Service areas include Toronto, Brampton, Mississauga, Vaughan, Oakville and Hamilton. Lawyers Vikas Madaan and Simmarjit K. Madaan have practised in two jurisdictions; Vikas holds an LL.B. from the University of Victoria and articled in Nanaimo, BC. The firm intends to offer corporate, commercial, and wills and estates services as well.
magnolia-law-corporation-vancouver:
Magnolia Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm, founded by principal lawyer Dimitra Vassilas, that handles business law, real estate and estate matters.

Its services include a business law subscription with three tiers, real estate transactions, estate planning, probate and estate administration, and family office and wealth structuring. The office is at 777 Richards Street, Suite 602.
mahogany-law-group-llp-abbotsford:
Mahogany Law Group LLP is a boutique Abbotsford, British Columbia family law and wills and estates firm.

Co-founding partners Puneet Mann and Alexandra Ghihor operate the firm alongside lawyers Francis Lepp and Joshua Vissia. Its practice covers divorce, separation agreements, child custody and parenting arrangements, child and spousal support, property division, cohabitation and marriage agreements, wills, probate, powers of attorney, family mediation and notary services. Ghihor is an accredited mediator and Fraser Valley duty counsel lawyer, and the firm serves families across the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland in English and Punjabi.
maio-family-law-kelowna:
Maio Family Law is a Kelowna, British Columbia family law firm founded in 2018 by Domenic Maio.

Maio was called to the Ontario bar in 2015 and the BC bar in 2018 and holds a Master of Laws from Osgoode Hall, and lawyers Megan Lonsdale and Olivia Desjardins work alongside the founder. The firm handles divorce, separation, custody, child and spousal support, property division, adoption, mediation, real estate and wills and estates for individuals and families across Kelowna, West Kelowna and the Okanagan Valley.
maisonneuve-dawkins-lawyers:
Maisonneuve Dawkins Lawyers is a Timmins, Ontario law firm established in 1960 at 15 Balsam Street South.

Operating as Maisonneuve Dawkins Professional Corporation, the firm’s lawyers include Ben Dawkins and Luc Maisonneuve. It advises on corporate and commercial law, real estate, criminal law, wills and estates, family law and civil litigation, with bilingual services in English and French.
malina-a-roshan-mississauga:
Malina Roshan runs Roshan Law, a Mississauga practice handling family and divorce law as well as criminal defence matters.

Malina Roshan founded the firm in 2010 and has more than 15 years as a family and criminal lawyer, regularly appearing in the Superior Court of Justice. The firm serves the Greater Toronto Area and communities including Brampton, Etobicoke, North York, Hamilton, Milton, Guelph, Kitchener, Waterloo, Vaughan, Newmarket, Oakville, Burlington, Oshawa and Orangeville. It offers clear pricing, regular updates on the file and a process that starts with booking a meeting.
maltais-morin-avocats:
Maltais & Morin Avocats is a Drummondville, Quebec firm of avocats with an office at 1665 Boulevard Saint-Joseph.

The firm is located at 1665 Boulevard Saint-Joseph, in Drummondville, Quebec. Its French name identifies it as a firm of avocats, the Quebec term for lawyers. Individual lawyers, practice areas and specific services are not recorded for the firm, so this entry gives only its name, address and city.
mamann-sandaluk-llp:
Mamann Sandaluk LLP is a Toronto immigration law firm acting on Canadian and U.S. immigration, refugee and enforcement matters.

Established in 1987 by Guidy Mamann, the firm is led with partner Joel Sandaluk, who heads its litigation and enforcement group. It works from 103 Church Street, Suite 200, and handles Express Entry, family sponsorship, work and study permits, provincial nominee applications, refugee claims and appeals, detention and deportation matters and immigration appeals. Lawyers and staff work in languages including French, Arabic, Farsi, Hebrew, Hindi and Amharic.
manbir-sodhi-brampton:
Manbir Sodhi Criminal Defence Law is a downtown Brampton criminal defence practice, in operation since 2000 and founded by lawyers including Manbir Sodhi.

The practice works from Unit 102 at 9 George Street North and handles criminal defence matters only, including impaired and dangerous driving, domestic and sexual assault, weapons and drug charges, theft and fraud, youth offences and bail hearings for Peel Region clients, in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu.
mandall-immigration-law-toronto:
Mandall Immigration Law is a Toronto immigration law firm founded by Austin Mandall Rooplall, acting for clients across Canada.

Rooplall holds a JD from the University of Ottawa and is a member of the Canadian Immigration Lawyers Association. Associates Paran Singh, Bradley Rees and Benjamin Cohen-Murison and regulated immigration consultant Yulia Kan work with him from offices at 763 Bay Street in Toronto and in Ottawa. The firm handles work and study permits, permanent residence, spousal and family sponsorship, citizenship, humanitarian applications, inadmissibility, appeals and Federal Court judicial review, in English, Hindi, Punjabi, French and Arabic.
mandeep-saggi-criminal-lawyer:
Mandeep Saggi Criminal Lawyer is a Brampton criminal defence practice, also operating as Saggi Law Firm, acting in DUI, drug, assault and fraud cases.

Mandeep Saggi was called to the Ontario bar in 2009 and is a member of the Law Society of Ontario, appearing at the Brampton Courthouse, the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice. The practice handles impaired driving, drug offences, assault, domestic violence, theft, fraud, youth criminal justice, firearms and bail hearings for clients in Brampton, Mississauga, Vaughan, Etobicoke, Oshawa, Newmarket and the Greater Toronto Area, in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
mann-law-calgary:
Mann Law is a Calgary law practice handling criminal defence, personal injury, family law and real estate matters.

Founded by Ramanjit Mann, who was called to the Alberta bar in 2013 after earning an LLB from the University of Leicester in 2012 and starting out with a small group of Calgary lawyers, the practice serves Calgary and surrounding communities including Airdrie, Canmore, Cochrane, Red Deer and Edmonton in English, Hindi and Punjabi.
mann-lawyers-llp:
Mann Lawyers LLP is a full-service Ottawa law firm handling corporate, family, employment, estates and real estate matters.

The firm's lawyers include Ted Mann, Christopher Arnold, Heather Austin-Skaret, Daniella Sicoli-Zupo, Nigel McCready and Cherolyn Knapp. Its practice covers corporate law, family law, labour and employment, wills and probate, real estate and personal injury for a diverse clientele of individuals and businesses.
mansoor-law-oakville:
Mansoor Law is an Oakville firm that handles real estate transactions, wills and trusts, and probate. Since it began, the firm has served over 1,000 clients, acted on $250 million worth of real estate transactions and created 350 estate plans.

A matter begins with a meeting to discuss needs in real estate, wills or probate, followed by a tailored legal strategy and a detailed examination of documents, from property titles to wills, including compliance checks and client updates. The firm then manages the final steps, whether a real estate closing or the execution of wills and probate. It is located on Oak Park Boulevard.
manucci-allen-llp-edmonton:
Manucci Allen LLP is an Edmonton firm that practises family law and criminal defence for clients across Alberta.

Its lawyers are Cristian Manucci, Lonnie Allen, Danny Fayad, Adam Shaben and Sam Sekhon. Manucci studied law at the University of New Brunswick and Allen holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Manitoba. The office is at 10080 Jasper Avenue, Suite 801.
maqbool-law-toronto:
Maqbool Law is a Scarborough law firm established in 2016, handling real estate, wills and estates, corporate and insolvency matters.

The firm operates as Maqbool Law Professional Corporation and is run by sole lawyer Ali Maqbool, who spent 15 years at the Ontario Ministry of the Attorney General, including as a supervisor of court operations, before entering private practice. He is a member of the Law Society of Ontario, the Ontario Bar Association, the Canadian Bar Association and the South Asian Bar Association, and the firm keeps a satellite office in Niagara Falls. Services include residential and commercial real estate, wills, powers of attorney, elder law, corporate and business law, and bankruptcy and insolvency, in English, Urdu, Hindi and Punjabi.
marc-andre-letarte-avocat-inc:
Marc-Andre Letarte, Avocat inc is a Trois-Rivieres practice that handles family law only, from separation and divorce to child custody and support.

Operating as Letarte Avocat, the practice has worked since 2006 and has represented more than a thousand clients across the province. It acts in the Superior Court on separation and divorce, and seeks judgments or negotiated settlements on child custody and parenting time, child and spousal support, division of assets and parental authority. The team includes Mathilde Milot-Beauchesne and Marc-André Letarte, with experience in litigation and pleading.
marc-sabourin-montreal:
Marc Sabourin is a Lachine lawyer in Montreal handling family and civil law matters, from divorce and custody to child support.

Me Sabourin practises on his own from 68 7e Avenue in Lachine. His family work covers divorce, custody, child support, collaborative law and mediation, alongside civil law and immigration matters such as temporary visas, permanent residency and citizenship. He serves individuals and families in French and English.
mariana-samaan-law-firm:
Mariana Samaan Law Firm is a Windsor solo practice handling real estate, wills and estates, corporate matters and uncontested divorce.

Led by lawyer Mariana Samaan, the firm works from 635 Erie Street East and handles residential and commercial real estate, wills and estate planning, business and contract law and notary services. Clients are served in English and Arabic, and the practice acts for individuals, families and businesses in Windsor, Essex County and nearby communities such as Tecumseh, LaSalle and Chatham.
marin-immigration-law-ottawa:
Ottawa's Marin Immigration Law handles citizenship by descent, Express Entry and sponsorship applications for families around the world.

Founded in 2023, the firm pairs its lawyers with an in-house genealogist who locates family records for citizenship by descent applications, including those under Bill C-3. It also prepares work and study permits, files reconsideration requests, and brings Federal Court applications to overturn IRCC refusals, as well as mandamus applications. The lawyers work in English and French and are licensed by the Law Society of Ontario.
mark-chiu-law-kelowna:
Mark Chiu Law is a Kelowna practice handling family law and criminal law matters in the Okanagan, the Kootenays and elsewhere in British Columbia.

The lawyer behind Mark J. Chiu Law Corp, Mark Chiu, has practised in British Columbia since 2014 and holds degrees in psychology from the University of Calgary and law from the University of Saskatchewan. He is also certified as a family law mediator through the Law Society of British Columbia. He has acted for the Public Prosecution Service of Canada, as defence counsel in serious matters, and in family cases involving the Family Maintenance Enforcement Program and the Ministry of Children and Family Development. Family work includes dividing property held through corporations or trusts and parenting disputes involving alienation.
mark-graham-law-office:
Mark Graham Law Office is a Guelph real estate and estates law practice led by sole practitioner Mark Graham.

Mark Graham holds a law degree from Western. The practice works from 137 Norfolk Street in Guelph, with a second office in Waterdown, and handles residential, commercial and farm real estate, private mortgages and refinancing, wills and powers of attorney, and estate administration for homebuyers, sellers, lenders and families in Guelph, Wellington County and Waterdown, in English.
marshall-law:
Marshall Law is a Toronto firm representing people in employment, human rights, harassment and sexual assault matters against employers, unions and governments.

The lawyers are Rebecca Curcio, Chase Frazer, Michelle Palmeri and Amrit Sohi, and their work includes wrongful termination, constructive dismissal and executive compensation. Intake starts with a support team member who gathers key information, followed by a one-hour or thirty-minute meeting with a lawyer, held over Zoom or in person depending on the case. The process is confidential, and the firm crafts a strategy tailored to each client. It also works beyond Ontario.
martineau-daoust-boulianne-pelletier-avo:
Martineau Daoust Boulianne Pelletier Avocats is a law firm founded in 2009 serving Rouyn-Noranda and Ville-Marie in Quebec’s Abitibi-Témiscamingue region.

Its six lawyers, with Michel-Étienne Parayre as primary contact, advise individuals and businesses in the region on civil, family, criminal and business law, mining law, civil liability, insurance, administrative law, bankruptcy, labour relations, real estate and personal injury matters.
marwah-law-ottawa:
Marwah Law is an Ottawa law firm covering business, real estate, immigration and estate matters, with notary and paralegal services.

Yaman Marwah founded the firm in 2016 after several years practising on Bay Street in Toronto. Hisham Marwah serves as senior counsel with more than 40 years in law, and Sammy Alroub is a lawyer on a team that also includes paralegals, a notary and a senior immigration consultant. mast-avocats-quebec:
MAST Avocats Quebec is a Quebec City law firm founded by Sarah April and Mélanie Tremblay, with family law as its main practice.

The firm works from Suite 410 at 5600 boulevard des Galeries and acts for individuals and families in family law, youth law, business law, civil litigation, immigration and criminal defence matters, with services in English and French.
mat-schwartz-criminal-law-winnipeg:
Mat Schwartz Criminal Law is a Winnipeg criminal defence practice led by lawyer Mat Schwartz, who appears at all levels of court in Manitoba.

Mat Schwartz holds a law degree from the University of Manitoba and practises with the Rees Dyck Rogala firm at 155 Carlton Street. The practice covers drug offences, domestic violence, impaired driving, assault, sexual offences, theft and youth criminal justice for clients in Winnipeg and across Manitoba.
mathieu-di-lullo-montreal:
Mathieu Di Lullo is a Montreal immigration lawyer who heads MDL Immigration, a practice focused on Canadian immigration and citizenship law.

From 5505 Monkland Avenue, the practice handles Express Entry, skilled workers, the Canadian Experience Class, LMIA and temporary foreign workers, NAFTA and USMCA permits, business visitors, intra-company transfers, study permits, extensions, Quebec CAQ, post-graduation work permits and citizenship, and has practised immigration law since 2012.
matthew-feehan-estate-lawyer-edmonton:
Matthew Feehan Estate Lawyer is an Edmonton estate law practice led by lawyer Matthew Feehan, continuing the Feehan Law Office tradition established in 1950.

The practice works from 10160 118 Street NW and handles wills and probate, probate applications, grants of administration, estate litigation, powers of attorney, personal directives and residential real estate for seniors, adult children and personal representatives in Greater Edmonton, in English.
matthew-gould-criminal-law-winnipeg:
Matthew Gould Criminal Law is a Winnipeg criminal defence practice led by trial lawyer Matthew Gould, who was called to the Manitoba bar in 2008.

From Suite 1212 at 363 Broadway, the practice handles impaired driving, drug offences, violent and domestic offences, property offences, fraud and white-collar charges, youth matters and bail hearings. Matthew Gould is also listed as a partner at Brodsky Amy & Gould at the same address.
matthew-m-granic-and-assoc-toronto:
Matthew Granic has practised law in Toronto since 2001, handling immigration applications and criminal defence through Matthew M Granic & Assoc. The office serves clients in the Greater Toronto Area.

He graduated in law from the University of Windsor in 1999 and works from an office at Gerrard Street East and Pape Avenue, practising in association with the long-established Sharma law office. His practice includes humanitarian and compassionate applications and the defence of criminal and regulatory charges, with attention to the immigration consequences of facing charges. He manages each file personally, and flexible fee rates and payment plans are offered. He is a member of the Law Society of Ontario, the Toronto Lawyers Association and the Criminal Lawyers' Association.
mawazini-visa-and-immigration-services-o:
Mawazini Visa and Immigration Services is an Ottawa consultancy assisting with refugee protection, family sponsorship, study and work permits and appeals.

It is an immigration consulting firm led by Abdullah Mawazini, a licensed consultant accredited by the Canadian College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants, with over 22 years of experience and hundreds of completed cases. Services include refugee applications and hearings, appeals of refused applications, sponsorship of spouses, parents and children, passport services, permanent residence, PR cards, visit applications, academic accreditation reports, and RCMP fingerprints and biometrics. The address is in Nepean.
maxime-lapointe-associes-inc:
Maxime Lapointe & Associés inc. is a Québec City boutique law firm practising immigration law exclusively.

Maxime Lapointe leads the firm, which acts for private companies, institutional organizations, business people and individuals immigrating to Canada, locally and abroad. Its practice covers business and investor immigration, permanent residence, work permits, family sponsorship, study permits, temporary residence, visitor visas, compliance and international recruitment, in French and Spanish.
maynes-and-radovici-edmonton:
Maynes & Radovici is an Edmonton boutique litigation firm that acts for injured people and other civil claimants, with criminal defence also listed.

Partners Michael Maynes and Eliza Maynes lead the firm, which acts only for injured victims and does not represent insurance companies, large corporations or at-fault drivers in motor vehicle accidents. Its lawyers are members of the Alberta Civil Trial Lawyers Association, and its site also covers Calgary and Red Deer. The office is on the 14th floor of First Edmonton Place, 10665 Jasper Avenue.
mbaa-law-professional-corporation-oshawa:
MBAA Law Professional Corporation is a full-service Oshawa law firm with roots in the early 1900s, serving Durham Region.

Named for McGibbon, Bastedo, Armstrong and Armstrong, the firm works from 73 Centre Street South, where lawyers Michael Armstrong, Mark Armstrong and Alex Henderson practise. Its practice covers residential and commercial real estate, wills, estates and trusts, corporate and business law, employment law and notary services, in English.
mbbm-lawyers-llp:
MBBM Lawyers LLP is a Toronto litigation firm handling commercial and civil disputes, trucking and auto litigation, accident benefits and insurance matters.

The firm acts for insurers, corporations, small businesses and individuals, with lawyers in downtown Toronto and an office in Calgary. Its areas include loss transfer and priority disputes, examinations under oath, cargo claims, property claims and coverage opinions. Its lawyers act before all levels of court in Ontario, the Licence Appeal Tribunal and private arbitrations, and are available to attend an accident scene. Recent articles discuss flawed outside reports in litigation and the case of McFee v. Sutram.
mbl-avocats-inc:
MBL Avocats is a Drummondville, Quebec law firm led by avocat Bruno Lapierre, advising on family and civil law.

Operating from 289 Rue Marchand, the firm’s two lawyers, Bruno Lapierre, a member of the Barreau du Québec since 2012, and Cynthia Marcil, handle family law, civil law, youth protection, business and corporate law and administrative law, including CNESST, SAAQ and social assistance matters. Clients are served in French, in person by appointment or virtually.
mccague-borlack-llp:
McCague Borlack LLP is a Toronto law firm established in 1994, with offices in Ottawa, Kitchener, Barrie and London.

Founded by Paul McCague, David Wires and Howard Borlack and renamed McCague Borlack LLP in 2009, the firm advises on insurance law, personal injury, civil litigation and dispute resolution, class actions, employment and labour, bankruptcy and insolvency, family law, wills, estates and trusts, landlord and tenant, administrative and regulatory law and intellectual property. Clients include insurers, manufacturers, banks, real estate developers, hospitals, municipalities, nonprofits and individuals, served in English, French, German, Greek and Polish.
mccarthy-t-trault-llp:
McCarthy Tétrault LLP has an office in Toronto, Ontario, at 66 Wellington St W, Suite 5300.

The firm operates under the name McCarthy Tétrault LLP in Toronto, Ontario. No practice areas, lawyers, industries or matters are recorded for this office, so this entry gives only the firm's name, city, province and street address rather than guessing at further detail.
mccarthy-t-trault-llp-calgary:
McCarthy Tétrault LLP operates a Calgary office at 421 7 Avenue SW, Suite 4000, part of a national full-service law firm.
