The firm also has offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, Quebec City and London, England.
mccrea-immigration-law-vancouver:
McCrea Immigration Law is a Vancouver immigration law firm led by partners Meika Lalonde and Ryan Neely.

Associate counsel Chi-Young Lee and associate Silvia Macedo practise with the partners from Suite 205 at 560 Beatty Street. The firm handles Canadian immigration matters including work permits, permanent residence, citizenship and compliance strategy for corporate and individual clients, in English and Portuguese.
mccuaig-desrochers-llp-edmonton:
McCuaig Desrochers LLP is an Edmonton firm and successor to one of the oldest law practices in the area, with origins dating to 1895.

The firm's history begins when Alexander Cameron Rutherford arrived from Ontario and set up a law office at the railhead of the Calgary and Edmonton Railway. Its practice areas include construction, administrative and municipal law, landlord and tenant law, and debtor and creditor matters.
mcelderry-morris:
McElderry & Morris is a Guelph, Ontario law firm established in 1921, advising on litigation, real estate, corporate and estate matters.

The firm’s three lawyers are Sergio Manera, who handles real estate, business and estates, Patrick Morris, who handles litigation, and Gregory Matthews, who handles corporate matters. Its practice covers civil litigation, personal injury, family law, real estate, corporate and commercial law, wills and estates and estate planning for people, families and businesses in Guelph and southwestern Ontario, in English.
mcelroy-law-ottawa:
McElroy Law is a boutique Ottawa criminal defence law firm founded in August 2015 by Anne-Marie McElroy.

McElroy was called to the Ontario bar in 2010 after earning a law degree from the University of Ottawa in 2009, and associate Dawn Dickinson also practises with the firm. The firm defends domestic assault, impaired driving, sexual offence, youth justice, theft and fraud charges and handles Charter challenges and appeals for individuals across Eastern Ontario, in English and French.
mcintosh-and-zayed-s-r-l-winnipeg:
McIntosh & Zayed s.r.l. is a Winnipeg law firm focused on immigration and refugee law, acting for refugee claimants and sponsored families.

Stephen A. McIntosh is the founder, Philip A. Zayed is a partner and Salma El-Khodari is an associate, and the firm's lawyers regularly represent refugee claimants before the Immigration and Refugee Board. Its work covers asylum claims, appeals, Federal Court judicial review, family sponsorship and permanent residence, along with real estate, business, wills and estates and notary services, in English, French, Arabic and Spanish for clients in Manitoba and beyond.
mckenzie-lake-lawyers-llp:
McKenzie Lake Lawyers LLP is a London, Ontario law firm formed in 1998 by merger, with additional offices in Guelph and Strathroy.

The firm was formed by the merger of Ross, Bennett Lake and McKenzie Nash Bryant, with roots reaching back to the 1930s, and its roughly 52 lawyers work from 140 Fullarton Street in London, with Matthew Villeneuve as managing partner since 2023; Chinneck Law merged into the firm in 2022. Its practice covers business and corporate law, civil and commercial litigation, class actions, personal injury, family law, real estate, wills and estates, tax, employment and labour, health law, Indigenous law, insurance, agricultural and administrative law.
mclaren-bryan-law-professional-corporati:
McLaren Bryan Law is a Peterborough practice handling residential and commercial real estate, immigration, wills and estates, and family law.

Chantal McLaren Bryan is the founder and principal lawyer, and the team brings over 14 years of legal experience across several practice areas. Real estate work covers acquisitions, dispositions, financing and leasing. Immigration work includes applications, sponsorships and status matters for individuals and families, while estate services include planning, administration and litigation. Family law support is also offered. The office is at 398 McDonnel Street, Unit 4, in Peterborough.
mcleish-orlando-lawyers-llp:
McLeish Orlando Lawyers LLP is a Toronto personal injury law firm established in 1999, acting for seriously injured people and bereaved families.

Principal partners John McLeish, Dale Orlando and Patrick Brown lead the firm, alongside partners Salvatore Shaw, Joseph Cescon, Lindsay Charles and Nick Todorovic, with further offices in Barrie, Hamilton, Kitchener, Sault Ste. Marie and St. Catharines. Its work covers brain and spinal cord injury, orthopaedic injury, wrongful death, motor vehicle accidents, medical malpractice, nursing home negligence, product and premises liability, long-term disability and insurance and fire loss claims, with service in languages including French, Cantonese, Mandarin, Punjabi, Hindi, Arabic and Spanish.
mclennan-ross-llp:
McLennan Ross LLP is an Edmonton firm acting for corporations, governments and public bodies in employment, municipal and litigation matters. The firm works from a base in Alberta and the Northwest Territories for clients across Canada, including not-for-profit organizations.

It has a management-side labour and employment practice, a litigation team and a corporate commercial group, and its lawyers have taken part in cases at every level of the Canadian courts, including the Supreme Court of Canada. Current topics include a workplace investigations webinar series and commentary on Alberta's Bill 11 and employee group benefits plans. The office is on Stony Plain Road NW.
mcnally-gervan-lawyers-llp-ottawa:
McNally Gervan Lawyers LLP is an Ottawa personal injury firm that acts for people hurt in serious accidents, including motor vehicle and motorcycle collisions.

The firm focuses on serious personal injury cases, and its lawyers have represented hundreds of people after accidents of many kinds. Its practice covers motor vehicle matters and motorcycle accidents in Ottawa, including damages such as pain and suffering and loss of income. McNally Gervan represents individuals across Eastern Ontario and serves Ontario generally.
mcquarrie:
McQuarrie is a Surrey multi-practice law firm handling business law, land development, insurance denials and estates for clients since 1967.

Its main office is in the Central City Tower in downtown Surrey, with meeting space in Burnaby and Vancouver by appointment, and it serves businesses, individuals and institutions across the Lower Mainland, the Fraser Valley and British Columbia. The firm sponsors community causes and gives to charity. Its practice areas also include family law, and its articles cover injurious affection, resulting trusts and British Columbia's prompt payment law for the construction industry.
mctague-law-firm-llp:
McTague Law Firm LLP is a Windsor, Ontario general practice law firm established in 1920.

The firm merged in 1967 with Whiteside, Coughlin & Whiteside and operates from its own building at 455 Pelissier Street, built in 1981. Its roughly twenty lawyers, including partners Josephine Stark, Jeffrey MacKinnon, David Amyot and Nancy Jammu-Taylor, advise on business and corporate law, civil and commercial litigation, employment and labour, wills and estates, real estate, taxation, insurance, personal injury and municipal law.
md-law-group-edmonton:
MD LAW GROUP is an Edmonton law firm founded in 2015, handling family, criminal, employment and immigration matters.

Daniel Murphy and Harjot Dhillon are among the firm's lawyers, which works from 10123 99 Street NW in Edmonton and has a second office in Calgary. Its practice covers family law, criminal defence, employment, civil litigation, immigration, wills and estates, estate planning, personal injury, real estate and notarial services for individuals, families and businesses across Alberta and the Northwest Territories, in English.

Family law and immigration clients in Montreal and Laval are served by Me Bachar Khader, in French and Arabic.

Immigration work covers refugee protection and asylum applications, the Quebec Selection Certificate (CSQ) and federal economic immigration through Express Entry, including its points system and category-based draws, as well as Quebec's separate selection system. Files are handled in steps: listening to the client's situation, assessing the file, setting out next steps and following developments through to the objective, with adjustments when circumstances change. The office is on Rue de Salaberry.
me-celina-st-francois-avocate-criminalis:
Célina St-Francois is a criminal defence lawyer in Granby, Quebec, with an office at 125 Boulevard Leclerc Est.

me-chiraz-ouni-montreal:
Chiraz Ouni Avocate is a Montreal immigration and family law practice at 9440 boulevard de l’Acadie.

Ouni, a graduate of the École du Barreau with a law certificate from Université de Montréal, also handles general civil law, litigation and insurance matters and offers limited-scope and flat-fee mandates. She assists new arrivals with immigration procedures in Quebec in French, English and Arabic.
me-isabelle-roy-avocate:
Me Isabelle Roy is a Sherbrooke family law lawyer handling divorce, separation, custody and support matters.

Isabelle Roy practises from 991 rue de Gibraltar, bureau 2, and handles divorce and separation, child custody, support and youth protection, along with matrimonial, labour and civil law matters, for clients in Sherbrooke and the surrounding area, in French.
me-jonathan-boivin-saint-jerome:
Jonathan Boivin Avocat is a solo criminal defence practice in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec, run by criminal defence lawyer Jonathan Boivin.

Boivin was called to the Barreau du Québec in 2007, began his career with Quebec’s Director of Criminal and Penal Prosecutions, and entered private practice in 2012. He handles criminal and penal law and administrative law matters, including trials, jury trials and appeals, and serves clients in French.
me-louis-r-lupien:
Me Louis Lupien has a law office at 3367 Rue Papineau in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec.

The full name is Me Louis R. Lupien. No practice areas or description are recorded for the lawyer, and for that reason no services, languages or courts are stated, so this entry is limited to the name, the city and the street address.
me-marc-andre-blain-jurimab:
Me Marc-Andre Blain (Jurimab) is a business law practice in Laval, Quebec, at 3030 Boulevard Curé-Labelle, Suite 300.

The practice carries a business law practice tag and the name Jurimab. Services, clients and approach are not described here, so this entry gives only the lawyer's name, practice area, city and office address.
me-melanie-brochu-avocate:
Me Melanie Brochu, Avocate, practises criminal law in Longueuil, Quebec, from an office at 2127 Chemin de Chambly.

Her practice is known as Avocate Droit Criminel Longueuil and serves the Montérégie region. A Granby practice with the same name also exists. The offences and courts involved are not described, so criminal defence in Longueuil is the extent of what is stated here.
me-melanie-brochu-droit-criminel-granby:
Mélanie Brochu is a criminal defence lawyer (avocate criminaliste) in Granby, Quebec, serving Granby and surrounding communities.

A member of the Barreau du Québec, she defends impaired driving, sexual assault, drug offences, cannabis production and exportation, computer fraud and fraud, assault and domestic violence, indecent acts, breach of conditions, mischief and theft charges, as well as tickets and bylaw offences, in French and English.
me-nabil-ben-naoum-avocat:
Me Nabil Ben-Naoum, Avocat is a Montréal criminal and penal defence practice acting for accused individuals across Greater Montréal.

Nabil Ben-Naoum is a member of the Barreau du Québec and has practised exclusively in criminal law since 2019, from an office at 20 rue Saint-Paul Ouest, Suite 203. His work covers impaired driving, theft and fraud, assault and sexual offences, drug and weapons offences, youth criminal justice, bail hearings and traffic and penal infractions, in French, English and Arabic.
me-sylvain-bissonnette-mediateur-familia:
Médiation Familiale, Me Sylvain Bissonnette is a Terrebonne family mediation practice run by lawyer and family mediator Sylvain Bissonnette.

From bureau 203 at 4583 rue des Fleurs, the practice handles family mediation, divorce and separation, child custody, support payments, youth protection, elder law, succession and incapacity matters for French-speaking clients in Terrebonne and the Lanaudière region.
me-valerie-la-madeleine-avocate:
Valérie La Madeleine Avocate is a criminal and penal defence practice in Longueuil, Quebec, now practising alongside Christine Brosseau.

La Madeleine was admitted to the Barreau du Québec in 2006, began as a solo criminal defence lawyer in Montreal, and moved her practice to the Longueuil district in 2013. The firm defends impaired driving, domestic violence, sexual offence, drug and fraud charges, youth matters and appeals, and handles record suspensions, mainly for first-time offenders across the South Shore and Greater Montreal, in French and English.
mehrez-law-ottawa:
From its Kanata office in Ottawa, Mehrez Law handles business law, employment law, immigration and litigation for clients in Ontario and Quebec. The firm was founded in Ottawa and combines legal training from several jurisdictions with local knowledge.

Its work covers business transactions, litigation and dispute resolution, employment matters for employers and employees, and immigration to Canada. A fractional legal counsel service gives businesses on-demand access to lawyers licensed in Ontario and Québec for contracts, employment questions, litigation risk and immigration issues. Clients include individuals, families and corporations, and the firm also serves people internationally.
meighen-haddad-llp-brandon:
Meighen Haddad LLP is a Brandon law firm at 110 11th Street, handling construction, corporate, real estate, employment and litigation matters.

The firm’s lawyers include Warren Barber, Derek Cullen, Patrick Sullivan, Trent Sholdice, Karen Beauchamp, Elia Arraf and Blair Filyk, and its practice covers construction, corporate and commercial law, real estate, employment, labour, human rights, intellectual property, criminal, family, estates and trusts and civil litigation.
melanie-lord-gatineau:
Mélanie Lord is a bilingual criminal defence lawyer in Gatineau, Quebec, practising with Lafleur and Associates at 137 Rue Wellington.

Admitted to the bar in 2007, Lord defends DUI and impaired driving, domestic violence, assault, theft and fraud charges, handles youth criminal justice and mental health law matters, and represents individuals charged with offences across Eastern Ontario and the National Capital Region in English and French.
menneh-legal-s-a:
Menneh Legal is a bilingual Montreal firm advising businesses and individuals on business law, litigation, civil law and commercial real estate. It also handles finance and lending work for borrowers and lenders, and trademark disputes over brand names, logos and trade dress, across Quebec.

The firm was founded by Rita Menneh, a member of the Barreau du Québec, who holds three degrees from McGill University, two in law and one in engineering. She began her legal career at Herzog Fox & Neeman in Israel. The firm acts as outsourced in-house counsel and offers fixed-scope programs for new and growing businesses, in English and French.
menon-b-droit-des-arts:
MENON B - Droit des Arts is a Sherbrooke boutique law practice focused on arts, music and entertainment law.

Bertrand Menon is a lawyer and a former touring musician of more than a decade. From 41 rue King Ouest, Suite 3, the practice handles music contracts including recording, publishing, management, producer and performance agreements, copyright, trademark, licensing and royalties, and business formation for artists and labels. Clients include musicians, performing artists, independent labels, festivals and cultural organizations across Quebec and internationally, in French and English.
merchant-law-group-llp-surrey:
Merchant Law Group LLP is a national law firm founded by Tony Merchant, with a Surrey office handling class action, injury and family matters.

Its practice covers class action litigation, motor vehicle accidents, divorce and family law, high-net-worth divorce, criminal defence, residential real estate and business incorporation for individuals and businesses, in English, Mandarin and Punjabi.
meridian-law-group-vancouver:
Meridian Law Group is a downtown Vancouver law firm founded in 1988, practising from the Nelson Square building at 808 Nelson Street.

merovitz-potechin-llp-ottawa:
Merovitz Potechin LLP is an Ottawa law firm founded in 1976 by Chuck Merovitz, handling litigation, real estate and business matters.

Its practice covers civil and commercial litigation, real estate, business and corporate law, employment and labour, insolvency and bankruptcy, and wills, trusts and estates for businesses, developers, institutions and individuals across Ottawa and Eastern Ontario.
metro-law-office:
Metro Law Office is a Burnaby law firm and notary practice handling real estate, family, estates, business and immigration matters.

meunier-carrier-lawyers:
Meunier Carrier Lawyers is a Timmins civil litigation firm founded in 2020, handling personal injury, family and employment matters.

The boutique firm works from 151 Second Avenue and serves clients across Ontario. Its practice covers personal injury including motor vehicle accidents, slip and fall and dog bites, disability claims, insurance disputes, wrongful death, family law, employment law and civil litigation.
mg-law-personal-injury-lawyers-ottawa:
MG Law is an Ottawa personal injury firm handling car accident, catastrophic injury and insurance matters.

The firm has served injury victims since 2009. Its team speaks English, French, Greek, Mandarin, Russian, Spanish, Ukrainian, Punjabi, Hindi and several Arabic dialects, so clients can explain their situation in their own language. The firm focuses on personal injury and helps with insurance matters and financial issues that follow an accident, including cases with life-altering consequences.
mian-hakeem-law-professional-corporation:
Mian Hakeem Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga law firm founded in 2021 and led by barrister Mian Abdul Hakeem.

The firm works from 5805 Whittle Road and handles immigration, real estate, family law, business and corporate law, wills and estates, and notary and commissioner services for individuals, families and businesses, mainly immigration and real estate clients, in English, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu.
michael-a-wills-windsor:
Michael A Wills is a Windsor labour and employment lawyer called to the Ontario bar in 1997.

Michael Wills holds an LL.B. and a B.A. from the University of Calgary and is a member of the Essex Law Association. Directories list the practice at 2557 Dougall Avenue in Windsor and an association with McTague Law Firm LLP, with a focus on labour law, employment law and management-side labour law.
michael-dibua-law-prof-corp-brampton:
Michael Dibua Law Prof Corp. is a Brampton sole practice led by Michael Dibua, handling family law and civil litigation.

Dibua earned his law degree at Obafemi Awolowo University in 1997, was called to the Nigerian bar in 1999, completed an LL.M. at Cardiff University in 2004 and was later called to the Ontario bar, having previously worked as in-house counsel in banking. He is a member of the Law Society of Ontario and is on the Legal Aid Ontario roster. His practice covers divorce, separation, child and spousal support, property division, parenting arrangements, breach of contract, small claims, mortgage, real estate and partnership disputes in Peel Region and the Greater Toronto Area, in English, Igbo and Yoruba.
michael-dyck-criminal-law-winnipeg:
Michael Dyck Criminal Law is a Winnipeg criminal defence practice led by lawyer Michael Dyck, who was called to the Manitoba bar in 2012.

From Suite 1640 at 155 Carlton Street, the practice handles impaired driving, domestic assault, drug charges and bail hearings in Winnipeg and Steinbach. Michael Dyck is also listed as a partner at Rees Dyck Rogala Law Offices at the same address.
michael-juskey-toronto:
Michael Juskey is a Toronto criminal defence lawyer representing clients charged with assault, theft, fraud, young offender and driving offences.

michele-madick-law-corporation-winnipeg:
Michele Madick Law Corporation is a Winnipeg boutique law practice established in 1980 in the 55 Nassau complex in Osborne Village.

Lawyer Michele Madick, a University of Manitoba graduate called to the Manitoba bar in 1979, handles wills and estates, residential real estate, powers of attorney, health care directives, probate and mobile legal services for Winnipeg and Manitoba residents, in English.
mickelson-whysall-moore-law-group:
Mickelson, Whysall & Moore Law Group is a Vancouver firm that defends people charged with criminal and driving offences.

mike-beckett-law-surrey:
Mike Beckett Law is a Surrey criminal defence practice acting for people charged with or under investigation for criminal offences. mikhael-avocat-inc-montreal:
Mikhael Avocat Inc. is a Montreal law firm led by founder Marianne Mikhael, handling immigration and family law matters.

millars-lawyers-london-london:
Millars Lawyers London is a full-service law firm in London, Ontario, founded by former Crown Attorney and military veteran Phillip Millar.

millennium-law-chambers-calgary:
Millennium Law Chambers is a Calgary law firm led by founder P M Menon Parakkal, handling personal injury, criminal defence and immigration matters.

The practice works from Unit 104 at 350 Rutherford Road South and handles bail hearings and defends charges including assault and domestic assault, impaired driving, drug offences, fraud, theft, robbery, firearms and weapons offences, sexual offences and youth crime for clients across Brampton and Ontario, in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
nirwan-law-corporation-surrey:
Nirwan Law Corporation is a Surrey personal injury firm handling car, pedestrian, bicycle and motorcycle accidents and slip and falls. Founded in 2014, the firm acts for people injured through someone else's negligence.

It operates from two head offices, one in British Columbia and one in Washington state, and its lawyers are licensed to practise in British Columbia, Alberta, Washington, Texas and other American jurisdictions. The firm handles each case from the first meeting with a client through to litigation.
nk-lawyers-professional-corporation-nort:
NK Lawyers Professional Corporation is a North York practice handling immigration and real estate law, led by Nilofar Ahmadi and Khesrau Ahmadi.

Both lawyers are barristers, solicitors and notaries public with law degrees from the University of Ottawa, and the practice works from the Madison Centre at 4950 Yonge Street, Suite 2200. Its immigration work covers family sponsorship, Super Visa, Express Entry, provincial nominee applications, refugee hearings and Federal Court judicial reviews, while its real estate work covers purchases, sales, refinances and title insurance. Service is available in English, Dari, Farsi and Urdu.
nolan-ciarlo-llp:
Nolan, Ciarlo LLP is a Hamilton law firm established in 1915, handling business, real estate, employment and litigation matters.

Partner Dermot Nolan and senior partner John Nolan practise from Suite 700 at 1 King Street West. The firm’s practice covers business law, real estate, employment law, civil litigation, personal injury and wills and estates for individuals and businesses in Hamilton.
nolan-persaud:
Nolan Persaud is an Oshawa law firm renamed in 2023 under managing lawyers Helen Nolan and Aruna Persaud, with roots dating to 1992.

The firm traces its history to Elliott & Hughes and later Hills Nolan and works from 106 Stevenson Road South. Its practice covers family law, real estate and wills and estates for Oshawa and Durham Region individuals and families, with criminal law also handled by one of its lawyers, in English.
non-coupable-longueuil:
In Longueuil, Non Coupable defends criminal and penal charges at trial and on appeal, from statements of offence to murder cases.

Operating as Elayoubi Raymond, the firm has been in practice since 2002 and takes only criminal and penal files. Its lawyers appear before the municipal court, the Court of Quebec, the Superior Court, the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court. Areas include impaired driving by alcohol or drugs, crimes against the person, sexual offences, economic crime, drug offences, youth cases and appeals. Lawyers are available around the clock in an arrest or emergency, and the firm covers greater Montreal and most judicial districts of the North Shore and South Shore.
noohi-law-north-york:
Noohi Law is a North York personal injury firm acting for people hurt in accidents, including slip and fall injuries. The firm has practised for over 23 years, offers legal advice, support and litigation across Canada, and provides its services in multiple languages. Its team includes Kathy Noohi and Ali Nobahar.

Its slip and fall work addresses injuries that follow a fall, including broken bones and traumatic brain injury, and the firm has handled slip and fall settlements for more than 20 years. Its office is on Sheppard Avenue East, and clients come from Toronto and elsewhere in Ontario.
nora-law-professional-corporation-london:
Nora Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario firm covering family, immigration and refugee, child protection and business law.

The firm acts for parents and caregivers in Children's Aid Society proceedings, and handles refugee protection cases, humanitarian applications, PRRA matters, sponsorships, work and study permits and permanent residence applications. Business services include incorporations, shareholder agreements and contract drafting. Nora Eze is licensed in Ontario and Nigeria and has anti-money laundering compliance certification, and Krupa Patel is also on the team. The firm offers direct access to counsel and careful preparation.
north-road-law-and-notary-public-burnaby:
North Road Law & Notary Public is a Burnaby firm handling home and business transactions, including real estate, business and corporate, and wills matters.

Managing partner Jenny Cho focuses on real estate, business and corporate law. Before joining the firm, Jenny practised corporate, business and U.S. immigration law as a New York-licensed lawyer in Seoul. The firm also offers notarial services.
northern-law-llp:
Northern Law LLP is a Greater Sudbury firm handling complex litigation, family and estate matters, and real estate, construction and property disputes.

The firm recently moved to 298 Larch Street. Spencer D.W. Ball is partner and Paul J. Frinak is associate, with Jordan E. Duplessis, Carly Harris, Bhishm Khanna and Morgan L. Zyma among its lawyers. Every file gets a team-based approach, with a focus on cost-effective service and access to justice and regular litigation against large corporations, insurance companies and municipalities. Its blog covers topics such as decision-making responsibility for parents after separation and dependant support claims in estate law.
norton-law-pc-oshawa:
Norton Law PC is an Oshawa criminal defence practice led by Steve Norton, representing people charged with offences across the Greater Toronto Area.

Steve Norton earned a Juris Doctor at Bond University while completing a master's in business administration in Australia, where he also clerked at criminal and commercial litigation firms. He holds a B.A. with honours from York University and is in good standing with the Law Society of Ontario and the Criminal Lawyers Association. Topics covered include bail hearings, police questioning, the presumption of innocence and the right to a bail hearing within 24 hours, with material for charges in Ajax and Richmond Hill.
norton-rose-fulbright-canada-llp:
Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP is the Canadian arm of a global law firm, based in Toronto and focused on energy, infrastructure, mining and defence.

Recent deal news includes a court-supervised sale of Ravines Senior Suites to Verve Senior Living, a management buyout of Brightstone Financial Group, and Altus Group's sale of its development advisory business to Newmark. Commentary addresses federal infrastructure approvals legislation, private investment in airports, defence procurement rules for Canadian companies, Bill C-39 and Ontario accessibility reporting. Practice topics include ESG and white-collar, regulatory and investigations work.
norton-rose-fulbright-canada-llp-calgary:
Norton Rose Fulbright Canada LLP operates a Calgary office at 400 3rd Avenue SW, part of a national business law firm.

The Calgary lawyers, including partners Marcus Archer, Aldo Argento and Crispin Arthur, advise on business law, banking and finance, securities, corporate law, mergers and acquisitions, commercial litigation, energy, tax, intellectual property, labour and employment, real estate, insolvency and Aboriginal law. The firm also has offices in Vancouver, Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal and Quebec City.
nspc-law-firm-ottawa:
NSPC Law Firm is an Ottawa general practice law firm founded by lawyer Nikolay Stanchulov, who holds a JD from the University of Ottawa.

Nikolay Stanchulov also holds a Master of International Affairs from Carleton University. The solo firm at 2417 Holly Lane handles business and corporate law, civil litigation and dispute resolution, personal injury, wills, estates and trusts, family law and immigration matters for clients across the Greater Ottawa area and elsewhere in Ontario.
nuraney-law-group-vancouver:
Nuraney Law Group is a boutique Vancouver firm handling corporate and commercial law, tax, and wills and estates for small businesses and individuals.

Managing partner Arif S. Nuraney established the firm in 2016. His work includes mergers and acquisitions, reorganizations, joint ventures, financings and due diligence for clients in hospitality, manufacturing, technology, construction, mining and infrastructure. He also acts for private equity and venture capital firms on investments. The firm has offices in downtown Vancouver and West Vancouver and serves clients across the Lower Mainland, including help with starting and incorporating a new business.
nyota-avocate:
Nyota Avocate is a Gatineau, Quebec law firm founded by Nancy Nyota, serving the Outaouais region.

Nancy Nyota and Yvette Meta practise civil litigation and dispute resolution, family law, criminal and penal law, administrative law, youth protection and immigration law. The firm also serves clients in Luskville and offers services in English, French, Lingala and Tshiluba.
oakley-family-law-calgary:
Oakley Family Law is a Calgary family law firm handling divorce, separation, property division and parenting matters.

The firm works from 3150 114 Avenue SE in southeast Calgary and acts for individuals and families on divorce and separation, property division, child support, parenting arrangements, protection orders and family mediation, with services available in English and Polish.
oatley-vigmond-personal-injury-lawyers-l:
Oatley Vigmond Personal Injury Lawyers LLP is a Barrie law firm founded by Roger Oatley in 1974, acting for injured plaintiffs.

The firm works from 151 Ferris Lane in Barrie with offices in Toronto, North York, Hamilton, Sudbury and North Bay, and its roughly 15 injury lawyers include James Vigmond, Karen Vigmond, Brian Cameron and Troy Lehman. It acts only for injured individuals and families in catastrophic and brain injury, spinal cord injury, orthopaedic injury, medical negligence, wrongful death and motor vehicle accident claims.
odele-law-group-ottawa:
Odele Law Group is an Ottawa firm in Orléans with a strong focus on family law, alongside corporate law and estate planning. Its approach puts people first, with legal service meant to be client-focused, transparent and approachable.

Lawyers take the time to listen to clients' concerns and goals before developing a customized strategy. The office is on Taylor Creek Drive in Orléans, and the firm serves families and businesses in the Ottawa area.
olalere-law-office-ottawa:
Olalere Law Office is an Ottawa immigration firm concentrating on appeals of refused applications and removal orders.

Appeals go before the Immigration and Refugee Board and the Federal Court. The practice dates to 2004 and is led by twin brothers Kehinde and Taiwo Olalere, who both studied law and political science at Carleton University. Appeal routes include the Immigration Appeal Division for refused sponsorships and the Refugee Appeal Division for negative refugee decisions. As a full-service firm it also handles family sponsorship, Express Entry, study and work permits, visitor visas, citizenship, humanitarian and compassionate applications and inadmissibility, and publishes selected decisions.
olena-chepil-and-lawyers-etobicoke:
Real estate, business and estate matters are the focus of Olena Chepil & Lawyers, an Etobicoke firm that also operates as Terralaw. Founded in 2020, the firm acts on residential and commercial property purchases, sales and financing, and prepares and negotiates commercial leases. Its corporate work covers business formation, structuring and legal compliance.

On the estates side it prepares wills and powers of attorney and assists with estate planning and administration. Notary services cover affidavits, statutory declarations and other documents. Jutland Road in Etobicoke is the firm's address, and clients include both individuals and businesses.
olex-legal-calgary:
Olex Legal is a Calgary law firm in Quarry Park, led by managing lawyer Bim Oluyemi and handling real estate, business and family matters.

Associate lawyer Richa Chahal practises alongside the managing lawyer from Suite 300 at 160 Quarry Park Boulevard SE. The firm's practice covers real estate, business and corporate law, family law, wills, estates and trusts, elder law and notary services for individuals, families and businesses across Alberta, including first-time home buyers and investors, in English, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu.
ols-avocats-en-droit-du-travail-labour-a:
OLS Avocats is a Montreal employment and labour law firm led by senior partner Susan Orenstein Little and partner Jeremy Little.

The firm works from Suite 950 at 2015 Peel Street and handles wrongful and executive dismissal, constructive dismissal, severance negotiation, workplace harassment and discrimination, employment contracts, CNESST proceedings and labour relations for employees, executives, employers, human resources departments and non-profits across Montreal, Laval, Longueuil, Sherbrooke, Lévis and the rest of Quebec, in English and French.
omar-hasan-al-zahid-toronto:
Omar Hasan Al Zahid is a barrister, solicitor and notary public in Scarborough, called to the Ontario bar in 2017.

The practice, established in 2017 as Omar Zahid Law Professional Corporation, works from Suite 201 at 2481 Kingston Road. It handles real estate law, corporate and commercial law, wills, estates and trusts, and mortgage enforcement.
one-family-law-edmonton-divorce-law-edmo:
One Family Law Edmonton Divorce Law is an Alberta family law firm offering a one-lawyer approach to amicable divorce.

Founded in 2023 by bilingual family lawyer Melissa Bourgeois and located at 10706 124 Street NW in Edmonton, the firm represents both spouses in amicable separations under a Law Society of Alberta Innovation Sandbox waiver. It handles separation agreements, uncontested divorce, parenting plans and child custody, child and spousal support and the equalized division of property, and offers mediation services in English and French.
onley-law-business-lawyers-oshawa:
Onley Law is an Oshawa, Ontario business law firm serving start-ups, software-as-a-service founders and established companies.

Founded by Robert Onley, who holds a JD from the University of Windsor, the firm has practised since 2018 from the Spark Centre business hub in downtown Oshawa. It handles business incorporations, commercial and SaaS contracts, privacy compliance, trademark registration and intellectual property, supported by trademark and commercial legal professional Trish Sawhney, and serves clients across Durham Region and Canada in English, French and Arabic.
onyx-law-group-vancouver:
Onyx Law Group is a Vancouver boutique law firm practising since 2012, focused on family and estate disputes.

Lawyers Candace Cho, Hailee Chun, Judith Janzen, Janis Ko and Jackson Todd practise from Suite 1215 at 650 West Georgia Street in the Scotia Tower. The firm handles divorce and separation, child custody and guardianship, property division, spousal support, wills-variation claims, probate and estate administration, and civil litigation, in English, Cantonese, Korean and Vietnamese.
op-lawyers-llp-calgary:
OP Lawyers LLP is a Calgary law firm of three lawyers handling family, employment and civil litigation matters.

Amanda Ovaici practises family, employment and civil litigation law, Imtiaz Hafiz civil litigation and employment law, and Mani Peydayesh family law and estate planning, from Suite 600 at 600 6 Avenue SW. The firm also handles divorce, construction law, protection orders and immigration matters and appears before the Alberta Court of Justice, Court of King’s Bench and Court of Appeal, with services in English and Persian.
oracle-law-vancouver:
Oracle Law is a Vancouver law firm led by lawyer Peter Bizos, called to the British Columbia bar in 2014.

Operating as Oracle Law Corporation, the firm works from Suite 602 at 777 Richards Street and handles residential and commercial real estate transactions, business and corporate law including incorporation and succession planning, and wills, powers of attorney, estate planning and probate.
orr-ewing-law-group-vancouver:
Orr-Ewing Law Group is a Vancouver firm led by lawyer Etienne Orr-Ewing that handles personal injury and insurance denial claims.

Its areas of practice also include sexual assault and abuse claims, general litigation, election law and immigration law. The office is at 999 West Hastings Street, Suite 1800.
osborne-law-group-st-catharines:
Osborne Law Group focuses on Ontario probate applications, estate administration and wills, alongside real estate and corporate law, for Niagara residents.

Based at 5 Race Street in St. Catharines, the firm has over 17 years of practice and has served more than 3,500 clients across its practice areas. Its work covers Certificates of Appointment of Estate Trustee with and without a will, Small Estate Certificates for estates under $150,000, and the situations where a bank, investment firm or purchaser may ask for probate. Stephen Osborne is its probate and estate lawyer, and fixed-fee options exist for eligible probate applications.
osler-hoskin-harcourt-llp:
Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP is a Canadian business law firm founded in Toronto in 1862.

Renamed Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt in 1916, the firm operates offices in Toronto, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa, Vancouver and New York. It advises on mergers and acquisitions, capital markets, insolvency and restructuring, real estate, tax, disputes, franchise law and private client matters, with lawyers who speak 28 languages including English, French, Mandarin, Cantonese, Spanish, Punjabi and Ukrainian.
osler-hoskin-harcourt-llp-calgary:
Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP is a business law firm with a Calgary office in Brookfield Place, handling energy and corporate and M&A matters. It has offices in Toronto, Montréal, Calgary, Ottawa, Vancouver and New York, a team of over 500 lawyers, and more than 160 years of business law practice.

An interdisciplinary team advises pipeline companies on energy infrastructure projects, and client work includes Shell's $22-billion acquisition of ARC Resources, Emera's combination with Canadian Utilities and ATCO, and Amazon's $14-billion maple bond offering. Its insights cover federal project-approval legislation, tariffs and tax measures, and the firm works as a single firm across its offices.
osra-avocats-laval:
Osra Avocats is a Laval family law firm led by lawyer Wafa Ouafi, handling divorce, separation and custody matters.

The firm works from bureau 306 at 1555 boulevard de l’Avenir and handles contested and uncontested divorce, separation, child custody and access, child and spousal support, and division of family property and patrimony for clients in Laval and the greater Montreal area, in French and Arabic.
osuji-and-smith-employment-lawyers-calga:
Osuji & Smith is a Calgary law firm with an employment focus that also handles business, litigation, family, immigration and real estate matters.

Led by CEO and managing partner Charles Osuji, the firm works from 1109 Edmonton Trail NE in Calgary, with a second Calgary office in Kensington and further offices in Toronto, Vancouver and Dubai. Its areas of work include employment and labour law, corporate law, civil litigation and mediation, wills and estates and personal injury, and its lawyers offer service in languages including French, Hindi, Punjabi, Russian and Ukrainian.
outsiders-law-calgary:
Outsiders Law is a Calgary law firm with a Toronto office, handling tax, corporate, commercial and charity law matters.

The firm works from Suite 1900 at 350 7 Avenue SW and its practice covers tax law, business and corporate law, mergers and acquisitions, commercial litigation, bankruptcy and insolvency, patent law, contract law, and charities and not-for-profit legal services for businesses, entrepreneurs, charities and non-profits.
pablaws-edmonton:
PABLAWS is an Edmonton litigation and general practice law firm founded and led by lawyer Dildeep Pabla.

The firm works from Suite 200 at 9637 41 Avenue NW and handles criminal defence, CRA tax disputes, family law, immigration appeals and refugee law, civil litigation and real estate, appearing before Alberta courts, the Tax Court of Canada and the Immigration and Refugee Board for individuals, families and business owners, in English, Hindi and Punjabi.
pace-law-firm:
Pace Law Firm is a Toronto personal injury law firm acting for accident victims across Ontario for nearly 40 years.

Based at 191 The West Mall, Suite 1100 in Etobicoke, the Toronto office has ten lawyers, including Al Pace. Its personal injury work covers car and motorcycle collisions, slip and fall claims, boating accidents, and brain and spinal cord injuries, and immigration law is also among its practice areas.
pacific-legal-professional-corporation-t:
Pacific Legal is a Toronto corporate and commercial firm handling incorporations, shareholder agreements, acquisitions and real estate.

The firm was founded in 2021 by Avi Khanna, who worked at Toronto corporate firms on mergers and financings before starting it. Yash Mehrotra is also on the team. Work includes start-up representation, asset purchase agreements, creditors' rights, contracts, shareholder and partnership agreements, buy-sell agreements, franchise matters and commercial technology transactions. It serves clients across Ontario in technology, real estate, e-commerce and professional services, from incorporation through to exit.
pacific-point-law-corporation-surrey:
Pacific Point Law Corporation is a Surrey law firm founded in 2016 and led by principal lawyer Tarun Malik.

The firm has a team of about four, with offices in Surrey and Delta. Its practice covers family law, immigration, criminal defence, real estate, wills and estates, intellectual property, civil litigation and notarial services for individuals, families and businesses across the Lower Mainland, including newcomers and entrepreneurs, in English, Hindi, Punjabi, Urdu and American Sign Language.
paciocco-and-mellow-windsor:
Paciocco & Mellow, founded in 2013, is a Windsor personal injury firm acting in car accident, head injury, wrongful death and fall cases. Gino Paciocco and Jeffrey Mellow started the firm, and its lawyers have practised in personal injury law for a combined total of over sixty years. Jeffrey grew up in Leamington, attended the University of Windsor, was called to the bar in 2003 and belongs to the Essex Law Association and the Ontario Trial Lawyers Association.

The firm's matters also include animal attacks and dog bites, truck and motorcycle accidents, disability and insurance matters across South-Western Ontario. Its lawyers have appeared at trial in the Ontario Superior Court of Justice, on appeals in the Divisional Court, and before the License Appeal Tribunal, the Financial Services Commission of Ontario and the Workplace Safety and Insurance Appeals Tribunal.
pactum-law-edmonton:
Pactum Law is an Edmonton firm practising family law, real estate, wills and estates, and employment law. Its family and employment lawyers act at all levels of court across Alberta.

Family matters include divorce, spousal and child support, property division, parenting, relocation, grandparent access, emergency protection, exclusive possession of the family home, and prenuptial, cohabitation and separation agreements. Employment work includes severance negotiation and wrongful dismissal. The team at 104 Avenue NW includes Orlando Munoz, Beverly Duong, James Arendt and Jose Soto, as well as paralegal Kelly Pike.
paine-edmonds-llp-vancouver:
Paine Edmonds LLP is a Vancouver law firm founded in 1945 by Paul Britton Paine and William Henry Kemp Edmonds.

From 510 Burrard Street, the firm advises on family law, employment, wills and estates, disability, insurance, personal injury, business and corporate law, and civil litigation and trial practice for individuals and businesses across British Columbia. Its roster of about fourteen lawyers includes Lyle Woodley, Henry Edmonds and John Hyde.
pallavi-law-office-mississauga:
Pallavi Law Office is a Mississauga, Ontario law practice led by principal lawyer Pallavi Kataria, a barrister, solicitor and notary public.

The office advises on immigration, family, business and corporate, criminal defence and real estate law, with a licensed paralegal handling real estate files, and offers notary public services to individuals and businesses in Mississauga.
pare-duquette-avocats-inc-drummondville:
Paré Duquette Avocats inc. is a business law firm in Drummondville, Quebec, with a second office in Brossard.

Associates Yves Paré and Alexandre Duquette advise on incorporations, shareholder and partnership agreements, reorganizations, family and asset-protection trusts, mergers, liquidations and commercial contracts for small and medium-sized businesses, entrepreneurs, pharmacists and other healthcare providers, in French and English.
parlatore-law-niagara-niagara-falls: Parlatore Law handles personal injury cases and residential real estate transactions for clients in Niagara Falls and across the Niagara Region. Its lawyers act for people in Niagara Falls and surrounding communities, with personal injury and real estate as practice areas. Clients pay no fees if there is no recovery, and each case is treated as unique to the individual. The office is at 6387 Morrison Street, Suite 200, in Niagara Falls, Ontario.
parlee-mclaws-llp:
Parlee McLaws LLP is an Edmonton, Alberta law firm established in 1883, with offices in Edmonton and Calgary.

The firm adopted its current name in 1986 and advises on business and corporate law, civil litigation and trial practice, appellate work, intellectual property, labour and employment, banking, bankruptcy and insolvency, tax, securities, oil and gas, real estate, municipal law, Aboriginal business law, and wills and estates for corporate, institutional and individual clients.
parr-business-law-vancouver:
Parr Business Law is a Vancouver firm handling incorporations, contracts, business sales and purchases, wills and estate planning.

Services include incorporations and corporate reorganizations, contract drafting, and help with buying and selling a business or planning succession. The estate side covers wills, powers of attorney, healthcare representation agreements, corporate wills, alter ego and joint partner trusts, estate freezes, and probate administration with executor support. Estate planning and wills in Vancouver, including trusts, executors and the probate process in British Columbia, are covered in detail.
passgo-real-estate-law-calgary:
PassGo Real Estate Law is a Calgary law firm handling residential real estate transactions and wills for clients across Alberta and British Columbia.

Working from 340 Midpark Way SE, the firm acts on home purchases, sales, refinances, title transfers and real estate contracts and negotiations, alongside wills and estate planning. Lawyer Erin Crocker is part of the practice, and secure virtual signings allow closings to be completed remotely for clients in either province.
passi-patel:
Passi & Patel is a Brampton criminal defence firm founded in 2014 by lawyers Jay Passi and Rick Patel.

Jay Passi has more than two decades of experience, has appeared before every level of court up to the Supreme Court of Canada and is a past vice-president of the Peel Criminal Lawyers' Association. The firm is headquartered at 197 County Court Boulevard with satellite offices in Mississauga and Milton and practises criminal defence exclusively, covering impaired and dangerous driving, assault, drug and firearms offences, fraud, sexual offences, youth matters and mischief.
patel-law-firm:
Patel Law Firm is a Downtown Brampton law firm led by Mikesh H. Patel, handling family, criminal, civil litigation and real estate matters.

The practice is located at 60 Queen Street East and acts for Brampton residents in family law, criminal defence, civil litigation, real estate transactions and wills, with notary public services. Service is offered in English.
pathfinder-law-abbotsford:
Pathfinder Law is an Abbotsford family law firm with additional offices in Langley and Chilliwack, led by founder and principal Timothy Bhullar.

Senior associate counsel Leonard Kompa and associates Jas Boparai and Vaibhav Mehra practise from Unit 104 at 2001 McCallum Road. The firm handles family and divorce law, civil litigation and dispute resolution, construction law, strata law, wills, estates and trusts, employment and labour law and business law for clients across Abbotsford, the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver, in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
pathway-legal-family-lawyers:
Pathway Legal Family Lawyers is a Victoria-area family law firm in Colwood, handling divorce and separation matters.

The firm operates as Pathway Legal Law Corporation from Unit 206 at 310 Wale Road, with lawyer Valorie Hemminger listed as its lawyer. It acts for people going through divorce or separation, taking a negotiation-first approach and using court only as a last resort, in English.
patriam-immigration-law-vancouver:
Patriam Immigration Law is a Vancouver firm focused on Canadian citizenship and immigration, including Express Entry.

The firm's name draws on the Latin motto of the Order of Canada, desiderantes meliorem patriam, meaning "they desire a better country". It also handles refusals of visas, study permits and work permits, and its team includes a lawyer who read law in England and practised in Singapore before immigrating to Canada.
patricia-brown-barrister-and-solicitor-w:
Patricia Brown Barrister and Solicitor is a Windsor law firm led by Patricia Brown, handling criminal defence, mental health and immigration matters.

Lawyers Alyssa Jervis and Monique Jewell practise with Patricia Brown, who is licensed in Ontario and Michigan, from 140 Park Street West in Windsor, with a team in Chatham. The firm’s practice covers criminal defence, mental health law, immigration law and municipal and planning law, with appearances before Ontario courts, the Supreme Court of Canada, the Immigration and Refugee Board, the Consent and Capacity Board and the Ontario Review Board.
patrick-jacques-avocat-droit-criminel-qu:
Patrick Jacques Avocat is a Québec City criminal defence firm founded by Patrick Jacques, a former Crown prosecutor, with a presence in Gatineau.

The one-lawyer firm defends DUI, drug, violent and property offences and handles immigration inadmissibility and deportation defence for individuals facing criminal charges, including clients whose Canadian immigration status is at risk. Services are available in French.
patrola-law-corporation-surrey:
Patrola Law Corporation is a Surrey business law firm advising entrepreneurs, startups and corporations across Canada and internationally.

The firm has three lawyers and handles business incorporations, mergers and acquisitions, trademarks, commercial contracts, money services business registration, employment law and litigation for founders, startups and established companies. Clients are served in English, Hindi, Korean, Punjabi and Urdu.
pav-singh-criminal-lawyer-mississauga:
Pav Singh is a Mississauga criminal defence lawyer who represents clients across Peel Region, Toronto and surrounding areas.

Pav Singh completed a Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice at Ryerson University, a law degree at the University of Leicester, and a Master of Laws at Osgoode Hall Law School. His personal line is answered around the clock, every day of the year, and evening, weekend and out-of-office meetings are available. Fees are quoted upfront, with block fee and hourly options and payment plans. His office is on Matheson Boulevard West in Mississauga, Ontario.
pazder-law-corporation-vancouver:
Pazder Law Corporation is a Vancouver real estate law firm at 800 West Pender Street, handling property purchases, sales and mortgage refinancing.

Principal lawyer Kenneth Pazder practises with Melissa Valana, and the firm works exclusively in real estate law, serving property buyers, sellers and homeowners across British Columbia. A second office in Surrey and White Rock is available by appointment.
pelican-law-immigration-and-refugee-lawy:
Pelican Law is a Mississauga, Ontario immigration and refugee law firm founded by Narinder Mann.

Mann is a Law Society of Ontario barrister, solicitor and notary public, called to the Ontario bar in 2024 after earlier licensing as a paralegal and practising civil law in India. The firm handles temporary resident visas, Express Entry, provincial nominee applications, citizenship, family sponsorship, refugee claims and appeals and Federal Court judicial review, along with family law, real estate, and notary and apostille services, in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
pelsmakher-law-toronto:
Pelsmakher Law is a Toronto employment and labour law practice founded by Simon Pelsmakher.

Called to the Ontario bar in 2019 after holding senior in-house roles at large retail and food-manufacturing organizations, Pelsmakher acts on wrongful and constructive dismissal, severance, executive compensation, human rights, privacy and employment contract matters. The one-lawyer practice acts for both employees facing dismissal and employers drafting employment contracts.
pender-litigation-vancouver:
Pender Litigation is a Vancouver criminal defence firm led by principals Kevin Westell, Meghan Forhan and Frances Mahon.

Associate counsel Andrew Hindi, David Jardine, Janine Sicotte and Michel Fabre practise with the principals. The firm defends driving offences, sexual offences, violent offences, drug offences, and fraud and theft charges, and handles appeals, for clients facing charges at every level of court in British Columbia.
pereira-walter-lawyers-llp-mississauga:
Pereira Walter Lawyers LLP is a Mississauga, Ontario law firm founded in 2010 by partners Carlos Pereira and Michael Walter.

From a single office at 201 City Centre Drive, Suite 300, the firm handles civil litigation, personal injury, insurance and disability law, employment law, real estate, wills and estates, family law and alternative dispute resolution for clients across Mississauga. Services are available in English and Portuguese, and the partners handle files directly.
perley-robertson-hill-and-mcdougall-llp:
Perley-Robertson, Hill & McDougall LLP is an Ottawa law firm with a single office at Constitution Square, 340 Albert Street, Suite 1400.

The firm’s lawyers advise on advanced technology law, business law, intellectual property, real estate, civil litigation, health law, municipal law, environmental law, police law, wills and estate planning, immigration, labour, taxation, sports law and planning law. Named lawyers include Lynda Bordeleau, who heads the police law group, Michael Gerrior, who heads the business law group, and partners Dirk Bouwer, Joël Dubois, Paul Braunovan, Jean-Marc Eddie and Andrew de Lotbinière McDougall.
perrin-ahmad-llp:
Perrin Ahmad LLP is a four-lawyer North Bay litigation firm handling criminal defence, family law, civil litigation and wills and estates.
