Robb MacDonald holds a JD from Queen’s University and articled at Gowling WLG. The practice works from Suite 606 at 130 Spadina Avenue and defends charges including homicide, sexual assault, domestic assault, impaired driving, drug offences, fraud, youth offences, property offences and bail hearings, with a focus on jury trials, for clients across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.
robert-j-klassen:
Robert J Klassen is a Victoria, British Columbia family law practice handling divorce, separation, collaborative family law and mediation.

Founded by family lawyer and mediator Robert Klassen, who was called to the Ontario bar in 1970 and the British Columbia bar in 1979, the practice has offered family law mediation since 1985. Klassen founded and formerly chaired the Victoria Collaborative Family Law Group and previously served as an adjunct professor at the University of Victoria Faculty of Law. The two-lawyer practice includes Gloria Cheung and also advises on wills, estates and trusts.
robert-legal-montreal:
Robert Légal is a Montreal criminal and penal defence practice founded by Anne-Geneviève Robert.

A graduate of the Université de Montréal, Robert leads a two-lawyer team with avocate Meryam Zakko, both called to the bar in 2025. The firm defends clients from police investigation through trial in offences against the person, sexual offences, domestic violence, economic crimes, drug offences, impaired driving and youth matters, in French.
robertson-llp-calgary:
Robertson LLP is a Calgary firm, founded in 2012, practising commercial and residential real estate, business law, wills and estates, and litigation. Ryan Robertson started the firm with national firm and in-house experience, aiming to give clients predictable pricing.

Offices are in Calgary and Okotoks, and clients include home buyers and sellers, small and medium-sized businesses, lenders, home builders, developers, REITs, investors and condominium corporations. Commercial work covers purchases and sales, financing, leasing, construction law, builders' liens and franchise law. Madison Steenson is among the firm's lawyers.
robins-appleby-llp:
Robins Appleby LLP is a Toronto business law firm with a single office in the financial district.

Managing partners David Schlesinger, Errol Tenenbaum and Jonathan Zepp lead the firm at 120 Adelaide Street West, Suite 2600. It handles business and transactions, commercial real estate and development, secured lending and enforcement, employment law, litigation, tax, wills and estates, and affordable and social housing for entrepreneurs, businesses, financial institutions and foreign companies.
robinson-llp-edmonton:
Robinson LLP is an Edmonton plaintiff-only personal injury law firm, known as The Recovery Team, led by senior trial counsel Ed Robinson and Carol Robinson.

Lawyers Craig MacKay and Kevin Fedorak and associates Kathryn Griffin and Ryan Magh practise at 10410 81 Avenue NW, handling motor vehicle, truck, motorcycle and bicycle accidents, medical malpractice, brain and spinal cord injury, wrongful death, slip and fall and dog bite claims for injured people and their families in Edmonton and Northern Alberta, in English.
rocky-mountain-german-law-ltd-calgary:
Rocky Mountain German Law is a Calgary practice advising North American clients on German law.

The one-lawyer practice of Richard Rummel, a German-qualified Rechtsanwalt registered as a Practitioner of Foreign Law in British Columbia, advises on German citizenship, inheritance, real estate, family and corporate matters and represents clients before German courts. It works with a network of German lawyers and tax advisors.
rohan-hate-litigation-lawyers-toronto:
Rohan Haté Litigation Lawyers is a Toronto litigation firm founded in 2012 by lawyer Rohan Haté, handling personal injury and civil litigation.

Rohan Haté was called to the Ontario bar in 2012 and holds a JD from Santa Clara University and an LLM from Osgoode Hall. The firm works from 61 Jarvis Street and handles personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, slip and fall, long-term disability, wrongful death, insurance litigation, real estate and estate litigation and commercial litigation across Toronto, the Greater Toronto Area and Ontario.
rohit-sharma-law-etobicoke:
Rohit Sharma Law is an Etobicoke law firm led by principal lawyer Rohit Sharma, called to the Ontario bar in 2019.

The firm works from Suite 200 at 1058A Albion Road and appears in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice. Its practice covers family law, criminal defence, real estate, immigration, employment law, personal injury, notary public services and litigation for clients in Etobicoke, Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area.
ronald-kumar-law-corporation-vancouver:
Ronald Kumar Law Corporation is a Vancouver law firm founded in 2014 by Ronald Kumar, handling estate litigation, wills and personal injury.

Ronald Kumar was called to the British Columbia bar in 2013 after articling and working as an associate at Vertlieb Dosanjh Trial Lawyers. The firm’s practice covers estate litigation, wills, probate and estate administration, personal injury, general litigation, and sports and entertainment law, with appearances in the BC Provincial Court, Supreme Court and Court of Appeal.
ronalee-carey-law-ottawa:
Ronalee Carey Law is an Ottawa immigration law practice led by Ronalee Carey, acting for individuals and businesses.

Carey has practised law in Ontario since 1998 and has practised immigration law exclusively since 2008. She is a member of the Law Society of Ontario, the Canadian Immigration Lawyers Association, the Canadian Bar Association's national immigration section and the Ontario Bar Association's citizenship and immigration section. The practice handles economic immigration, permanent residence, provincial nominee programs, family sponsorship, refugee, humanitarian and citizenship matters, in English.
ronen-kurzfeld-immigration-lawyer-toront:
Ronen Kurzfeld Immigration Lawyer Toronto is a North York immigration law office acting for individuals, families and corporate employers.

The practice, the Law Office of Ronen Kurzfeld, is run by founder Ronen Kurzfeld, an Osgoode Hall LL.B. graduate and member of the Law Society of Ontario, from 110 Sheppard Avenue East, Suite 630. Its work covers Express Entry and permanent residence, spousal and family sponsorship, work and study permits, LMIA applications, deportation defence and appeals, Federal Court judicial review, humanitarian and compassionate applications and citizenship, in English, French, Tagalog and Russian.
ross-mcbride-llp:
Ross & McBride LLP is a Hamilton law firm established in 1890, acting for municipalities, financial institutions, businesses, nonprofits and families.

William Leaper Ross was admitted to the Ontario bar in 1890 and Robert Pickard McBride was called in 1912, and the firm works from 1 King Street West, 10th Floor, with Brian Simo as firm chair. It is a member of the Law Firm Diversity and Inclusion Network. Its practice covers personal injury, civil litigation, family law, labour and employment, business and corporate law, real estate, wills and estates, human rights, criminal defence, banking, insurance and environmental law, in English, Hindi, Italian, Korean, Punjabi and Urdu.
roy-beaulieu-boudreau-belanger:
Roy Beaulieu Boudreau Belanger is a Rimouski firm operating as Avocats BSL, with practice areas from administrative law to family law.

Avocats BSL is one of the larger independent law firms in Eastern Quebec and one of the oldest legal practices in the province. Its fields include health and social services law, occupational health and safety, cross-border and private international law, insurance, civil and commercial litigation, real estate and family mediation. It also handles administrative matters such as access to information, employment insurance, housing tribunal cases, SAAQ benefits, the Federal Court, immigration and professional discipline, and offers bilingual services.
roy-johnston-tds-brandon:
Roy Johnston TDS is the Brandon office of Thompson Dorfman Sweatman LLP, serving Westman in corporate, family, estates, real estate and farm law.

The local team has five lawyers and seven support staff and also runs a part-time office in Boissevain. Clients include primary producers, large farm operations, small and medium-sized businesses, individuals, financial firms and developers. Its areas include commercial law, financial services, wills and estates, residential real estate, and commercial property and development. Through the larger Winnipeg office, clients can reach over 30 areas of law, and Thompson Dorfman Sweatman was founded in 1887.
royalridge-law-calgary:
Royalridge Law is a full-service Calgary law firm founded by managing partner Anant Sidhu, who has practised since 2021.

Sidhu, who holds an LLM from the University of British Columbia, practises with partner Dilrose Singh Sandhu, who handles real estate, and lawyers Manjot Saini and Raja Boparai. The firm advises on real estate, business and corporate law, wills, estates and trusts, criminal defence, and civil litigation and dispute resolution for individuals, families, investors and businesses across Calgary and Alberta, in English and Punjabi.
rpb-family-law-ottawa:
RPB Family Law is an Ottawa family law firm founded in 2020 by Ronan Blake, practising family law exclusively.

The firm, incorporated as RPB Family Law Professional Corporation, has five lawyers including Giselle Alexander, Jeremiah Kalyniak, Maria Ilie-Draga and Michael Randazzo, working from a single Ottawa office. It handles divorce, separation, custody, child and spousal support, property division and adoption for clients across Ottawa and Eastern Ontario, including Renfrew, Pembroke, Perth, Smiths Falls and Cornwall, in English, French, Romanian, Bengali, Hindi and Urdu.
rpc-personal-injury-lawyer-richmond-hill:
Based in Richmond Hill, RPC Personal Injury Lawyer handles car accidents, slip and falls and other personal injury cases.

The practice also covers pedestrian and motorcycle accidents, dog bite incidents, public transit accidents, orthopaedic injuries and traumatic brain injuries. Operating as RPC Law, it has offices in Richmond Hill, Vaughan and Georgetown and belongs to the BARAPP Law Alliance. Its staff are multilingual, and its lawyers deal with insurance adjusters on behalf of injured people.
rple-law:
RPLE Law is a Vancouver trial firm handling class actions, personal injury and complex litigation, with sexual assault matters among its practice areas.

The firm's full name is Rice Parsons Leoni & Elliott LLP, and its team numbers between 11 and 50 people. Its injury trial practice acts for clients across Canada. For sexual assault matters, initial meetings can take place by Zoom, at the office on Howe Street or at another location, and people need share only what they are comfortable telling the firm. The firm supports the Parkinson's Society of British Columbia and Canuck Place.
ruberto-sheikh-llp:
Ruberto Sheikh LLP is a Thunder Bay law firm founded in 2022 by partners Luke Ruberto and Nadir Sheikh.

Associates Alana Wilson, Carter Fontaine, Kady Stachiw and Matthew Huston practise with the partners from 130 May Street North. The firm handles family and divorce law, real estate, wills and estates, civil litigation and child protection law for clients across Northwestern Ontario, including Thunder Bay, Kenora, Dryden and Fort Frances.
rudner-law:
Rudner Law is a Markham employment law firm founded by Stuart Rudner, acting for both employers and employees.

The firm operates as Stuart Rudner Professional Corporation from Suite 600 at 15 Allstate Parkway, and its six lawyers include partner Brittany Taylor and senior associate Nadia Zaman. Its practice covers wrongful and constructive dismissal, workplace harassment, employment contracts, human rights, mediation and arbitration across the GTA, in English.
rupinder-singh-dhaliwal-professional-cor:
Rupinder Singh Dhaliwal Professional Corporation is a Brampton practice offering real estate legal services and wills and affidavits.

Rupinder Singh Dhaliwal became a member of the Law Society of Upper Canada in July 2019 and holds a B.A. and an LL.B. He practises as a barrister and solicitor. The firm's approach is timely representation and practical solutions, and it works virtually with quick responses. The Brampton office handles property matters and the document work that goes with wills and sworn affidavits.
russell-alexander-collaborative-family-l:
Russell Alexander Collaborative Family Lawyers is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, separation, support and collaborative practice.

Founded in 1998 by Russell Alexander, the firm has further Ontario offices in Whitby, Lindsay, Markham, Peterborough, Concord, Oshawa and Kingston. Its work includes collaborative practice, mediation, parenting arrangements, the division of family property, cohabitation agreements and Family Responsibility Office matters, with real estate, wills and powers of attorney available alongside.
ryan-edmonds-workplace-counsel-toronto:
Ryan Edmonds Workplace Counsel is a Toronto employment law firm acting for employees, founders and small and mid-sized businesses.

Ryan Edmonds founded the firm after beginning his career at a national law firm, was called to the Ontario bar in 2012 and serves as managing partner. The team of five lawyers includes Christopher Gibson, Andrew Kennedy, Thulasi Kandiah and Graeme Wyatt. The firm practises employment law only, with particular attention to severance pay lawsuits, for small and mid-sized businesses, employees in transition and company founders.
s-and-s-lex-pc-mississauga:
S & S LEX PC is a Mississauga law firm led by lawyers Shubham Bansal and Shivangi Bansal, handling immigration and real estate matters.

The professional corporation works from Suite 1501 at 90 Burnhamthorpe Road West and handles immigration law including sponsorships, appeals and Federal Court judicial reviews, real estate, criminal defence, and powers of attorney and notary work for clients in Mississauga and Peel Region, in English, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu.
s-athwal-law-professional-corporation-mi:
S Athwal Law Professional Corporation is a solo criminal defence practice with offices in Hamilton and Mississauga, Ontario.

Founded by lawyer Sahej Athwal, who was called to the Ontario bar in 2022 and holds an LLM from Osgoode Hall, the practice defends assault, DUI and driving offences, drug and weapons offences, sexual assault charges and youth matters, and handles bail hearings and appeals. It serves clients across Ontario and the Greater Toronto Area.
s-s-loomba-law-professional-corporation-:
S S Loomba Law Professional Corporation is a Brampton law firm founded in 2021 by lawyer Shubinder Singh Loomba, who is also a notary public.

Shubinder Singh Loomba holds a master of laws degree in Canadian common law from Osgoode Hall Law School. From Unit 304 at 5B Conestoga Drive, the firm handles immigration, real estate, civil litigation, family law, and corporate and commercial law for individuals and businesses in Brampton.
s-zalman-haouzi-avocat-montreal:
Zalman Haouzi Avocat is a Montreal boutique handling criminal defence for clients in Longueuil, Laval, Valleyfield and surrounding areas.

Founded in 2011, the practice treats a criminal charge as a problem to be solved and works with first-time offenders to avoid a criminal record. It assists from the first interaction with police through to resolution of the file, and prefers negotiated outcomes over trial where possible. Zalman Haouzi, who has practised in Montreal for more than a decade, is the lawyer behind the firm, and the work centres on minimizing the consequences of an accusation.
sabio-law-llp-brampton:
Sabio Law LLP is a Brampton law firm formed in 2021, handling real estate, lending, business and litigation matters.

The firm was formed through the merger of KSK Law Professional Corporation and GSC Law Professional Corporation. Co-founding partners Kunwar S. Kohli, who leads business and real estate, and Gurpreet Singh Chandok, who leads litigation, serve as co-CEOs. The firm works from its Brampton head office with further offices in Cambridge, North York and Burlington, and handles residential and commercial real estate, land development and leasing, institutional and private lending, mortgage enforcement and debt recovery, business acquisitions, incorporation, construction liens, litigation and wills and estates.
safi-law-group-edmonton:
Safi Law Group is an Edmonton law firm established in 2019, handling personal injury, family, estates and immigration matters.

Lawyers at the firm include Sangin Safi, Hinnah Beydoun, Shantale D’Aoust, Isabelle Kim, Breifne Quigley, Afzal Shah and Megan Tupper, working from Suite 900 at 11150 Jasper Avenue. Its practice covers personal injury, family law and divorce, wills and estates, civil litigation and immigration for Edmonton clients.
saguy-barchichat:
Saguy Barchichat is a Montreal immigration law firm assisting individuals and small businesses with immigration and business law matters.

Led by lawyer Saguy Barchichat from a single office at 2047 Rue Mansfield, the firm handles immigration appeals, visas, work and study permits, refugee applications and family sponsorship, alongside business law. Service is offered in English and French to clients across Montreal.
salloum-and-company-edmonton:
Salloum & Company is an Edmonton firm acting in criminal defence, immigration, family law, real estate and civil litigation. The office is in the Bell Tower on 103 Avenue NW.

The lawyers act for individuals and businesses facing criminal charges, civil disputes, family matters and property issues, and handle residential real estate from purchases and sales to refinancing. The team brings experience across real estate, civil litigation, family law and criminal defence, and works closely with each client to protect their rights.
samfiru-tumarkin-llp:
Samfiru Tumarkin LLP is a Toronto employment and disability law firm acting for employees in dismissal, severance and disability claims.

Founded in 2007 by Lior Samfiru and Sivan Tumarkin, who remain its national co-managing partners, the firm has its head office at 350 Bay Street and further offices in Ottawa, Calgary, Vancouver and Saskatoon. Its work covers wrongful and constructive dismissal, workplace harassment and discrimination, long-term disability claims and personal injury, with employment matters handled in Ontario, Alberta and British Columbia and disability claims in nearly every province. The team works in English and French.
samphir-law-office-winnipeg:
Samphir Law Office is a Winnipeg law firm founded by Joel Samphir, who has practised in Manitoba since 2000.

Samphir, who is also admitted in Ontario and studied at Cardiff University, spent more than fifteen years in corporate law firms before opening the practice. It advises on residential and commercial real estate, wills, estates and trusts, immigration, corporate and business law, and notary services for individuals, cottage owners, families and growing businesses across Manitoba and Northwestern Ontario.
samy-ziada-avocat-montreal:
Samy Ziada Avocat, operating as ZS Avocats, is a solo Montreal litigation and immigration practice at 500 Place d’Armes.

Samy Ziada, a member of the Barreau du Québec, handles civil and commercial litigation in housing, employment, real estate and insurance, immigration matters including sponsorship, asylum, and temporary and permanent residence, business law for entrepreneurs and small and medium-sized businesses, and landlord and tenant disputes, in French.
sanctuary-lawyers-aurora:
With offices in Aurora and Toronto, Sanctuary Lawyers is a family-run firm handling criminal defence and personal injury. For over a decade it has represented individuals across Southern Ontario, defending charges such as assault, domestic assault, assault with a weapon, drug offences, theft and fraud, impaired driving and youth offences. It also handles bail hearings and criminal appeals.

Beyond criminal defence, the firm acts in personal injury, civil litigation and family law matters. Its Aurora office is on Yonge Street, and its service area stretches across Southern Ontario, including Barrie, Brampton, Burlington, Cambridge and Ajax.
sandrine-bourgon-avocate-droit-criminel:
Sandrine Bourgon is a Saint-Jérôme, Quebec criminal and penal law practice serving the Laurentides region.

The solo practice of avocate Sandrine Bourgon defends clients facing charges such as impaired driving, sexual assault, assault, domestic violence, drug offences and fraud, and also handles immigration law and municipal and planning law. Bourgon is a member of the Barreau du Québec and serves Saint-Jérôme and surrounding communities in French.
sankoff-criminal-law-edmonton:
Sankoff Criminal Law is a boutique Edmonton criminal law firm led by Peter Sankoff, a University of Alberta law professor.

Practising since 2022 from the historic Ritchie Mill building in Strathcona, the firm handles criminal defence, criminal appeals, Supreme Court of Canada advocacy, complex criminal trials, sexual assault defence, drug offences, impaired driving, violent crime and domestic violence matters. It also consults for other criminal defence lawyers on factums, strategy and trial support and acts for individuals charged with serious offences across Alberta, the Northwest Territories and Canada, in English.
sarao-law-pro-corp-etobicoke:
Sarao Law Professional Corporation is an Etobicoke law firm led by lawyer Navdeep Singh Sarao, handling real estate, family and immigration matters.

The firm works from Suite 5 at 130 Westmore Drive and acts on residential and commercial real estate closings, family law, business law, immigration, wills and powers of attorney, with notary public and commissioner of oaths services, in English, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu.
sas-ing-immigration-law-centre:
Sas & Ing Immigration Law Centre is a Vancouver firm advising on work and study permits, permanent residence, citizenship and Federal Court immigration matters.

The centre is a partnership between Catherine Sas Law Corporation and Victor Ing Law Corporation, established in November 2015. Clients range from corporations transferring personnel to individuals who want to live, work or study in Canada or reunite with family, and services include Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, family sponsorship and citizenship appeals. Catherine A. Sas, KC, opened her own firm in 1990, Victor Ing was appointed to the board of directors of CILA, and a continuing education seminar is scheduled for October 21, 2026.
satnam-grewal-criminal-defence-and-immig:
Satnam Grewal Criminal Defence and Immigration Lawyer is a Kitchener law firm practising criminal defence and immigration law.

Satnam Singh Grewal holds a master’s in Canadian common law from Osgoode Hall and works from 53 Roy Street. The firm, listed as Satnam Grewal Law PC, handles DUI, assault, drug and youth criminal matters along with immigration, refugee and citizenship law for clients in Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Brantford, Woodstock, Hamilton and Milton, in English, Punjabi, Hindi, Urdu and Bengali.
savard-defoy-avocats:
Savard Defoy Avocats is a Levis firm whose lawyers defend criminal and penal charges, including youth offender cases.

The firm also appears under the name Savard & Plouffe Avocats. Its team has more than 25 years of experience and includes Me Yves Savard, Me Sophie Plouffe and Me Marie-Maxime Tremblay. Me Savard was admitted to the Barreau in 1995, concentrates on criminal and penal law and has pleaded before courts up to the Supreme Court of Canada. The firm also covers family law and youth law, and family law is a listed practice area.
savoie-savoie:
Savoie & Savoie is a Repentigny law firm founded in 1975 by lawyer Claude Savoie, handling civil, commercial and family matters.

Olivier Therrien serves as president of the firm, with lawyers Maxime Therrien and Claude Savoie, from 46 boulevard Brien. The firm handles civil and commercial litigation, real estate and construction law, personal and commercial debt recovery, family law and accredited family and civil mediation, and estate litigation for private, corporate and institutional clients across Lanaudière and greater Montreal, in French and English.
schaffer-schaffer-law:
Schaffer & Schaffer Law is a Kitchener law firm established in 1982, handling real estate, family, criminal, injury and estates matters.

The practice is incorporated as Schaffer & Schaffer Professional Corporation. Gerry V. Schaffer founded it and has practised since 1982, Zack G. Schaffer was called to the bar in 2016, and Sam Schaffer is a barrister and solicitor, and all three are members of the Waterloo Region Law Association. From a single Kitchener office, the firm acts in real estate, family law, criminal defence, personal injury, wills and estates, and corporate and small business law.
sean-fagan-criminal-defence-lawyer-calga:
Sean Fagan Criminal Defence Lawyer is a Calgary practice defending assault, driving, drug, sexual, theft and fraud charges, and handling bail matters.

Sean Fagan grew up around his father's Calgary criminal practice, focused on criminal defence in law school, took first place at the MacIntyre Cup and medalled at the Sopinka Cup national trial advocacy finals. He was lead counsel in a Supreme Court of Canada case that ended in acquittal and re-established the defence of extreme intoxication. The practice also covers breaches and failures to appear, and recent matters include charges withdrawn or stayed. The firm does not handle traffic tickets, and Devlin Gavigan also practises there.
sean-kelly-law-ottawa:
Based in Barrhaven, Sean Kelly Law handles real estate, wills and estate planning for clients across Ottawa. Sean Kelly is a second-generation lawyer, born and raised in Ottawa, with more than 15 years of experience.

He acts for first-time home buyers and seasoned investors, prepares agreements of purchase and sale, acts for borrowers or lenders in private financing, and handles title transfers between spouses or family members. The firm also prepares wills and advises on estate planning, and serves all neighbourhoods in Ottawa and surrounding areas.
sebastien-gagnon-avocat-criminel:
Sebastien Gagnon, Avocat Criminel is the Gatineau practice of Me Sébastien Gagnon, handling criminal charges and statements of offence. He is a partner at CSG Avocats with more than 20 years of experience in criminal and penal law, and also practises disciplinary law.

The practice handles impaired driving, sexual assault, dangerous driving, drug offences, assault, theft and fraud, as well as administrative law, and also appears before the Commission des transports du Québec and the youth court in young offender and youth protection matters. The client meets the lawyer from the first day, with emergency availability at any hour. The office is at 166 Rue Wellington.
seif-law-firm-richmond-hill:
Seif Law Firm is a Richmond Hill law firm founded in 2011, handling real estate, wills, civil litigation and notary matters.

Adam Seif opened the practice after articling with Pace Law Firm and holds a BA from Roosevelt University and a JD from the University of Florida. He is a member of the Law Society of Ontario, the Florida Bar, the Canadian Bar Association, the Ontario Bar Association and the American Bar Association. The firm works from 10288 Yonge Street, Unit 3, with offices in downtown Toronto and Laguna Niguel, California. Its services cover residential and commercial real estate, refinancing, private mortgages, wills, powers of attorney, small claims and civil litigation, and notary and commissioner work, including cross-border matters, in English, Farsi and Punjabi.
sg-injury-law-ottawa:
SG Injury Law is an Ottawa personal injury law firm founded in 2015 by Sean Giovannetti.

Sean Giovannetti spent the previous 13 years as an insurance defence lawyer for major Canadian auto insurers. The firm's three lawyers focus solely on personal injury and long-term disability claims, including motor vehicle accidents and slip and fall, for accident victims in Ottawa and Eastern Ontario, including Pembroke, Cornwall, Kingston, Brockville, Perth and Arnprior.
shaffie-law-toronto:
Shaffie Law is a Toronto criminal defence firm founded in 2014 by Shayan Shaffie, acting in assault, youth and bail matters.

Shaffie was called to the Ontario bar in 2011 and previously worked as an Assistant Crown Attorney in Hamilton. He is a member of the Law Society of Ontario and the Criminal Lawyers' Association. The firm handles domestic assault, sexual assault, youth criminal justice and bail hearings for clients across the Greater Toronto Area, Hamilton and Peel, and accepts legal aid certificates.
shapiro-llp-north-york:
Shapiro LLP is a North York law firm with more than 45 years in practice, handling real estate, business, and wills and estates matters.

The firm began as a sole practice under Garry Shapiro, who moved from Bay Street into private practice, and was renamed from Shapiro Real Estate and Business Law to Shapiro LLP. Evan Shapiro is a senior lawyer and partner, joined on the roster by Avleen Marwaha and Azin Isabelle Mousavi. Its work covers residential and commercial real estate, private mortgages, corporate law, wills, estates and trusts for Greater Toronto Area clients, with service in English, Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, Portuguese and Punjabi.
share-lawyers-calgary-calgary:
Share Lawyers Calgary is a disability law firm with offices across Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, Ontario and Saskatchewan.

Led by president and managing director David Share, the firm works from Suite 1800 at 330 5 Street SW in Calgary and handles disability and insurance claims including employee long-term disability benefits, employee short-term disability benefits and privately purchased disability benefits.
sheard-law-professional-corporation-toro:
Sheard Law Professional Corporation is a Toronto boutique family and estate law firm founded in 2011 by lawyer John Sheard.

John Sheard was called to the Ontario bar in 2005 and practises from 235 Carlaw Avenue, 5th floor. The firm handles family law, divorce, child custody and support, spousal support, property division, wills and estates, probate, estate litigation and family mediation for individuals and families, in English and French.
sherritt-greene-immigration-law-calgary:
Sherritt Greene Immigration Law is a Calgary firm practising immigration law exclusively, founded in 1998 by Michael Greene and Michael Sherritt.

Senior partners Michael Greene and Michael Sherritt practise with associate Navi Dhaliwal from Suite 301 at 1550 8 Street SW. The firm handles temporary status, permanent residence and citizenship matters for corporate and individual clients.
shilpa-bhadoria-barrister-solicitor-winn:
Shilpa Bhadoria Barrister & Solicitor is a Winnipeg law practice operating as S Lawyers LLP, founded around 2020 by lawyer Shilpa Bhadoria.

The firm handles residential real estate conveyancing, family law and uncontested divorce, wills and powers of attorney, and notary public services for clients in Winnipeg, Headingley and surrounding municipalities, in English, Hindi and Punjabi.
shimon-segal-criminal-lawyer-winnipeg:
Shimon Segal Criminal Lawyer is a Winnipeg criminal defence practice led by lawyer Shimon Segal, who also acts in immigration and refugee matters.

Shimon Segal was called to the Manitoba bar in 2015 and practises in Winnipeg with colleagues Jeffery Gindin and Gerri Wiebe. The practice covers assault, drug offences, impaired driving, sexual offences, fraud, theft and youth criminal justice, and acts for clients across Winnipeg, Manitoba and Northwestern Ontario, including Kenora and Dryden, in English.
shivji-law-calgary:
Shivji Law is a Calgary real estate and wills law firm, founded in 2011 by barrister and solicitor Farouk Shivji.

From a single office on Macleod Trail SW, the firm acts on residential real estate purchases and sales, mortgage refinancing, wills and estate planning, and employment law matters. Its clients include first-time homebuyers, property investors, families and employees across Calgary and southern Alberta, and service is offered in English.
shore-and-johnston-barristers-at-law-ott:
Shore & Johnston, Barristers-at-Law is an Ottawa criminal defence law firm co-founded in 1974 by Leonard M Shore.

Partner Michael Johnston directs the firm from Suite 600 at 141 Laurier Avenue West, and Leonard Shore is a founding president of the Defence Counsel Association of Ottawa. Its practice covers impaired driving, bail hearings and reviews, domestic and sexual assault, drug offences, firearms and violent offences, theft and fraud and criminal appeals, with services in English, French and Spanish.
shory-law-llp-calgary:
Shory Law LLP is a Calgary law firm established in 1998, handling immigration, business immigration, business law and real estate matters.

The firm has five lawyers: Chetan Shory and Ahmad J. Nasser in business law, Devinder Shory in real estate law, and Jatin Shory and Laura-Anne Goulding in immigration law. It operates from a single office at 4851 Westwinds Drive NE, Suite 220, and acts for startups, established businesses, first-time homebuyers and immigration applicants.
shulman-and-partners-llp:
Shulman & Partners LLP is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, separation and related matters, with a second office in Ottawa.

The firm has Toronto and Ottawa locations and a team-based approach in which each client has the support of a group of lawyers rather than a single adviser. Every family matter is unique, and the firm aims to give clients workable solutions to their concerns. Its practice areas include family law, divorce and separation agreements.
siddiky-law-montreal:
Siddiky Law is a Montreal immigration law firm with three lawyers: Ashraf Siddiky, Shadman Siddiky and Sohana Sara Siddiky.

The firm handles permanent residence, visitor visas, work permits, study permits and asylum matters, with civil litigation and dispute resolution also available, and has offices in Montreal, Toronto and Dartmouth. Services are offered in Bengali, English, French, Hindi and Urdu.
silaw-group-family-lawyers-surrey:
SiLaw Group Family Lawyers is a South Surrey firm of four family lawyers handling divorce, parenting, separation agreements and mediation.

Founder Sandy Sihota has practised as a family litigation lawyer, mediator and children's lawyer since 2013. The team offers family litigation in British Columbia courts, mediation, arbitration and children's law in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Gujarati, with a free 30-minute consultation and flat fees where they fit. surrovik-law-corporation-surrey:
Surrovik Law Corporation is a Surrey firm handling family law and civil matters, including divorce, child support and personal injury. Jagriti Jaswal founded the firm, and its lawyers act for clients in Vancouver and the surrounding area.

Family services cover divorce, pre- and post-nuptial agreements, child and spousal support, property division, domestic violence and guardianship, and civil work covers contract disputes, insurance matters and personal injury. Jagriti Jaswal works mainly in family and personal injury law, has appeared in the provincial and supreme courts, and negotiates or mediates for clients whenever possible. Umed Singh is also part of the team.
surya-law-toronto:
Surya Law serves Toronto, Scarborough and Brampton in real estate, immigration, family and wills and estates law. The firm was founded by Surya Chakrabarti, who practised at the Calcutta High Court in Kolkata and gained experience at Bose & Mitra in India before moving to Canada. It also handles business and contract law and notary services, and serves clients in Bangla, Hindi and English, among other languages.

Surya holds a Bachelor of Laws from the University of Burdwan and a Master of Laws from London Metropolitan University, articled with OWS Law, and built his real estate experience at Omar Zahid Law. He appears at courthouses across the GTA from an office on Kingston Road in Scarborough, and the team includes lawyer Amin Sachedinas and several legal associates.
susan-karpa-calgary:
Susan Karpa is a Calgary criminal defence lawyer handling assault, sexual offence, drug and firearms charges for clients across Alberta.

She has twenty-five years of experience in criminal law and has defended more than 2,000 people. Practice areas include assaults, threats and harassment, domestic assault, sexual assault and sexual offences, child pornography and luring offences, drug offences, and firearms and weapons offences. Each area has an explanation of the charge in plain terms, and a section of case decisions is included. She serves communities including Calgary, Airdrie and Cochrane.
sutharsan-law-professional-corporation-t:
Sutharsan Law Professional Corporation is a Scarborough criminal defence firm acting in assault, bail, drug, fraud and impaired driving cases.

The firm was founded by Sujith Sutharsan, a barrister and solicitor who studied law at the University of Windsor, and associate Arunn Logan completed his articling there. It also acts on weapons and firearms charges, sexual offence charges, probation violations, and Highway Traffic Act and administrative offences, and accepts Legal Aid Ontario certificates. Service is offered in English and Tamil to individuals across the Greater Toronto Area from its office at 305 Milner Avenue, Suite 908.
sutherland-criminal-defence-edmonton:
Sutherland Criminal Defence is a downtown Edmonton criminal defence firm founded in 2018 by lawyer Ellen Sutherland.

The firm handles emergency bail hearings, impaired driving, domestic violence, sexual assault, drug and weapons offences, theft and fraud charges, and criminal appeals before the Alberta Court of Justice and the Court of King’s Bench of Alberta, for clients in Edmonton and across Alberta, in English.
suzanne-desrosiers-professional-corporat:
Suzanne Desrosiers Professional Corporation is a Timmins law firm led by founder and president Suzanne Desrosiers, who was called to the Ontario bar in 1984.

Associates Cameron Hilker and Robert Jones practise alongside Suzanne Desrosiers at 92 Spruce Street North. The firm handles employment law, real estate, wills and estate administration, business and corporate law, civil litigation, services for First Nations clients, and HR and compliance training for clients across Timmins and Northern Ontario, in English and French.
sv-law:
SV Law serves Guelph, Elora and Waterloo with business, condominium, construction, employment, family, farm and real estate law.

Its services also include litigation and municipal, planning and land development work, and the firm has practised in Guelph since 1960. Its history runs through the name SmithValeriote LLP, the welcome of clients from Farley Law Office after Ted Farley's retirement, and a later welcome of clients from Vorvis, Anderson, Gray Armstrong LLP before the rebrand to SV Law. Lisa Gazzola is a partner. The firm also supports local organizations through sponsorship, volunteering and board service.
swift-law-calgary:
Swift Law is a Calgary real estate and estates law firm in practice since 2021, operating as Swift Barristers and Solicitors LLP.

Partners Angela Mouton and Paul Kennett lead the firm from the Marda Loop area at 2130 33 Avenue SW, with associate Jennifer George and paralegal Danny Nguyen. The practice handles residential real estate purchases, sales, refinancing and title transfers, along with wills, powers of attorney, personal directives, mediation and notary public services, in English.
swiftsure-law-victoria:
Swiftsure Law is a boutique family law firm in Victoria, British Columbia, with a practice built around divorce and separation.

Senior lawyer John Nelson works with lawyer Anukiran Klar on divorce and separation, child custody and support, property division, mediation and family law appeals for individuals and families across Greater Victoria and Southern Vancouver Island. Services are available in English, Punjabi and Hindi.
szakacs-law-injury-lawyers-calgary-calga:
Szakacs Law Injury Lawyers is a Calgary personal injury firm that represented people hurt in car, truck, motorcycle and pedestrian accidents.

Founder Dale Szakacs defended insurance companies before switching sides. The firm had offices in Calgary and Edmonton and served Red Deer, Lethbridge, St. Albert, Sherwood Park and St. Paul. Lawyers included Sandra C.M. Folkins and Bridget Belsher. Mr. Szakacs has retired after more than thirty-five years in practice, and the firm has transitioned its practice to Cuming & Gillespie LLP.
tabuchi-law-mississauga:
Tabuchi Law is a Mississauga law firm handling wills, estates, real estate closings, family agreements and small business incorporations.

The practice operates as Tabuchi Law Professional Corp. and is led by founder Maureen Tabuchi, who holds an LL.B. and a Master of Taxation and has more than 30 years of experience. It is a woman-owned firm with a single office at 120 Watline Avenue, Unit 5. Its services include wills, powers of attorney, estate planning, probate and estate administration, separation, divorce, cohabitation and prenuptial agreements, and small business tax planning.
taerk-family-law-toronto:
Taerk Family Law is a Toronto family law firm founded by managing partner Amanda Taerk.

Taerk holds a BA and BSW from McGill and an LLB from Western and spent about a decade at two Toronto family law boutiques before founding the firm. Its four lawyers handle divorce and separation, parenting and support disputes, property division, domestic contracts and high-net-worth matters, as well as child protection matters, for clients across Toronto.
tailor-law-professional-corporation-miss:
Tailor Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga family law firm founded in 2016 by Deepa Tailor.

Deepa Tailor is a member of the Law Society of Ontario with degrees from the University of Toronto and the University of Ottawa. The firm's head office is in Mississauga, and a Toronto office added in 2018 is used by appointment. Its work covers family law, including divorce, custody, support and property division, wills and estates and civil litigation for families and professionals across Peel Region and the Greater Toronto Area.
tapper-cuddy-llp-winnipeg:
Tapper Cuddy LLP is a full-service Winnipeg law firm practising from 330 St Mary Avenue, Suite 1000.

Managing partner Brett Williams leads a partnership that includes Kathleen Coutts, Kevin Schulz, Kris Janovcik, Richard Beamish, Amanda Verhaeghe, Jason Harvey and Jason Kendall. The firm handles civil and commercial litigation, family law and child protection, wills and estates, real estate, construction, employment and labour, personal injury, medical negligence, defamation and media, insolvency and financial restructuring, and corporate and commercial law, with services in English and Mandarin.
tarnow-criminal-law-richmond:
Tarnow Criminal Law is a Richmond, British Columbia criminal defence firm acting for people charged with offences throughout Metro Vancouver.

Brothers David Tarnow and Jason Tarnow lead the practice, which is full-service and draws on decades of combined criminal law experience. They are trial lawyers by nature who treat guilty pleas and plea bargains as a last resort. The firm appears in court in Vancouver, Surrey and Richmond, along with the wider region of British Columbia, and Yukon is also among its service areas. Emphasis is placed on Charter rights and the right to legal counsel. The office is on Westminster Highway in Richmond.
tarnowecky-law-professional-corporation:
Tarnowecky Law Professional Corporation is a family-run Kingston law firm serving the community for more than 50 years.

Yuri Tarnowecky was called to the Ontario bar in 1975, and the firm has six lawyers including Ivanna Tarnowecky, who was called in 2015. Its work covers residential and commercial real estate purchases, sales, refinancing and title transfers, as well as wills, powers of attorney and estate administration for Kingston-area clients, with remote closings available, in English.
tas-law-firm-mississauga:
TAS Law Firm is a Mississauga family law firm led by lawyer Ansar Khan, handling uncontested divorce and separation agreements.

The firm operates as TAS Law Firm Professional Corporation from Suite 700 at 2 Robert Speck Parkway and serves Mississauga, Milton, Brampton and the wider Greater Toronto Area. Its practice covers uncontested divorce, separation agreements, child custody and support and foreign divorce opinion letters, with in-person and virtual consultations in English.
tathgar-law:
Tathgar Law is a Victoria law firm established in 2018 by Sunny Tathgar, handling real estate, business and wills and estates matters.

Sunny Tathgar is the founder and principal lawyer, a member of the Law Society of British Columbia with an honours law degree from the University of Birmingham and a political science degree from the University of Victoria. The firm has offices in Victoria, Langford and Nanaimo and handles residential and commercial real estate, business and corporate law, wills, trusts and estate planning for individuals, families, entrepreneurs and business owners across Vancouver Island, in English and Punjabi.
taurus-law-edmonton:
Taurus Law is an Edmonton law firm founded in 2023, handling family law, civil litigation, estates and real estate matters.

Omar Abdulhak and Rana Ghanem founded the firm, joined by counsel Kathy Tarrabain and lawyer Alim Tharani, and it operates in Edmonton with a branch in Calgary. Its practice covers family law and divorce, civil and commercial litigation, personal injury, estate litigation, wills, estates and trusts, real estate, corporate and commercial law, employment, administrative law, builders' liens and Indigenous and Métis law for individuals, entrepreneurs and businesses across Alberta.
taylor-janis-workplace-lawyers-vancouver:
Taylor Janis Workplace Lawyers is a Vancouver employment and labour law firm acting for employees and employers in British Columbia and Alberta.

The firm works from an office in Gastown and handles wrongful and constructive dismissal, severance, workplace harassment, human rights matters, employment contracts, and civil and commercial litigation. Service is offered in English, Mandarin, French and Arabic.
taylor-law-calgary:
Taylor Law is a Calgary boutique law firm handling real estate, wills, estates and corporate matters.

Principal lawyer Thomas J. Taylor was called to the Alberta bar in 1989 and has practised for more than three decades. The firm works from Suite 240 at 550 71 Avenue SE and handles real estate, wills and estates, estate planning, probate and corporate law for clients in Calgary and surrounding Alberta communities.
taylor-mccaffrey-llp-winnipeg:
Taylor McCaffrey LLP is a full-service Winnipeg law firm formed from the merger of firms led by Reeh Taylor and D’Arcy McCaffrey.

Corrine Kulyk is managing partner of the firm's roughly 67 lawyers, who work from Suite 2200 at 201 Portage Avenue and serve rural Manitoba through satellite offices. The practice covers business and corporate law, civil litigation, family law, employment and labour, real estate, tax, wills and estates, intellectual property, administrative law and immigration for business, government, professional-association and individual clients, in English and French.
tc-legal-calgary:
TC Legal is a Calgary firm that acts for people injured in accidents and for people facing criminal charges.

Its two practice areas are personal injury law and criminal defence, and its site describes a process that runs from an initial consultation through to resolution. The office is at 1144 29 Avenue NE, Suite 101E.
tcj-brossard:
TCJ, short for Therrien Couture Joli-Coeur, is a multidisciplinary Quebec law firm with its Brossard office at 2000 Rue de l’Éclipse.

The independent firm operates seven offices across Quebec, with lawyers, notaries and tax professionals advising on business and corporate and commercial law, commercial and residential real estate including notarial services, employment and labour, litigation, tax, wills and estates, and family law. It serves start-ups, mid-market companies, public institutions and individuals across Montérégie and beyond in French and English.
tcz-law-toronto:
TCZ Law is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, separation, custody, support and domestic contracts, with services in English and Chinese.

Lawyer Eric Tianchuan Zhao represents clients in negotiation and, when needed, in court. Areas include custody and access, child support, spousal support, division of property, marriage contracts, cohabitation agreements and motions to change. The firm provides a draft separation agreement or marriage contract within five business days of receiving the needed information. Before opening his own practice he worked at Baker McKenzie LLP, McInnis & Nicoll and Mahdi Leite Family Law LPP, and the firm has downtown and North York locations.
team-law-group-llp-edmonton:
Team Law Group LLP is an Edmonton law firm established in 2014 by Navjeet Ralh, handling family, immigration and corporate matters.

Lawyers Inderpreet Budesha and Jagsharan Mahal practise with the founder from a single office in Mill Woods at 4271 23 Avenue NW, Suite 203. The firm's practice covers family law, immigration, corporate and commercial law, criminal defence, real estate conveyancing, wills, estates and probate, and notary public services, with in-person and virtual appointments.
temple-of-justice-legal-service-hamilton:
Paralegals at Temple of Justice Legal Service in Hamilton handle provincial offences, tribunal matters and notary public work. The firm acts for individuals and businesses, including at the Landlord and Tenant Board and the Human Rights Tribunal of Ontario. It aims to provide a safe, welcoming environment in which clients' rights are protected and their voices are heard.

Its mission is access to justice, with a people-centred approach that puts the individual first. The firm is open around the clock, seven days a week, from its office on Upper James Street.
tessera-avocats-inc:
Tessera Avocats is a Montreal boutique firm handling corporate, commercial, real estate and financing matters, along with dispute resolution. It was founded by four lawyers whose practices complement each other.

Service areas cover real estate and financing, corporate and commercial law, corporate reorganization, and litigation and dispute resolution. The firm takes a direct, pragmatic approach that favours clear advice and efficient execution over form, and its partners include Yanni Sideris and Christopher Tesolin. The office is at 300 Rue Léo-Pariseau.
tevlin-gleadle-curtis-vancouver:
Tevlin Gleadle Curtis is a Vancouver employment law firm handling wrongful dismissal, constructive dismissal and human rights matters. Murray Tevlin and Dan Gleadle founded it in 2000, and it acts for employees, groups of employees, employers and contractors across Canada.

Its lawyers have worked in trial and appeal courts in British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan and Ontario and appeared at the Supreme Court of Canada in Matthews and Ocean Nutrition, and they also act in mediation, arbitration and before administrative tribunals. The practice covers workplace harassment, class actions, workplace investigations and compensation issues for physicians in publicly funded health care.
the-criminal-law-team-north-york:
Criminal defence across Toronto, the GTA and Southern Ontario is the work of The Criminal Law Team, based in North York. Co-founded by Stephen Hebscher, the firm represents people facing domestic assault, sexual assault, dangerous driving, property, violent crime, drug and youth charges, including cases involving mental health considerations.

Its lawyers have decades of combined courtroom experience and have represented clients across Ontario. Stephen Hebscher and Bruce Karten, now retired, each kept their own roster of clients while working together on cases. The firm is available around the clock and publishes case summaries showing the types of matters it has handled.
the-law-offices-of-nikolas-j-lust-ottawa:
The Law Offices of Nikolas J Lust is an Ottawa criminal defence practice led by lawyer Nikolas Lust, serving clients across Ontario.

A graduate of the University of Ottawa Faculty of Law who articled under a senior Toronto criminal defence lawyer, Nikolas Lust practises from 331 Somerset Street West and defends assault and aggravated assault, domestic violence and sexual assault charges, and handles bail and detention reviews and Charter applications.
the-law-portal-vancouver:
The Law Portal is a virtual British Columbia family law firm with its head office at 777 Hornby Street in Vancouver.

Founded by Sarah Miller, the three-lawyer firm includes Christine Inducil and Katya Richardson alongside the founder and handles uncontested divorce, cohabitation, marriage and separation agreements, civil litigation, and wills, estates and trusts. Clients across British Columbia are served remotely by phone, Zoom or Teams, with optional in-person meetings at the Vancouver office.
the-legal-pillars-pc-mississauga:
The Legal Pillars is a Mississauga firm handling family, criminal and real estate matters, and it describes itself as advocates for justice in Ontario.

The firm says it puts transparency and honesty at the centre of its work with clients and gives each client personalized attention. Its site sets out family law, criminal law and real estate law separately, with an explanation of how each area works in practice.
the-litigators:
The Litigators is a Mississauga law firm handling civil litigation, real estate, wills and estates, family and corporate matters.

Managing lawyer Micah Remedios leads a team of three lawyers with Divya Keswani and Jamie Levine, who is of counsel, working from Building 4, Suite 320 at 2000 Argentia Road. The firm acts for individuals and businesses in Mississauga, Milton and the surrounding area, including startups and companies in manufacturing, construction, technology and retail.
the-myers-law-company-vancouver:
The Myers Law Company is a Vancouver criminal defence firm led by Justin Myers and Zack Myers, with traffic and family matters also covered.

The lawyers appear in Youth Court, Provincial Court, BC Supreme Court, the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court of Canada, and can attend in Alberta, Ontario and other jurisdictions on request. Serious matters include murder, drug importation, firearms, theft, trafficking and arson. The approach is detail-oriented and transparent, with lawyers who often write detailed legal arguments and who collaborate on strategy and trials without raising the cost to the client. The office is on West Pender Street.
the-riley-divorce-and-family-law-firm:
The Riley Divorce & Family Law Firm is a Hamilton family practice handling divorce, parenting time, spousal support and property division.

The firm has offices in Toronto, Ottawa, Hamilton, Kawartha Lakes and Oakville and serves clients throughout Ontario. Its clients are professionals, business owners, executives and their spouses, including high-net-worth property division, and it handles contested matters over parenting time, decision making, relocation, appeals and variations. The firm also produces a video series called Details in Divorce, with topics such as cross-border divorce, child support for high-income families and separation agreements set aside for non-disclosure.
thind-law-enterprise-professional-corpor:
Real estate, corporate and immigration law are the main work of Thind Law Enterprise Professional Corporation in Brampton. The firm also takes on civil litigation and other matters for clients across Canada.

Its office is on Delta Park Boulevard, and meetings are held in person or virtually. Clients are kept informed at each stage of a file and have easy access to their lawyer. Fees are competitive, payment arrangements are flexible, and legal strategy is set around each client's goals. The corporate, real estate and immigration work is aimed at keeping transactions manageable for business owners who want to focus on growth.
thompson-dorfman-sweatman-llp-winnipeg:
Thompson Dorfman Sweatman LLP is a full-service Winnipeg law firm with ten offices across Manitoba and an office in Saskatoon.

The firm’s Winnipeg office is at Suite 1700, 242 Hargrave Street. Its practice covers business and corporate law, civil litigation, administrative and regulatory law, real estate, employment and labour, wills, estates and trusts, family, tax, intellectual property, Indigenous law, bankruptcy and insolvency, and immigration, with services available in languages including French, Cantonese, Mandarin, Punjabi, Hindi, Portuguese, Spanish and Tagalog.
thomson-rogers-llp:
Thomson Rogers LLP is a Toronto personal injury and civil litigation firm whose roots go back to 1935.

The firm began as E.L. Haines and Co., became Haines, Thomson, Rogers in 1950 and Thomson, Rogers in 1966, and has been at 390 Bay Street since 1973. Stephen J. D'Agostino is managing partner, and partners include Al Burton, Aleks Mladenovic, Carr Hatch, Daniel Klein, Darcy R. Merkur and Ian W.K. Furlong. Its work covers personal and catastrophic injury, medical malpractice, family law, class actions, municipal and expropriation law, environmental law and civil litigation, in English, French, Mandarin and Cantonese.
threshold-law-winnipeg:
Threshold Law is a Winnipeg boutique immigration law firm led by principal lawyer David Davis.

David Davis, called to the Manitoba bar in 1989, practises from Suite 201 at 233 Portage Avenue and handles immigration matters including healthcare recruitment, employer pathways, business investor and provincial nominee programs, appeals and judicial reviews, along with cybersecurity and privacy counsel, for companies recruiting foreign workers, foreign investors and rural and remote employers across Canada.
tidal-law-llp-edmonton:
Tidal Law LLP is a family and civil litigation firm with offices in Edmonton and Calgary.

The firm advises on separation, divorce, parenting and financial issues, and acts for individuals and businesses in civil disputes such as contracts, debt recovery and commercial conflicts. Its team includes Jaskaran Sandhu, Hasman Dhaliwal, Navjeet Ralh, Amreet Toor and Guntash Gill. The Edmonton office is at 1667 91 Street SW.
tierney-stauffer-llp:
Tierney Stauffer LLP is a full-service Ottawa law firm handling business, real estate, employment, estates and personal injury matters.

The firm has practised in the Ottawa area since 1982 and combines the insight of a boutique with the resources of a full-service firm. Within the past decade it opened offices in Cornwall, Kingston and North Bay, and its lawyers have over 30 years of experience in each of its practice areas. It also runs an articling program in which a large share of student work comes from the Civil Litigation Practice Group.
tim-louis-and-company-law-firm-vancouver:
Tim Louis & Company Law Firm is a Vancouver law firm established in 1984, handling disability, personal injury, employment and estate matters.

Founder and sole lawyer Tim Louis has practised for more than four decades in disability, injury and employment law from the firm's office at 2526 West 5th Avenue. The firm acts on long-term disability claims, personal injury, wrongful dismissal, wills and estate planning, probate, estate litigation and wills variation for clients across the Vancouver region, in English and Spanish.
tina-fasano-lindy-mcdonald-lawyers:
Tina Fasano & Lindy McDonald Lawyers is a two-lawyer Kingston, Ontario family law firm serving Kingston and Eastern Ontario.

Tina Fasano was called to the Ontario bar in 1993, is an accredited lawyer-mediator and formerly chaired Kingston’s Family Law Section and Collaborative Family Law Group, while partner Lindy McDonald is a bilingual lawyer with an LLM. The firm handles family law and divorce, family mediation, child custody and support, separation agreements, collaborative family law, residential real estate, wills and powers of attorney, and employment law and wrongful dismissal, in English and French.
titan-law-toronto:
Titan Law runs immigration and corporate law offices in Toronto and Vancouver. Immigration work covers visitor visas, study permits, work visas, family sponsorship, business immigration, permanent residency, inadmissibility, previously refused applications and refugee matters, and the firm also advises on incorporations, reorganizations and cross-border corporate structures.

Its lawyers offer one-hour appointments in English, French, Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Russian, Ukrainian, Korean and Japanese. The Toronto office is on Bloor Street West, and the team includes Stanley Chiu, Sameera Ismail, Leo Chan, Karen Jantzen and Anneka Oh.
tlc-family-law-prince-george:
TLC Family Law Practice is a Prince George firm handling divorce, parenting arrangements, support and property division under British Columbia family law.

The practice also has offices in Parksville and serves the Nanaimo and Qualicum area. Tracy L. Clark is a family lawyer with over 30 years in practice. The firm's primary aim is to settle matters by agreement quickly and efficiently, while taking cases to court when that is necessary. Services include flat fee agreements, uncontested divorces, guardianship, parenting time and access, child and spousal support, variation of existing orders, pension and property division, family debt, and cohabitation, marriage and prenuptial agreements.
tlc-legal-professional-corporation-ottaw:
In the Barrhaven area of Ottawa, TLC Legal Professional Corporation focuses on real estate, wills and estates, and charity law.

Tanya Carlton founded the firm after practising since 2013, including time at Carter's Professional Corporation and Drache Aptowitzer LLP, where she served not-for-profit clients. She holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Ottawa. Lawyers Jordan Scorgie and Dean Barrett also practise there. The practice covers home purchases, sales and remortgages, wills and estates, and business, charity and not-for-profit law, and it offers notary public services.
tlm-avocat-divorce-montreal:
Divorce, child custody, child support and mediation are the focus of TLM Avocat Divorce, a Montreal family law firm with fixed-price packages.

Operating as TLM Avocats, the team of family lawyers also covers civil law and the law of persons, and assists with small claims proceedings. Packages exist for uncontested divorce without children and for joint custody and child support procedures, and the child support calculation is included. Payment arrangements can be set up, and payment is accepted by cheque, Interac, MasterCard, Visa or cash. The office is on Rue Sherbrooke Est in Montreal.
top-law-firm-north-york:
This North York law practice provides real estate legal services to clients in Toronto and the surrounding area. It is listed as a general practice, and its team handles the real estate legal needs of its clients.

The office is at 4950 Yonge Street, Suite 2200, North York, Ontario M2J 4Z2, in the Toronto area. Real estate law is the focus of the practice, which serves the wider Toronto region from this location.
torkin-manes-llp:
Torkin Manes LLP is a full-service Toronto law firm founded in 1974, advising businesses, investors and private clients.

The firm’s practice covers banking, corporate and commercial law, mergers and acquisitions, tax, employment, insolvency, franchise and technology law, commercial real estate, health law, litigation and dispute resolution, and private client services including estates, family law and charities. Clients range from owner-operators and founders to investment funds and high-net-worth individuals, with service available in more than a dozen languages.
toronto-civil-litigation-lawyers-toronto:
Toronto Civil Litigation Lawyers, or Powell Litigation, handles commercial litigation and shareholder disputes for businesses and individuals.

The firm is led by founding partner Weston Powell and focuses exclusively on courtroom advocacy and dispute resolution rather than general practice. It handles commercial conflicts, real estate disputes and estate challenges, and appears in the Ontario Superior Court of Justice for clients across Southern Ontario. Its office is in Toronto, Richmond Hill is also among the places served, and the lawyers have over 40 years of combined trial experience.
torys-llp:
Torys LLP is an international business law firm in Toronto advising on mergers and acquisitions and capital markets transactions.

The firm has worked with clients for over 80 years and has a cross-border, multidisciplinary team led by Managing Partner Matt Cockburn. Transactions include acting as counsel to Anglo American on its proposed merger with Teck Resources, to Rogers Communications on a C$7 billion equity financing with an investor group led by Blackstone, and to Ontario Power Generation on an equity investment in the Darlington New Nuclear Project, plus Endo's sale of its international pharmaceuticals business to Knight Therapeutics.
torys-llp-calgary:
Torys LLP is a business law firm founded in Toronto in 1941 that opened a Calgary office in 2011, making it a national firm.

The Calgary office, with about twelve lawyers including partners Ron Deyholos, Scott Cochlan and Luigi Cusano and Robert Froehlich, who heads the Calgary business law group, advises on corporate law, mergers and acquisitions, securities and capital markets, banking and finance, energy, commercial real estate, tax, environmental law, competition and litigation. Torys also has offices in Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, Halifax and New York, and acts for commercial clients and financial institutions in Canada, the United States and globally.
traffic-tickets-toronto-toronto:
Traffic Tickets Toronto defends drivers charged with speeding, stunt driving, careless driving and other traffic offences in Ontario and Manitoba.

The business traces to Shelina Lalji, who joined POINTTS in 2008, became its master franchisee in 2015 and later launched the JUSTICEJOLT Legal Defence for Drivers brand. The team has more than 17 years of experience and offers paralegal-led defence aimed at protecting licences, records and insurance costs. Services include demerit point matters, handheld device violations, dangerous driving and related criminal charges, appeals, licence reinstatement and CVOR defence for commercial operators.
travers-law-guelph:
Travers Law is a Guelph law firm established in 1981, handling real estate, family, wills and estates and corporate matters.

The team includes Don Travers, Bryan Mayes, Robert Sheldon and Tiffany Yim, working from 100 Gordon Street in Guelph, with additional offices in Kitchener-Waterloo, Cambridge and Milton. The firm acts for first-time homebuyers, real estate developers and commercial investors, and its practice also covers estate administration, powers of attorney and business law.
traxler-haines:
Traxler Haines is a Prince George, British Columbia law firm established in 1974 at 1488 4th Avenue, Suite 614.

Managing partner Jacqueline Trudel works with lawyers Brad Douglas, Kristopher Henderson, Luke Cutbill and Murray Bartsch on wills and estates, real estate conveyancing, and business, commercial and corporate law. Clients include young families, small business owners, seniors and professionals in Prince George and surrounding communities.
tremblay-law-group-pc-north-bay:
Tremblay Law Group PC is a multidisciplinary North Bay, Ontario law firm serving Northern Ontario.

Established in 1993 as Wallace & Klein Partners in Law through the merger of two North Bay firms, the firm adopted its current name in 2024 under managing lawyer Christian Tremblay. Its six lawyers, Christian Tremblay, Daniela Legere, Jeff Jordan, Joel Senecal, Paul Trenker and Taylor Trottier, advise on real estate, business and corporate law, civil litigation and dispute resolution, family law, criminal defence, construction, wills, estates and trusts, and personal injury, in English and French.
treo-law-llp-brandon:
Treo Law LLP is a full-service law firm in Brandon, Manitoba, serving the Westman area and Western Manitoba.

Partners Breena Murray and Courtney Buckman lead a team of five lawyers that includes associates Lyric Stewart, Sarah Idowu and Sundeep Dhillon. The firm advises on family law, real estate, corporate and commercial law, criminal defence, wills and powers of attorney, immigration and litigation, with multilingual staff available.
trivium-law-richmond:
Trivium Law is a boutique Richmond, British Columbia law firm advising on business, real estate and estate matters.

Founded in 2021 and located at 4320 Viking Way, Suite 260, in the International Business Park, the firm’s four lawyers, Gary Hou, Jenny Ruan, Steven Liu and Tony Su, handle business and corporate law, commercial and residential real estate, wills, estates and trusts, and probate. It serves entrepreneurs, developers, investors and families across Metro Vancouver in English, Mandarin and Cantonese, by appointment in person or virtually, with wheelchair-accessible service.
truman-law-surrey:
Truman Law is a Surrey firm advising on real estate, corporate matters, civil litigation, foreclosures and estate planning. Principal lawyer Harkirat Singh Kang founded it in 2020 as a litigation practice and expanded into residential and commercial real estate in 2021.

He was called to the bar in Delhi in 2013, Ontario in 2016 and British Columbia in 2017, and has appeared in the Provincial Court and the Supreme Court of British Columbia. ylaw-vancouver:
